Metode evaluasi *model* ekstraksi entitas yang mencocokkan rentang teks tertentu yang diberi label.

background.en: Accessing sensitive patient data for machine learning is difficult due to strict privacy regulations such as HIPAA and GDPR, leading to a scarcity of accessible clinical data and annotated corpora. Developing privacy-enhancing technologies requires robust anonymization systems, but most existing resources and de-identification datasets are restricted to English or a few other languages. Furthermore, purely adhering to basic de-identification rules is often insufficient because indirect personal identifiers, such as ZIP codes and demographic details, can still be combined to re-identify individuals.
background.id: Mengakses data pasien yang sensitif untuk *machine learning* sulit dilakukan karena peraturan privasi yang ketat seperti HIPAA dan GDPR, yang menyebabkan kelangkaan data klinis yang dapat diakses dan korpus beranotasi. Pengembangan teknologi peningkatan privasi memerlukan sistem anonimisasi yang andal, tetapi sebagian besar sumber daya dan *dataset* de-identifikasi yang ada terbatas pada bahasa Inggris atau beberapa bahasa lainnya. Selain itu, kepatuhan murni pada aturan de-identifikasi dasar seringkali tidak mencukupi karena pengenal pribadi tidak langsung, seperti kode pos dan detail demografis, masih dapat digabungkan untuk mengidentifikasi ulang individu.

contributions.en: The main contributions of this work include the creation of MultiGraSCCo, a multilingual anonymization benchmark in ten languages across six language families and three writing systems, featuring annotations for both direct and indirect personal identifiers. The authors provide a comprehensive evaluation of translation quality and cultural adaptation conducted by medical professionals. Additionally, they perform extensive monolingual, cross-lingual, and multilingual experiments using encoder models to assess usability for model training.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama dari pekerjaan ini mencakup pembuatan MultiGraSCCo, sebuah *benchmark* anonimisasi multilingua dalam sepuluh bahasa dari enam rumpun bahasa dan tiga sistem penulisan, yang menampilkan anotasi untuk pengenal pribadi langsung maupun tidak langsung. Para penulis menyediakan evaluasi komprehensif mengenai kualitas terjemahan dan adaptasi kultural yang dilakukan oleh profesional medis. Selain itu, mereka melakukan eksperimen ekabahasa, silang bahasa, dan multilingua yang ekstensif menggunakan *encoder models* untuk menilai kegunaan dalam pelatihan *model*.

future_work.en: The authors note that the dataset contains artificial features like medical terminology-based names and lacks realistic stylistic variations found in natural clinical texts across different languages. They state that the performance and usability of the trained models should still be tested on real patient data in each respective language.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat bahwa *dataset* tersebut berisi fitur buatan seperti nama berbasis terminologi medis dan kekurangan variasi gaya realistis yang ditemukan dalam teks klinis alami di berbagai bahasa. Mereka menyatakan bahwa performa dan kegunaan dari *model* yang dilatih masih harus diuji pada data pasien nyata di masing-masing bahasa terkait.

method.en: The benchmark is built upon the German GraSCCo corpus by expanding PHI annotations and adding a new annotation layer for 13 indirect personal identifier categories using INCEpTION. The corpus is preprocessed using GPT-4.1 to correct typos and expand abbreviations based on annotator labels while preserving XML annotation tags. Subsequently, GPT-4.1 is used to translate the text into English, French, Arabic, Persian, Italian, Polish, Russian, Ukrainian, and Turkish with annotation preservation and cultural adaptation of named entities. Evaluation uses human assessment with medical experts and automated metrics like micro and macro F1 scores via NERvaluate across monolingual, cross-lingual, and multilingual training setups.
method.id: Benchmark ini dibangun di atas korpus GraSCCo berbahasa Jerman dengan memperluas anotasi PHI dan menambahkan lapisan anotasi baru untuk 13 kategori pengenal pribadi tidak langsung menggunakan INCEpTION. Korpus dipraproses menggunakan GPT-4.1 untuk memperbaiki *typo* dan memperluas singkatan berdasarkan label annotator sembari mempertahankan tag anotasi XML. Selanjutnya, GPT-4.1 digunakan untuk menerjemahkan teks ke dalam bahasa Inggris, Prancis, Arab, Persia, Italia, Polandia, Rusia, Ukraina, dan Turki dengan pelestarian anotasi dan adaptasi kultural dari entitas bernama. Evaluasi menggunakan penilaian manusia dengan pakar medis dan metrik otomatis seperti *micro* dan *macro F1-score* melalui NERvaluate di seluruh pengaturan pelatihan *monolingual*, *cross-lingual*, dan *multilingual*.

related_work.en: Prior research includes several English and monolingual clinical de-identification datasets, such as the i2b2 data, the SIRM COVID-19 corpus in Italian, MEDDOCAN for Spanish, and Swedish clinical text corpora. For German, corpora like GraSCCo and GraSCCo_PHI provide synthetic clinical texts annotated with HIPAA categories. However, the use of machine translation to address the scarcity of multilingual de-identification and privacy-related datasets remains largely unexplored, with only rare exceptions like translating the i2b2 dataset into Arabic.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya mencakup beberapa *dataset* de-identifikasi klinis berbahasa Inggris dan ekabahasa, seperti data i2b2, korpus SIRM COVID-19 dalam bahasa Italia, MEDDOCAN untuk bahasa Spanyol, dan korpus teks klinis Swedia. Untuk bahasa Jerman, korpus seperti GraSCCo dan GraSCCo_PHI menyediakan teks klinis sintetis yang beranotasi dengan kategori HIPAA. Namun, penggunaan *machine translation* untuk mengatasi kelangkaan *dataset* de-identifikasi multilingua dan terkait privasi sebagian besar masih belum dieksplorasi, dengan sedikit pengecualian seperti penerjemahan *dataset* i2b2 ke dalam bahasa Arab.

results.en: Human evaluation confirmed high translation quality, averaging 6.34 out of 7 for general quality and 6.39 for entity translation adaptation. In machine learning experiments, monolingual models achieved strong PHI detection (micro F1 0.90-0.95), while IPI detection proved more challenging due to subtle context-dependent cues. Cross-lingual zero-shot performance showed significant drops, whereas multilingual training with even 25% target-language data substantially improved performance, with 100% training data achieving the highest micro F1 (above 0.86) and macro F1 (above 0.79) scores across all languages.
results.id: Evaluasi manusia mengonfirmasi kualitas terjemahan yang tinggi, dengan rata-rata 6,34 dari 7 untuk kualitas umum dan 6,39 untuk adaptasi terjemahan entitas. Dalam eksperimen *machine learning*, *model* ekabahasa mencapai deteksi PHI yang kuat (*micro F1* 0,90-0,95), sementara deteksi IPI terbukti lebih menantang karena petunjuk kontekstual yang halus. Performa *zero-shot* silang bahasa menunjukkan penurunan yang signifikan, sedangkan pelatihan multilingua bahkan dengan 25% data bahasa target secara substansial meningkatkan performa, dengan 100% data pelatihan mencapai skor *micro F1* tertinggi (di atas 0,86) dan *macro F1* tertinggi (di atas 0,79) di semua bahasa.

tldr.en: This paper introduces MultiGraSCCo, a multilingual anonymization benchmark covering ten languages for detecting personal identifiers in clinical texts. The evaluation confirms high translation quality and shows that incorporating target-language data significantly improves model performance.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan MultiGraSCCo, sebuah *benchmark* anonimisasi multilingua yang mencakup sepuluh bahasa untuk mendeteksi pengenal pribadi pada teks klinis. Evaluasi mengonfirmasi kualitas terjemahan yang tinggi dan menunjukkan bahwa penyertaan data bahasa target secara signifikan meningkatkan performa *model*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.529.title: MultiGraSCCo: A Multilingual Anonymization Benchmark with Annotations of Personal Identifiers
acl:2026.lrec-1.529.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.537.abstract: SiDiaC-v.2.0 is the largest comprehensive Sinhala Diachronic Corpus to date, covering a period from 1800 CE to 1955 CE in terms of publication dates, and a historical span from the 5th to the 20th century CE in terms of written dates. The corpus consists of 244k words across 185 literary works that underwent thorough filtering, preprocessing, and copyright compliance checks, followed by extensive post-processing. Additionally, a subset of 59 documents totalling 70k words was annotated based on their written dates. Texts from the National Library of Sri Lanka were selected from the SiDiaC-v.1.0 non-filtered list, which was digitised using Google Document AI OCR. This was followed by post-processing to correct formatting issues, address code-mixing, include special tokens, and fix malformed tokens. The construction of SiDiaC-v.2.0 was informed by practices from other corpora, such as FarPaHC, SiDiaC-v.1.0, and CCOHA. This was particularly relevant for syntactic annotation and text normalisation strategies, given the shared characteristics of low-resource language status between Faroese and the similar cleaning strategies utilised in CCOHA. This corpus is categorised into two layers based on genres: primary and secondary. The primary categorisation is binary, assigning each book to either Non-Fiction or Fiction. The secondary categorisation is more detailed, grouping texts under specific genres such as Religious, History, Poetry, Language, and Medical. Despite facing challenges due to limited resources, SiDiaC-v.2.0 serves as a comprehensive resource for Sinhala NLP, building upon the work previously done in SiDiaC-v.1.0.
acl:2026.lrec-1.537.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Sebuah *korpus* teks yang dikumpulkan dari berbagai periode waktu untuk mempelajari bagaimana bahasa berevolusi dari waktu ke waktu.
Proses pengelompokan bentuk infleksi dari sebuah kata sehingga dapat dianalisis sebagai item tunggal berdasarkan bentuk dasarnya.
Tugas analisis sintaksis untuk menetapkan hubungan ketergantungan antar-kata dalam sebuah kalimat.
Kata-kata yang sering muncul bersama dalam jarak tertentu di dalam sebuah teks atau *korpus*.
Kondisi di mana sebuah kata memiliki beberapa arti atau makna yang berbeda tergantung pada konteksnya.
Perubahan makna kata seiring berjalannya waktu dalam suatu bahasa.

background.en: Diachronic linguistics studies how languages evolve over time, a field increasingly energized by historical text digitization and large-scale corpora. However, low-resource languages such as Sinhala lack extensive historical datasets, hindering the tracking of lexical semantic shifts, neologisms, and grammatical changes. Existing corpora for Sinhala were limited in size, contained code-mixed content, and suffered from formatting and OCR-induced errors, creating an urgent need for a larger, cleaner, and more thoroughly curated diachronic corpus.
background.id: Linguistik diakronik mempelajari bagaimana bahasa berkembang seiring waktu, sebuah bidang yang semakin didorong oleh digitalisasi teks historis dan *korpus* berskala besar. Namun, bahasa *low-resource* seperti Sinhala kekurangan *dataset* historis yang ekstensif, sehingga menghambat pelacakan pergeseran semantik leksikal, neologisme, dan perubahan gramatikal. *Korpus* yang ada untuk bahasa Sinhala terbatas ukurannya, mengandung konten *code-mixed*, serta mengalami kesalahan pemformatan dan yang disebabkan oleh *OCR*, sehingga menciptakan kebutuhan mendesak akan *korpus* diakronik yang lebih besar, lebih bersih, dan dikurasi secara menyeluruh.

contributions.en: This paper presents SiDiaC-v.2.0, the largest Sinhala diachronic corpus to date, expanding the dataset from 46 to 185 literary works comprising over 240,000 words. Key novelties include a revised written-date filtering approach modeled after COHA, systematic removal of non-Sinhala code-mixed data, introduction of special tokens such as sentence boundaries and poetry suffix-shift indicators, and comprehensive metadata containing primary and secondary genre classifications for synchronic and diachronic analysis.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyajikan *SiDiaC-v.2.0*, *korpus* diakronik Sinhala terbesar hingga saat ini, yang memperluas *dataset* dari 46 menjadi 185 karya sastra yang terdiri dari lebih dari 240.000 kata. Kebaruan utama mencakup pendekatan penyaringan tanggal penulisan yang direvisi yang dimodelkan setelah *COHA*, penghapusan sistematis data *code-mixed* non-Sinhala, pengenalan token khusus seperti batas kalimat dan indikator pergeseran sufiks puisi, serta metadata komprehensif yang berisi klasifikasi genre primer dan sekunder untuk analisis sinkronik dan diakronik.

future_work.en: The authors note limitations including the inability to perform automated part-of-speech tagging or dependency parsing due to the absence of accurate historical Sinhala syntactic tools, as well as the impracticality of inter-annotator agreement for manual post-processing. Future work involves extending annotation pipelines and improving NLP tools for historical low-resource languages.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat keterbatasan termasuk ketidakmampuan untuk melakukan *part-of-speech tagging* otomatis atau *dependency parsing* karena tidak adanya alat sintaksis bahasa Sinhala historis yang akurat, serta ketidakpraktisan persetujuan antar-*annotator* untuk *post-processing* manual. Pekerjaan di masa mendatang melibatkan perluasan alur *anotasi* dan peningkatan alat NLP untuk bahasa *low-resource* historis.

method.en: The corpus construction pipeline began with 233 unique books sourced from the National Library of Sri Lanka. Through rigorous data preparation, copyright checks, and language filtration, 185 books were accepted. Text extraction was performed using Google Document AI OCR due to its superior performance with historical Sinhala, complemented by manual post-processing. This post-processing involved character-by-character correction of malformed tokens, removal of footers and page titles, standardisation of multi-column text, insertion of sentence-ending and poetry suffix tokens, and meticulous written-date annotation using historical reference texts and author lifespans.
method.id: Alur pembuatan *korpus* dimulai dengan 233 buku unik yang bersumber dari Perpustakaan Nasional Sri Lanka. Melalui persiapan data yang ketat, pemeriksaan hak cipta, dan filtrasi bahasa, 185 buku diterima. Ekstraksi teks dilakukan menggunakan *Google Document AI OCR* karena kinerjanya yang superior dengan bahasa Sinhala historis, dilengkapi dengan *post-processing* manual. *Post-processing* ini melibatkan koreksi karakter demi karakter pada token yang cacat, penghapusan catatan kaki dan judul halaman, standardisasi teks multi-kolom, penyisipan token akhir kalimat dan sufiks puisi, serta *anotasi* tanggal penulisan yang cermat menggunakan teks referensi historis dan masa hidup penulis.

related_work.en: The authors build upon and compare their work against numerous international diachronic corpora such as COHA, CCOHA, FarPaHC, and PROIEL, as well as the prior iteration SiDiaC-v.1.0. While prior corpora pioneered methods for historical text cleaning, part-of-speech tagging, and normalisation, SiDiaC-v.1.0 suffered from several limitations. These included an overly strict written-date filter that reduced its size to 46 books, unaddressed OCR spell-correction domain errors, mixed non-Sinhala content like Pali and Sanskrit, unhandled commentary texts spanning multiple time periods, and poor handling of poetry suffixes, multi-column layouts, and content tables.
related_work.id: Para penulis mengembangkan dan membandingkan pekerjaan mereka dengan berbagai *korpus* diakronik internasional seperti *COHA*, *CCOHA*, *FarPaHC*, dan *PROIEL*, serta iterasi sebelumnya yaitu *SiDiaC-v.1.0*. Meskipun *korpus* sebelumnya memelopori metode untuk pembersihan teks historis, penandaan *part-of-speech*, dan normalisasi, *SiDiaC-v.1.0* mengalami beberapa keterbatasan. Ini termasuk filter tanggal penulisan yang terlalu ketat yang mengurangi ukurannya menjadi 46 buku, kesalahan domain koreksi ejaan *OCR* yang tidak ditangani, konten non-Sinhala yang tercampur seperti bahasa Pali dan Sanskerta, teks komentar yang tidak ditangani yang mencakup beberapa periode waktu, serta penanganan yang buruk terhadap sufiks puisi, tata letak multi-kolom, dan tabel konten.

results.en: SiDiaC-v.2.0 contains 241,491 total words with 58,173 unique tokens across 185 books, while a date-annotated subset comprises 67,005 words across 59 documents. Genre analysis reveals a right skew towards non-fiction and religious or poetry texts, heavily influenced by Theravada Buddhism and Sanskrit kavya traditions. A bag-of-words analysis across centuries from the 13th to the 20th century successfully tracked the semantic drift and polysemy evolution of ambiguous target words like satara and maha.
results.id: *SiDiaC-v.2.0* berisi total 241.491 kata dengan 58.173 token unik di 185 buku, sementara *subset* yang beranotasi tanggal terdiri dari 67.005 kata di 59 dokumen. Analisis genre menunjukkan kecondongan ke arah teks non-fiksi dan keagamaan atau puisi, yang sangat dipengaruhi oleh agama Buddha Theravada dan tradisi *kavya* Sanskerta. Analisis *bag-of-words* lintas abad dari abad ke-13 hingga abad ke-20 berhasil melacak pergeseran semantik dan evolusi polisemi dari kata target yang ambiguer seperti *satara* dan *maha*.

tldr.en: This paper introduces SiDiaC-v.2.0, the largest comprehensive diachronic corpus for Sinhala, spanning publication dates from 1800 to 1955 CE. The resource provides rigorously filtered, cleaned, and genre-classified texts to support temporal linguistic studies in a low-resource setting.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan *SiDiaC-v.2.0*, *korpus* diakronik komprehensif terbesar untuk bahasa Sinhala yang mencakup tanggal publikasi dari tahun 1800 hingga 1955 M. Sumber daya ini menyediakan teks yang disaring, dibersihkan, dan diklasifikasikan berdasarkan genre secara ketat untuk mendukung studi linguistik temporal pada pengaturan *low-resource*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.537.title: SiDiaC-v.2.0: Sinhala Diachronic Corpus Version 2.0
acl:2026.lrec-1.537.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.54.abstract: This paper introduces the first publicly available dataset for Automatic Essay Scoring (AES) and feedback generation in Basque, targeting the CEFR C1 proficiency level. The dataset comprises 3,200 essays from HABE, each annotated by expert evaluators with criterion specific scores covering correctness, richness, coherence, cohesion, and task alignment enriched with detailed feedback and error examples. We fine-tune open-source models, including RoBERTa-EusCrawl and Latxa 8B/70B, for scoring. We focused on correctness criteria for the explanation generation, adapting Latxa to correctly predict both, scores and explanations. Our experiments show that encoder models remain highly reliable for AES, while supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Latxa significantly enhances performance, surpassing state-of-the-art (SoTA) closed-source systems such as GPT-5 and Claude Sonnet 4.5 in scoring consistency and feedback quality. We also propose a novel evaluation methodology for assessing feedback generation, combining automatic consistency metrics with expert-based validation of extracted learner errors. Results demonstrate that the fine-tuned Latxa model produces criterion-aligned, pedagogically meaningful feedback and identifies a wider range of error types than proprietary models. This resource and benchmark establish a foundation for transparent, reproducible, and educationally grounded NLP research in low-resource languages such as Basque. The dataset, models and manual evalution results are available here: https://huggingface.co/collections/EkhiAzur/habe-hitz-c1
acl:2026.lrec-1.54.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.54.title: Automatic Essay Scoring and Feedback Generation in Basque Language Learning
acl:2026.lrec-1.54.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.546.abstract: Figurative language understanding remains a significant challenge for Large Language Models (LLMs), especially for low-resource languages. To address this, we introduce the Bangla Bagdhara dataset, a large-scale, culturally grounded corpus of 10,361 Bengali idioms. Each idiom is annotated under a comprehensive 19-field schema, established and refined through a deliberative expert consensus process that captures its semantic, syntactic, cultural, and religious dimensions, providing a rich and structured resource for computational linguistics. To establish a robust benchmark for Bangla figurative language understanding, we evaluate 30 state-of-the-art multilingual and instruction-tuned LLMs on the task of inferring figurative meaning. Our results reveal a critical performance gap, with no model surpassing 50% accuracy, in stark contrast to significantly higher human performance (83.4%). This finding underscores the limitations of existing models in cross-linguistic and cultural reasoning. By releasing the Bangla Bagdhara dataset and benchmark, we provide foundational infrastructure for advancing figurative language understanding and cultural grounding in LLMs for Bengali and other low-resource languages.
acl:2026.lrec-1.546.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Ungkapan atau frasa yang maknanya tidak dapat diartikan secara harfiah dari kata-kata penyusunnya.
Metode *evaluasi* di mana *model bahasa* diberi tugas baru tanpa diberikan contoh latihan atau *fine-tuning* terlebih dahulu.
Standar atau kumpulan data pengujian yang digunakan untuk mengukur dan membandingkan kinerja berbagai *model bahasa*.
Kumpulan data teks terstruktur yang digunakan untuk penelitian linguistik dan pelatihan *model bahasa*.
Proses penambahan label atau informasi penjelas pada *data* untuk keperluan pembelajaran mesin.
Bahasa yang memiliki ketersediaan *data* digital, korpus, dan sumber daya komputasi yang sangat terbatas.
Arsitektur *neural network* di mana beberapa sub-model spesifik dilatih untuk menangani bagian *data* yang berbeda.
Model kecerdasan buatan berskala besar yang dilatih untuk memahami dan menghasilkan bahasa alami.

background.en: Figurative language understanding remains a significant challenge for large language models, particularly for low-resource languages. Although high-resource languages like English benefit from extensive corpora, South Asian languages such as Bengali remain critically underresourced. This resource scarcity prevents models from capturing the complex morphology and deep cultural nuances necessary to interpret idioms correctly.
background.id: Pemahaman bahasa kiasan tetap menjadi tantangan besar bagi *large language model*, khususnya untuk *low-resource language*. Meskipun bahasa dengan sumber daya tinggi seperti bahasa Inggris diuntungkan oleh korpus yang ekstensif, bahasa-bahasa di Asia Selatan seperti bahasa Bengali masih sangat kekurangan sumber daya. Kelangkaan sumber daya ini menghambat model untuk menangkap morfologi yang kompleks dan nuansa budaya mendalam yang diperlukan untuk menginterpretasikan idiom secara tepat.

contributions.en: The paper introduces four main contributions: the Bangla Bagdhara dataset containing 10,361 annotated Bengali idioms, a novel 19-field annotation schema capturing semantic and cultural dimensions, the first comprehensive benchmark for Bangla figurative language understanding using 30 LLMs and human baselines, and the systematic integration of cultural context as a primary annotation layer.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan empat kontribusi utama: *dataset* Bangla Bagdhara yang berisi 10.361 idiom bahasa Bengali beranotasi, skema anotasi 19 bidang baru yang menangkap dimensi semantik dan budaya, *benchmark* komprehensif pertama untuk pemahaman bahasa kiasan bahasa Bengali menggunakan 30 *LLM* dan *human baseline*, serta integrasi sistematis konteks budaya sebagai lapisan anotasi utama.

future_work.en: The authors outline several future research directions, including temporal and generational expansion for contemporary neologisms, deeper geographical and dialectical representation for underrepresented dialects like Sylheti, scaling annotation frameworks via semi-supervised methods, developing domain adaptation techniques for sentiment analysis, and expanding benchmark scope and model diversity.
future_work.id: Para penulis menguraikan beberapa arah penelitian masa depan, termasuk ekspansi temporal dan generasional untuk neologisme kontemporer, representasi geografis dan dialektikal yang lebih mendalam untuk dialek yang kurang terwakili seperti Sylheti, penskalaan kerangka kerja anotasi melalui metode *semi-supervised*, pengembangan teknik *domain adaptation* untuk analisis sentimen, serta memperluas cakupan *benchmark* dan keragaman model.

method.en: The dataset was constructed through a multi-phase protocol involving data collection from authoritative sources, AI-assisted preliminary translation using models like Gemini-2.5-flash and GPT-4o, and rigorous expert validation by a multidisciplinary team. For evaluation, a zero-shot protocol was administered on 100 culturally significant idioms tested across 30 state-of-the-art LLMs, evaluated via a 6-point rubric through a double-blind expert review and compared against a human baseline of 15 students.
method.id: Korpus dibangun melalui protokol multi-tahap yang melibatkan pengumpulan data dari sumber otoritatif, penerjemahan awal berbantuan *AI* menggunakan model seperti Gemini-2.5-flash dan GPT-4o, serta validasi ahli yang ketat oleh tim multidisiplin. Untuk evaluasi, protokol *zero-shot* diterapkan pada 100 idiom bermakna budaya yang diuji pada 30 *large language model* terkini, dinilai melalui rubrik 6 poin melalui *double-blind review* oleh ahli dan dibandingkan dengan *human baseline* dari 15 siswa.

related_work.en: Prior research on idioms has progressed along psycholinguistic and computational linguistics tracks with limited crossover. While English corpora like MAGPIE and FLUTE provide large-scale data, multilingual datasets such as LIdioms and IMIL focus primarily on cross-lingual transfer rather than monolingual depth and cultural annotation. Regional efforts like Konidioms for Konkani operate at a small scale, and previous Bengali resources lack comprehensive, large-scale idiom corpora with deep cultural metadata.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu mengenai idiom berkembang melalui jalur psikolinguistik dan komputasi linguistik dengan sedikit persilangan. Sementara korpus bahasa Inggris seperti MAGPIE dan FLUTE menyediakan data berskala besar, *dataset* multilingual seperti LIdioms dan IMIL lebih berfokus pada *cross-lingual transfer* daripada kedalaman monolingual dan anotasi budaya. Upaya regional seperti Konidioms untuk bahasa Konkani beroperasi dalam skala kecil, dan sumber daya bahasa Bengali sebelumnya masih kekurangan korpus idiom berskala besar yang komprehensif dengan *metadata* budaya yang mendalam.

results.en: The evaluation results reveal a severe performance gap, with no model surpassing the 50% accuracy threshold. The leading model, google/gemini-2.5-flash, achieved only 47.6%, while human participants averaged 83.4%. Furthermore, analysis shows high performance variance, pervasive task failure, and no correlation between model performance and size, architecture, or geographic origin, indicating a fundamental limitation in current multilingual training paradigms.
results.id: Hasil evaluasi menunjukkan kesenjangan performa yang parah, di mana tidak ada model yang melampaui ambang batas akurasi 50%. Model teratas, google/gemini-2.5-flash, hanya mencapai 47,6%, sementara peserta manusia rata-rata memperoleh 83.4%. Lebih lanjut, analisis menunjukkan variasi performa yang tinggi, tingkat kegagalan tugas yang masif, serta tidak adanya korelasi antara performa model dengan ukuran, arsitektur, atau asal geografis, yang menandakan keterbatasan mendasar pada paradigma pelatihan multilingual saat ini.

tldr.en: This paper introduces the Bangla Bagdhara dataset, a large-scale corpus of 10,361 Bengali idioms annotated with a 19-field schema for figurative language understanding. Evaluation of 30 state-of-the-art large language models reveals that no model surpasses 50% accuracy, highlighting a critical gap in cross-lingual and cultural reasoning.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan korpus Bangla Bagdhara yang berisi 10.361 idiom bahasa Bengali dengan skema 19 bidang untuk pemahaman bahasa kiasan. Evaluasi terhadap 30 *large language model* terkini menunjukkan bahwa tidak ada model yang melampaui akurasi 50%, yang menyoroti celah kritis dalam penalaran lintas bahasa dan budaya.

acl:2026.lrec-1.546.title: When Words Don’t Mean What They Say: Figurative Understanding in Bengali Idioms
acl:2026.lrec-1.546.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.555.abstract: The pervasive spread of online misinformation, often through social media and political campaigns, makes detecting false claims a crucial task for mitigating societal risks. While the vast majority of fake news datasets are developed in English, a critical gap remains for low-resource languages, such as French. To address this, we introduce Infox-QC, a novel French-language corpus focused on misinformation relevant to the Quebec region. Beyond containing real true and fake news, Infox-QC includes two unique subsets of AI-generated fake news: one created by prompting an AI to paraphrase existing fake news, and a second generated by prompting an AI to fabricate fake news from real true reports. This innovative approach allows us to verify the robustness of detection systems against fabricated content, which modern LLMs can generate with convincing efficacy. We establish comprehensive baselines using traditional machine learning methods, BERT-based models, and Large Language Models, both with and without Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Our results demonstrate that RAG-augmented LLMs offer the strongest contextual understanding, while traditional models provide valuable interpretable baselines. We further provide an exploratory human–LLM thematic agreement analysis to assess annotation consistency. The Infox-QC resource fills a critical void in French-language NLP research, supporting future efforts to explore the regional and cultural dimensions of misinformation through cross-linguistic comparison.
acl:2026.lrec-1.555.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.555.title: Infox-QC: A Quebec-Focused French Corpus for Misinformation Detection and AI Robustness Assessment
acl:2026.lrec-1.555.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.570.abstract: This paper presents a study on readability-controlled Sentence Simplification for Italian, addressing the scarcity of annotated resources for low-resource languages. We introduce IMPaCTS (Italian Multilevel Parallel Corpus for Text Simplification), the first fully automatically created corpus of 1,444,160 original–simple sentence pairs automatically annotated with readability levels and linguistic features. It was generated using an Italian LLM prompted in zero-shot to produce multiple simplifications per input sentence. Increasing portions of the resource are used to fine-tune mono- and multilingual open-weight LLMs, conditioning them to generate simplifications at a target readability level. Results from automatic and human evaluations show that fine-tuning on IMPaCTS improves performance both in terms of task completion and adherence to the targeted readability levels compared to few-shot baselines.
acl:2026.lrec-1.570.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Tugas penyederhanaan teks di mana model *large language model* dikondisikan untuk menghasilkan teks yang cocok dengan tingkat kesulitan atau parameter tertentu.
Metode statistik non-parametrik yang digunakan untuk memperkirakan fungsi densitas probabilitas dari suatu variabel acak.
Uji statistik yang memperluas analisis varians untuk menguji perbedaan rata-rata dari beberapa variabel dependen secara bersamaan.
Teknik *parameter-efficient* *fine-tuning* yang membekukan bobot model asli dan melatih matriks rank rendah yang dapat di-*train*.
Variasi dari algoritma *beam search* yang mendorong keberagaman dalam hasil teks yang dihasilkan oleh model.

background.en: Text simplification aims to rewrite documents or sentences to make them easier to read for specific target audiences such as language learners, children, or readers with cognitive difficulties. Controlled Text Simplification focuses on generating text matching a specified target difficulty level by conditioning models during training. However, progress remains heavily constrained by the scarcity of large parallel corpora explicitly annotated with reading grade levels or simplification parameters, particularly for low-resource languages like Italian.
background.id: Penyederhanaan teks bertujuan untuk menulis ulang dokumen atau kalimat agar lebih mudah dibaca oleh target audiens tertentu seperti pembelajar bahasa, anak-anak, atau pembaca dengan kesulitan kognitif. *Controlled Text Simplification* berfokus pada menghasilkan teks yang cocok dengan tingkat kesulitan target tertentu dengan mengondisikan model selama pelatihan. Namun, kemajuan masih sangat terkendala oleh kelangkaan korpus paralel besar yang dianotasi secara eksplisit dengan tingkat membaca atau parameter penyederhanaan, khususnya untuk bahasa *low-resource* seperti bahasa Italia.

contributions.en: This paper introduces IMPaCTS, the first fully automatically created Italian corpus of 1,444,160 original-simple sentence pairs featuring multiple simplifications with increasing complexity, automatically annotated with readability levels and linguistic features across Wikipedia and administrative domains. It demonstrates that fine-tuning open-weight LLMs on increasing portions of IMPaCTS improves performance over few-shot in-context learning. Furthermore, it provides evidence of alignment between human perception and readability-controlled sentence generation.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan IMPaCTS, korpus bahasa Italia pertama yang dibuat secara otomatis yang berisi 1.444.160 pasangan kalimat asli dan sederhana yang menampilkan berbagai penyederhanaan dengan kompleksitas meningkat, dianotasi secara otomatis dengan tingkat keterbacaan dan fitur linguistik di domain Wikipedia dan administratif. Penelitian ini mendemonstrasikan bahwa *fine-tuning* *large language model* *open-weight* pada bagian IMPaCTS yang semakin besar meningkatkan performa dibandingkan pembelajaran *in-context* *few-shot*. Selain itu, makalah ini memberikan bukti adanya penyelarasan antara persepsi manusia dan pembuatan kalimat yang dikontrol keterbacaannya.

future_work.en: Future work includes performing an intrinsic evaluation of IMPaCTS using human raters to assess simplification quality more directly, addressing the generation failure causes in smaller models, and expanding the approach to additional domains and control variables such as specific morphosyntactic linguistic features.
future_work.id: Pekerjaan masa depan mencakup melakukan evaluasi intrinsik terhadap IMPaCTS menggunakan penilai manusia untuk menilai kualitas penyederhanaan secara lebih langsung, mengatasi penyebab kegagalan generasi pada model yang lebih kecil, serta memperluas pendekatan ke domain tambahan dan variabel kontrol seperti fitur linguistik morfosintaksis tertentu.

method.en: The automatic generation of IMPaCTS utilized an Italian LLM prompted in zero-shot to produce multiple simplifications per input sentence using divergent beam search. Six open-weight LLMs from the Minerva and Qwen families were fine-tuned using incremental subsets ranging from 500 to 25,000 original sentences, conditioned on a control token representing READ-IT readability scores in bins of 0.05. Evaluation used automatic surface and semantic metrics including BLEU, SARI, and BERTScore, as well as RMSE and Spearman correlation for readability compliance, alongside human evaluation via Prolific.
method.id: Pembuatan otomatis IMPaCTS menggunakan *large language model* berbahasa Italia yang diprompt dalam pengaturan *zero-shot* untuk menghasilkan beberapa penyederhanaan per kalimat masukan menggunakan *divergent beam search*. Enam *large language model* *open-weight* dari keluarga Minerva dan *fine-tuning* menggunakan subset inkremental mulai dari 500 hingga 25.000 kalimat asli, yang dikondisikan pada *token* kontrol yang merepresentasikan skor keterbacaan READ-IT dalam rentang 0,05. Evaluasi menggunakan metrik otomatis permukaan dan semantik termasuk BLEU, SARI, dan BERTScore, serta RMSE dan korelasi Spearman untuk kepatuhan keterbacaan, di samping evaluasi manusia melalui Prolific.

related_work.en: Previous research has explored automatic creation of parallel resources for languages other than English, such as MUSS for English, Spanish, and French, and transformer models conditioned on CEFR levels for German. For Italian, prior work used machine translation approaches and transformer models for administrative texts, alongside evaluations of LLMs in zero-shot settings without explicit control mechanisms. However, none of the existing studies systematically investigate the amount of training data required to fine-tune LLMs for reliable controlled text simplification performance.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah mengeksplorasi pembuatan otomatis sumber daya paralel untuk bahasa selain bahasa Inggris, seperti MUSS untuk bahasa Inggris, Spanyol, dan Prancis, serta model *transformer* yang dikondisikan pada tingkat CEFR untuk bahasa Jerman. Untuk bahasa Italia, pekerjaan sebelumnya menggunakan pendekatan terjemahan mesin dan model *transformer* untuk teks administratif, di samping evaluasi *large language model* dalam pengaturan *zero-shot* tanpa mekanisme kontrol eksplisit. Namun, tidak ada studi yang ada secara sistematis menyelidiki jumlah data pelatihan yang diperlukan untuk melakukan *fine-tuning* pada *large language model* demi mencapai performa *controlled text simplification* yang andal.

results.en: Qwen models consistently outperformed Minerva and reference models on surface metrics, achieving strong performance with only 500 fine-tuning instances. Minerva models required more data to stabilize and occasionally produced empty responses, particularly on administrative texts. The best performing model, Qwen 3 7B trained on 25k instances, achieved a root mean square error of just 0.2 in READ-IT scores. Human evaluation confirmed strong alignment between automatic READ-IT scores and human perception of simplicity, yielding an accuracy and F1-score of 0.74 and a Cohen kappa of 0.48.
results.id: Model Qwen secara konsisten mengungguli model Minerva dan referensi pada metrik permukaan, mencapai performa yang kuat hanya dengan 500 instans *fine-tuning*. Model Minerva membutuhkan lebih banyak data untuk stabil dan terkadang menghasilkan respons kosong, khususnya pada teks administratif. Model dengan performa terbaik, Qwen 3 7B yang dilatih pada 25 ribu instans, mencapai *root mean square error* sebesar 0,2 pada skor READ-IT. Evaluasi manusia mengkonfirmasi penyelarasan yang kuat antara skor READ-IT otomatis dan persepsi manusia tentang kesederhanaan, menghasilkan akurasi dan skor F1 sebesar 0,74 serta *Cohen kappa* sebesar 0,48.

tldr.en: This paper introduces IMPaCTS, a large automatically generated corpus of parallel sentence pairs for readability-controlled text simplification in Italian. Experiments show that fine-tuning open-weight large language models on this resource significantly improves both task completion and adherence to target readability levels compared to few-shot baselines.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan IMPaCTS, sebuah korpus kalimat paralel yang dihasilkan secara otomatis untuk penyederhanaan teks terkontrol tingkat keterbacaan dalam bahasa Italia. Eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *fine-tuning* pada *large language model* *open-weight* menggunakan sumber daya ini secara signifikan meningkatkan penyelesaian tugas dan kepatuhan terhadap target tingkat keterbacaan dibandingkan *baseline* *few-shot*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.570.title: Controllable Sentence Simplification in Italian: Fine-Tuning Large Language Models on Automatically Generated Resources
acl:2026.lrec-1.570.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.573.abstract: Document-level text simplification involves transformations that go beyond sentence-internal edits, addressing discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in sentence-level simplification for high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich, low-resource languages such as Estonian remains largely unexplored. This study presents a comprehensive evaluation of five state-of-the-art multilingual large language models (LLMs) for document-level simplification in Estonian. Three prompting strategies are examined: single-pass generation, pipeline-based modular agents, and guideline-augmented pipelines. The evaluation framework integrates automatic metrics assessing readability, semantic preservation, and discourse coherence, alongside a structured manual annotation protocol. The findings indicate that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 produce outputs with near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation, whereas other models display notable grammatical and semantic limitations. This work contributes novel document-level coherence metrics, evidence-based prompting strategies, and publicly available resources for reproducibility.
acl:2026.lrec-1.573.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: *Anaphora resolution* adalah proses mengidentifikasi ekspresi merujuk (seperti kata ganti) ke entitas antesedennya dalam teks agar kohesi referensial tetap terjaga.
FKGL adalah metrik keterbacaan berbasis rumus tingkat kelas sekolah di Amerika Serikat yang dihitung dari panjang kalimat dan jumlah suku kata.
*BERTScore* adalah metode evaluasi otomatis yang mengukur kemiripan semantik antar-teks menggunakan *embedding* token dari model BERT.
D-SARI adalah ekstensi metrik SARI tingkat dokumen yang menilai kualitas penyederhanaan dengan memberi penghargaan pada penambahan dan penghapusan informatif.
*Pipeline-Only* adalah strategi *prompting* berurutan yang menggunakan beberapa agen khusus secara bertahap untuk menyederhanakan dokumen tanpa panduan proyek awal.
*Pipeline-Guideline* adalah strategi *prompting* yang memperluas *pipeline* modular dengan menambahkan agen *Project Director* untuk merumuskan instruksi dan batasan gaya terlebih dahulu.
*Coherence* merujuk pada kontinuitas logis dan aliran semantik antar-kalimat berdekatan yang diukur melalui kesamaan kosinus *sentence embedding*.
*Discourse marker* adalah kata atau frasa penghubung yang memandu struktur wacana dan hubungan logis antar-bagian teks.

background.en:
Text simplification aims to reduce linguistic complexity while preserving original meaning to improve access for language learners and individuals with cognitive impairments. While sentence-level simplification has been extensively studied, document-level simplification presents additional challenges such as discourse coherence, anaphora resolution, and cross-paragraph consistency. Despite advances in high-resource languages, document-level simplification in morphologically rich and low-resource languages like Estonian remains largely unexplored.

This study addresses this gap by comprehensively evaluating state-of-the-art multilingual large language models on Estonian Wikipedia articles. The research investigates which models are most effective out-of-the-box and whether automatic metrics alone can reliably identify top-performing systems.
background.id:
Penyederhanaan teks bertujuan untuk mengurangi kompleksitas linguistik sambil mempertahankan makna asli guna meningkatkan akses bagi pembelajar bahasa dan individu dengan gangguan kognitif. Meskipun penyederhanaan tingkat kalimat telah banyak diteliti, penyederhanaan tingkat dokumen menghadirkan tantangan tambahan seperti koherensi wacana, resolusi anafora, dan konsistensi antar-paragraf. Terlepas dari kemajuan pada bahasa sumber daya tinggi, penyederhanaan tingkat dokumen pada bahasa yang kaya morfologi dan sumber daya rendah seperti bahasa Estonia sebagian besar masih belum dieksplorasi.

Studi ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan mengevaluasi secara komprehensif *large language model* multilingual mutakhir pada artikel Wikipedia bahasa Estonia. Penelitian ini menyelidiki model mana yang paling efektif secara *out-of-the-box* dan apakah metrik otomatis saja dapat secara andal mengidentifikasi sistem berkinerja terbaik.

contributions.en:
This work makes three primary contributions to document-level text simplification in low-resource settings. First, it develops and tests document-level prompting strategies tailored for Estonian using multilingual large language models, encompassing single-pass, pipeline-only, and guideline-augmented pipelines.

Second, it introduces automatic coherence metrics based on sentence similarity and discourse marker preservation. Third, it designs a structured manual evaluation protocol capturing fluency, grammaticality, meaning preservation, and discourse-level coherence, accompanied by publicly available resources for reproducibility.
contributions.id:
Karya ini memberikan tiga kontribusi utama pada penyederhanaan teks tingkat dokumen dalam pengaturan sumber daya rendah. Pertama, penelitian ini mengembangkan dan menguji strategi *prompting* tingkat dokumen yang disesuaikan untuk bahasa Estonia menggunakan *large language model* multilingual, yang mencakup *pipeline* satu kali *pass*, berbasis *pipeline-only*, dan *guideline-augmented*.

Kedua, penelitian ini memperkenalkan metrik koherensi otomatis berdasarkan kemiripan kalimat dan preservasi penanda wacana. Ketiga, penelitian ini merancang protokol evaluasi manual terstruktur yang menangkap kefasihan, gramatikalitas, preservasi makna, dan koherensi tingkat wacana, disertai dengan sumber daya yang tersedia untuk umum demi reproduksibilitas.

future_work.en: The authors note several limitations, including the small manual evaluation dataset constraining statistical conclusions, the restriction to Wikipedia articles which may not reflect other text genres like health or public service information, and the out-of-the-box API evaluation setting which leaves domain-specific fine-tuning unexplored. Additionally, the proposed discourse-aware automatic metrics do not fully capture global discourse structure, factual consistency, or the appropriateness of content additions and deletions.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat beberapa keterbatasan, termasuk kecilnya dataset evaluasi manual yang membatasi kesimpulan statistik, pembatasan pada artikel Wikipedia yang mungkin tidak mencerminkan genre teks lain seperti informasi kesehatan atau layanan publik, serta pengaturan evaluasi API *out-of-the-box* yang membuat *fine-tuning* spesifik domain belum dieksplorasi. Selain itu, metrik otomatis sadar wacana yang diusulkan tidak sepenuhnya menangkap struktur wacana global, konsistensi faktual, atau ketepatan penambahan dan penghapusan konten.

method.en:
The evaluation dataset consists of 15 articles randomly selected from a filtered 4,000-article sample of Estonian Wikipedia, constrained to lengths between 50 and 250 words. Five instruction-tuned models were evaluated: GPT-4.1, LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.0-flash-001, and Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct, accessed via the OpenRouter API with standard temperature and top-p settings.

Three prompting strategies were implemented: Single-Pass Prompting, Pipeline-Only involving specialized modular agents for terminology, structure, and anaphora, and Pipeline-Guideline adding an initial Project Director agent. Evaluation combined automatic surface-level metrics (FKGL, BERTScore, D-SARI), custom discourse-level metrics (sentence-embedding cosine similarity and discourse marker preservation), and a manual annotation protocol evaluated by two native Estonian linguists using a 5-point Likert scale.
method.id:
Dataset evaluasi terdiri dari 15 artikel yang dipilih secara acak dari sampel 4.000 artikel Wikipedia bahasa Estonia yang telah difilter, dibatasi pada panjang antara 50 hingga 250 kata. Lima model yang disetel instruksinya dievaluasi: GPT-4.1, LLaMA-3.3-70B-Instruct, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.0-flash-001, dan Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct, diakses melalui API OpenRouter dengan pengaturan suhu dan *top-p* standar.

Tiga strategi *prompting* diterapkan: *Single-Pass Prompting*, *Pipeline-Only* yang melibatkan agen modular khusus untuk terminologi, struktur, dan anafora, serta *Pipeline-Guideline* yang menambahkan agen *Project Director* awal. Evaluasi menggabungkan metrik tingkat permukaan otomatis (FKGL, BERTScore, D-SARI), metrik tingkat wacana kustom (kemiripan kosinus *sentence embedding* dan preservasi penanda wacana), serta protokol anotasi manual yang dievaluasi oleh dua linguis penutur asli bahasa Estonia menggunakan skala Likert 5 poin.

related_work.en:
Automatic text simplification has evolved from handcrafted rule-based systems to sequence-to-sequence neural architectures, reinforcement learning, and pretrained Transformer models like T5 and GPT variants. While sentence-level simplification dominates the literature, document-level datasets and metrics such as D-Wikipedia and D-SARI emphasize discourse structure preservation, and recent frameworks like SimDoc incorporate readability and coherence objectives during training.

For low-resource settings, multilingual benchmarks like MultiSim demonstrate cross-lingual transfer benefits, though Estonian has been excluded. Existing work on Estonian has focused strictly on sentence-level transformations using rule-based and NMT approaches, highlighting the need for systematic document-level evaluation and advanced prompting strategies.
related_work.id:
Penyederhanaan teks otomatis telah berkembang dari sistem berbasis aturan buatan tangan ke arsitektur neural *sequence-to-sequence*, *reinforcement learning*, dan model Transformer praterlatih seperti varian T5 dan GPT. Meskipun penyederhanaan tingkat kalimat mendominasi literatur, dataset dan metrik tingkat dokumen seperti D-Wikipedia dan D-SARI menekankan preservasi struktur wacana, dan kerangka kerja terbaru seperti SimDoc memasukkan tujuan keterbacaan dan koherensi selama pelatihan.

Untuk pengaturan sumber daya rendah, *benchmark* multilingual seperti MultiSim mendemonstrasikan manfaat transfer lintas bahasa, meskipun bahasa Estonia telah dikecualikan. Pekerjaan yang ada pada bahasa Estonia berfokus secara ketat pada transformasi tingkat kalimat menggunakan pendekatan berbasis aturan dan NMT, yang menyoroti perlunya evaluasi tingkat dokumen yang sistematis dan strategi *prompting* tingkat lanjut.

results.en:
Automatic evaluation revealed that single-pass prompting achieved higher textual simplicity via lower FKGL scores but sacrificed semantic similarity, whereas pipeline strategies improved BERT-S and D-SARI values. Among models, GPT-4.1 and LLaMA-3.3 achieved the highest coherence scores, while Gemini-2.0 excelled in discourse marker preservation.

In manual evaluation focusing on the Pipeline-Only approach, Gemini-2.0 achieved the highest average score (4.79), closely followed by LLaMA-3.3 (4.17), both demonstrating near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation. Conversely, Qwen-2.5 performed poorly (1.75) due to frequent grammatical errors, hallucinations, and meaning distortions, indicating that multilingual model size does not guarantee robust performance in low-resource languages.
results.id:
Evaluasi otomatis mengungkapkan bahwa *prompting* satu kali *pass* mencapai kesederhanaan teks yang lebih tinggi melalui skor FKGL yang lebih rendah tetapi mengorbankan kemiripan semantik, sedangkan strategi *pipeline* meningkatkan nilai BERT-S dan D-SARI. Di antara model, GPT-4.1 dan LLaMA-3.3 mencapai skor koherensi tertinggi, sementara Gemini-2.0 unggul dalam preservasi penanda wacana.

Dalam evaluasi manual yang berfokus pada pendekatan *Pipeline-Only*, Gemini-2.0 mencapai skor rata-rata tertinggi (4.79), diikuti erat oleh LLaMA-3.3 (4.17), keduanya menunjukkan kefasihan mendekati penutur asli dan preservasi makna yang kuat. Sebaliknya, Qwen-2.5 berkinerja buruk (1.75) karena seringnya kesalahan gramatikal, *hallucination*, dan distorsi makna, yang mengindikasikan bahwa ukuran model multilingual tidak menjamin kinerja yang tangguh pada bahasa sumber daya rendah.

tldr.en: This paper evaluates five multilingual large language models on document-level text simplification in Estonian across three prompting strategies. The findings show that Gemini-2.0 and LLaMA-3.3 achieve near-native fluency and strong meaning preservation.
tldr.id: Paper ini mengevaluasi lima *large language model* multilingual pada penyederhanaan teks tingkat dokumen dalam bahasa Estonia menggunakan tiga strategi *prompting*. Temuan menunjukkan bahwa Gemini-2.0 dan LLaMA-3.3 mencapai kefasihan mendekati penutur asli serta preservasi makna yang kuat.

acl:2026.lrec-1.573.title: Document-Level Text Simplification in Estonian Using Large Language Models
acl:2026.lrec-1.573.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.580.abstract: This paper examines the specific obstacles of constructing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems in low resource languages, with a focus on Persian’s complicated morphology and versatile syntax. The research aims to improve retrieval and generation accuracy by introducing Persian-specific models, namely MatinaRoberta (a masked language model) and MatinaSRoberta (a fine-tuned Sentence-BERT), along with a comprehensive benchmarking framework. Three datasets—general knowledge (PQuad), scientifically specialized texts, and organizational reports—were used to assess these models after they were trained on a varied corpus of 73.11 billion Persian tokens. The methodology involved extensive pretraining, fine-tuning with tailored loss functions, and systematic evaluations using both traditional metrics and the Retrieval-Augmented Generation Assessment (RAGAS) framework. The results show that MatinaSRoberta outperformed previous embeddings, achieving superior contextual relevance and retrieval accuracy across datasets. Temperature tweaking, chunk size modifications, and document summary indexing were explored to enhance RAG setups. Larger models like Llama-3.1 (70B) consistently demonstrated the highest generation accuracy, while smaller models faced challenges with domain-specific and formal contexts. The findings underscore the potential for developing RAG systems in Persian through customized embeddings and retrieval-generation settings and highlight the enhancement of NLP applications such as search engines and legal document analysis in low-resource languages.
acl:2026.lrec-1.580.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.580.title: Advancing Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Persian: Development of Language Models, Comprehensive Benchmarks, and Best Practices for Optimization
acl:2026.lrec-1.580.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.598.abstract: Crawling national top-level domains has proven to be highly effective for collecting texts in less-resourced languages. This approach has been recently used for South Slavic languages and resulted in the largest general corpora for this language group: the CLASSLA-web 1.0 corpora. Building on this success, we established a continuous crawling infrastructure for iterative national top-level domain crawling across South Slavic and related webs. We present the first outcome of this crawling infrastructure - the CLASSLA-web 2.0 corpus collection, with substantially larger web corpora containing 17.0 billion words in 38.1 million texts in seven languages: Bosnian, Bulgarian, Croatian, Macedonian, Montenegrin, Serbian, and Slovenian. In addition to genre categories, the new version is also automatically annotated with topic labels. Comparing CLASSLA-web 2.0 with its predecessor reveals that only one-fifth of the texts overlap, showing that re-crawling after just two years yields largely new content. However, while the new web crawls bring growing gains, we also notice growing pains - a manual inspection of top domains reveals a visible degradation of web content, as machine-generated sites now contribute a significant portion of texts.
acl:2026.lrec-1.598.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.598.title: The Growing Gains and Pains of Iterative Web Corpora Crawling: Insights from South Slavic CLASSLA-web 2.0 Corpora
acl:2026.lrec-1.598.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.601.abstract: Event trigger detection and classification aim to identify and categorize events within unstructured text. While prior research has primarily focused on news or biomedical corpora, the literary domain, especially short stories, remains largely underexplored. This gap is particularly pronounced for low-resource languages such as Assamese, where limited annotated data and complex narrative structures hinder progress. To address this challenge, we introduce Vrittanta-AS, a manually curated Assamese event trigger detection and classification dataset comprising 13,171 annotated events extracted from short stories. The dataset is designed to advance research in information extraction and narrative understanding for low-resource Indian languages. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation using classical machine learning methods, neural sequential architectures, pre-trained transformer models, and large language models (LLMs) on the proposed dataset. Experimental results demonstrate that IndicBERT v2 achieves the highest performance for both event trigger detection (85.86% micro-F1) and classification (65.21% macro-F1). Vrittanta-AS serves as an important step toward developing benchmark resources for event trigger detection and classification in Assamese literary text.
acl:2026.lrec-1.601.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.601.title: Vrittanta-AS: Dataset Development and Benchmarking for Event Trigger Detection and Classification in Assamese
acl:2026.lrec-1.601.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.607.abstract: Named entity recognition (NER), particularly fine-grained NER (FgNER), extracts domain-specific entity information for Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications such as knowledge base construction and relation extraction. While manual annotation for creating relevant data is expensive, distant supervision often produces noisy data. Moreover, resources for coarse-grained and fine-grained NER in Indian languages, particularly in the vulnerable languages of India’s North Eastern Region, remain scarce. This work aims at creating such a resource for three vulnerable languages: Bodo/Boro (brx), Manipuri/Meitei (mni), and Mizo/Lushai (lus), which are regarded as official languages in three Indian states and spoken by more than six million people across five countries in South and Southeast Asia. We use annotations projection from high-resource FgNER datasets using source-to-target parallel corpora and a projection tool built on a multilingual encoder. The dataset comprises over 198k sentences, 282k entities, and 2.8M tokens in each low-resource language. Our thorough analyses validate the dataset’s high quality. We further explore zero-shot and cross-lingual settings, examining the impact of script similarity and multilingualism in cross-lingual FgNER performance. The dataset, expert detector models, the agentic tool, and the interactive web application are available as open-source resources at: https://hf.co/collections/prachuryyaIITG/finerviner.
acl:2026.lrec-1.607.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Proyeksi anotasi adalah teknik mentransfer label dari satu bahasa sumber ke bahasa target melalui *parallel corpora* dan *word alignment*.
Zero-shot adalah kondisi pengujian model pada bahasa atau tugas yang belum pernah dilihat atau dilatih secara langsung sebelumnya.
Fine-grained named entity recognition adalah tugas pengenalan entitas bernama yang mengklasifikasikan entitas ke dalam kategori yang jauh lebih spesifik dan terperinci.
Token adalah unit teks terkecil, seperti kata atau bagian kata, yang diproses oleh *tokenizer* dalam *model bahasa*.
Inter-annotator agreement adalah ukuran statistik yang menunjukkan tingkat kesepahaman antara beberapa pemberi anotasi manusia pada data yang sama.

background.en: Named Entity Recognition, particularly Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition, is crucial for extracting domain-specific information for NLP applications. However, manual annotation is expensive and distant supervision produces noisy data, while resources for Indian languages, especially vulnerable languages in India's North Eastern Region, remain extremely scarce.
background.id: *Named entity recognition*, khususnya *fine-grained named entity recognition*, sangat penting untuk mengekstrak informasi spesifik domain guna keperluan aplikasi *natural language processing*. Namun, anotasi manual sangat mahal dan *distant supervision* menghasilkan data yang bising, sementara sumber daya untuk bahasa-bahasa di India, terutama bahasa-bahasa rentan di Wilayah Timur Laut India, masih sangat langka.

contributions.en: The main contributions include the creation of FiNERVINER, a large-scale fine-grained named entity recognition dataset comprising over 198k sentences, 282k entities, and 2.8M tokens for Bodo, Manipuri, and Mizo. Additionally, the authors provide high-quality human-annotated test sets with high inter-annotator agreement and present thorough analyses on zero-shot and cross-lingual settings.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama mencakup pembuatan FiNERVINER, sebuah dataset *fine-grained named entity recognition* berskala besar yang terdiri dari lebih dari 198k kalimat, 282k entitas, dan 2,8M *token* untuk bahasa Bodo, Manipuri, dan Mizo. Selain itu, para penulis menyediakan *test set* beranotasi manusia berkualitas tinggi dengan *inter-annotator agreement* yang tinggi serta menyajikan analisis menyeluruh mengenai pengaturan *zero-shot* dan lintas bahasa.

future_work.en: The authors acknowledge limitations such as the dependency of the generated dataset on the characteristics and biases of the source dataset. Future research directions include investigating the impact of different combinations of parallel corpora, projection tools, and multilingual encoders, as well as conducting a comprehensive evaluation of large language models on the fine-grained named entity recognition task.
future_work.id: Para penulis mengakui adanya keterbatasan seperti ketergantungan dataset yang dihasilkan pada karakteristik dan bias dari dataset sumber. Arah penelitian masa depan mencakup investigasi dampak dari berbagai kombinasi *parallel corpora*, perangkat proyeksi, dan *multilingual encoder*, serta melakukan evaluasi komprehensif terhadap *large language model* pada tugas *fine-grained named entity recognition*.

method.en: The dataset is constructed by projecting English MultiCoNER2 annotations onto the target languages using parallel corpora, a multilingual encoder, and an annotation projection and word alignment tool called AWESoME align. Various pre-trained language models, including mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, MuRIL, IndicBERTv2, and MizBERT, are fine-tuned on the dataset and evaluated using SeqEval metrics.
method.id: Dataset ini dibangun dengan memproyeksikan anotasi MultiCoNER2 bahasa Inggris ke bahasa target menggunakan *parallel corpora*, *multilingual encoder*, serta alat proyeksi anotasi dan *word alignment* bernama AWESoME align. Berbagai *pre-trained language model*, termasuk mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, MuRIL, IndicBERTv2, dan MizBERT, di-*fine-tune* pada dataset tersebut dan dievaluasi menggunakan metrik SeqEval.

related_work.en: Prior research has introduced various fine-grained datasets and entity typing hierarchies, but resources for low-resource Indian languages remain limited. While annotation projection methods have been applied to tasks like dependency parsing and relation extraction using parallel corpora and word alignment, comprehensive high-quality fine-grained datasets are lacking for vulnerable languages.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah memperkenalkan berbagai dataset *fine-grained* dan hierarki *entity typing*, namun sumber daya untuk bahasa-bahasa *low-resource* di India masih terbatas. Meskipun metode proyeksi anotasi telah diterapkan pada tugas seperti *dependency parsing* dan *relation extraction* menggunakan *parallel corpora* dan *word alignment*, dataset *fine-grained* berkualitas tinggi yang komprehensif masih kurang untuk bahasa-bahasa rentan.

results.en: Experiments show that models fine-tuned on FiNERVINER achieve strong performance, with language-specific encoders like IndicBERTv2 and MizBERT performing best on their respective target languages. Cross-lingual analyses reveal that script similarity significantly boosts zero-shot transfer performance, and balanced multilingual training further improves overall accuracy.
results.id: Eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa model yang di-*fine-tune* pada FiNERVINER mencapai performa yang kuat, dengan *encoder* khusus bahasa seperti IndicBERTv2 dan MizBERT berperformam paling baik pada bahasa target masing-masing. Analisis lintas bahasa mengungkapkan bahwa kesamaan skrip secara signifikan meningkatkan performa transfer *zero-shot*, dan pelatihan multibahasa yang seimbang semakin meningkatkan akurasi secara keseluruhan.

tldr.en: This paper introduces FiNERVINER, a large-scale fine-grained named entity recognition dataset for three vulnerable Indian languages using annotation projection. The results demonstrate high data quality and provide valuable insights into cross-lingual zero-shot performance and script similarity.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan FiNERVINER, sebuah dataset *fine-grained named entity recognition* berskala besar untuk tiga bahasa rentan di India menggunakan proyeksi anotasi. Hasil eksperimen menunjukkan kualitas data yang tinggi dan memberikan wawasan berharga tentang performa *zero-shot* lintas bahasa serta kesamaan skrip.

acl:2026.lrec-1.607.title: FiNERVINER: Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition for Vulnerable Languages of India’s North Eastern Region
acl:2026.lrec-1.607.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.608.abstract: We present APTFiNER, a novel fine-grained named entity recognition (FgNER) dataset covering six low-resource Indian languages spoken by over 400 million people across various nations. While creating FgNER resources through manual annotation is typically expensive and labor-intensive, distant supervision has emerged as a workable alternative. Yet, such FgNER datasets are often noisy, as each entity mentions are often assigned multiple entity types, which necessitates computationally demanding noise-aware models. Furthermore, resources for both coarse-grained and fine-grained NER tasks remain scarce for low-resource languages. To overcome this scarcity, we utilized the superior reasoning and translation capability of Gemini through the proposed annotation-preserving translation method and created a large-scale FgNER dataset comprising over 411 thousand sentences, 697 thousand entity mentions, and 5.8 million tokens in total. We translated the MultiCoNER2 English FgNER dataset to the target languages: Assamese (as), Marathi (mr), Nepali (ne), Tamil (ta), Telugu (te), and a vulnerable language, Bodo (brx). Through rigorous analyses and human evaluations, the effectiveness of our method and the high quality of the resulting dataset are ascertained with F1 score improvements of 8% in both Tamil and Telugu, and 25% in Marathi over the current state-of-the-art. The dataset, expert detector models, the agentic tool, and the interactive web application are available as open-source resources at: https://hf.co/collections/prachuryyaIITG/aptfiner.
acl:2026.lrec-1.608.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.608.title: APTFiNER: Annotation Preserving Translation for Fine-grained Named Entity Recognition
acl:2026.lrec-1.608.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.612.abstract: We present judgeWEL, a dataset for named entity recognition (NER) in Luxembourgish, automatically labelled and subsequently verified using large language models (LLM) in a novel pipeline. Building datasets for under-represented languages remains one of the major bottlenecks in natural language processing, where the scarcity of resources and linguistic particularities make large-scale annotation costly and potentially inconsistent. To address these challenges, we propose and evaluate a novel approach that leverages Wikipedia and Wikidata as structured sources of weak supervision. By exploiting internal links within Wikipedia articles, we infer entity types based on their corresponding Wikidata entries, thereby generating initial annotations with minimal human intervention. Because such links are not uniformly reliable, we mitigate noise by employing and comparing several LLMs to identify and retain only high-quality labelled sentences. The resulting corpus is approximately five times larger than the currently available Luxembourgish NER dataset and offers broader and more balanced coverage across entity categories, providing a substantial new resource for multilingual and low-resource NER research.
acl:2026.lrec-1.612.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Distant supervision adalah metode pelabelan data otomatis dengan mencocokkan teks dengan basis pengetahuan eksternal.
BIO adalah skema pengkodean batas entitas yang membedakan awal, bagian dalam, dan luar dari suatu entitas bernama.
Gazetteers adalah daftar kamus atau direktori nama tempat dan entitas yang digunakan dalam ekstraksi informasi.
Cross-lingual knowledge transfer adalah teknik mentransfer representasi bahasa dari bahasa sumber ke bahasa target yang kekurangan data.
Entity linking adalah proses mengaitkan penyebutan entitas dalam teks dengan entitas unik yang sesuai dalam basis pengetahuan.
Open-weight merujuk pada model *machine learning* yang bobot parameternya dirilis secara publik agar dapat diinspeksi dan digunakan.
Seqeval adalah pustaka *Python* yang umum digunakan untuk evaluasi tugas *sequence labelling* seperti NER.
Stratified sampling adalah teknik pengambilan sampel di mana populasi dibagi menjadi subkelompok untuk memastikan representasi yang seimbang.

background.en: Building datasets for under-represented languages remains a major bottleneck in natural language processing due to resource scarcity and linguistic particularities that make large-scale annotation costly and inconsistent. Luxembourgish, despite being a national language of an EU member state, suffers from a severe lack of standardised resources and labelled corpora for tasks such as sequence labelling, compounded by its structural ties to German and French and frequent code-switching.
background.id: Pembangunan *dataset* untuk bahasa yang kurang terwakili tetap menjadi kendala utama dalam pemrosesan bahasa alami karena kelangkaan sumber daya dan keunikan linguistik yang membuat anotasi berskala besar menjadi mahal dan tidak konsisten. Bahasa Luksemburg, meskipun merupakan bahasa nasional negara anggota Uni Eropa, mengalami kekurangan parah dalam sumber daya terstandarisasi dan korpus beranotasi untuk tugas seperti *sequence labelling*, yang diperburuk oleh hubungan strukturalnya dengan bahasa Jerman dan Prancis serta *code-switching* yang sering terjadi.

contributions.en: The paper introduces an open pipeline for automatically constructing annotated NER datasets using Wikipedia, Wikidata, and large language model judgments. It delivers judgeWEL, a new Luxembourgish NER dataset consisting of 28,866 sentences across five entity types, which is approximately five times larger than the existing benchmark and provides more balanced coverage.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan sebuah *pipeline* terbuka untuk secara otomatis membangun *dataset* NER beranotasi menggunakan Wikipedia, Wikidata, dan penilaian *large language model*. Penulis menghadirkan judgeWEL, *dataset* NER bahasa Luksemburg baru yang terdiri dari 28.866 kalimat di lima jenis entitas, yang berukuran sekitar lima kali lebih besar daripada *benchmark* yang ada dan menyediakan cakupan yang lebih seimbang.

future_work.en: The authors note that fully automating label generation through large language model remains premature due to systematic inconsistencies in producing entity labels from scratch. Future work includes extending the methodology to other under-represented languages, refining label granularity for additional entity subtypes and relational information, and incorporating limited human-in-the-loop validation.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat bahwa otomatisasi penuh pembuatan label melalui *large language model* masih terlalu dini karena adanya inkonsistensi sistematis dalam menghasilkan label entitas dari awal. Pekerjaan di masa mendatang mencakup memperluas metodologi ke bahasa lain yang kurang terwakili, menyempurnakan granularitas label untuk subtipe entitas tambahan dan informasi relasional, serta memasukkan validasi *human-in-the-loop* yang terbatas.

method.en: The authors extract articles from the Luxembourgish Wikipedia and link internal hyperlinks to Wikidata entities to generate initial BIO tags for persons, organisations, locations, and dates. After a candidate sentence selection process and automatic annotation improvements via a fine-tuned model, several large language model judges are evaluated to filter out inconsistent annotations and retain high-quality sentences. The resulting dataset is split into training, development, and test sets to benchmark various encoder and generative models.
method.id: Para penulis mengekstrak artikel dari Wikipedia bahasa Luksemburg dan menautkan *hyperlink* internal ke entitas Wikidata untuk menghasilkan label BIO awal untuk *person*, *organisation*, *location*, dan *date*. Setelah proses pemilihan kalimat kandidat dan peningkatan anotasi otomatis melalui *fine-tuned model*, beberapa *large language model* dievaluasi sebagai *judge* untuk menyaring anotasi yang tidak konsisten dan mempertahankan kalimat berkualitas tinggi. *Dataset* yang dihasilkan dibagi menjadi data *training*, *development*, dan *test* untuk menguji berbagai *encoder* dan *generative model*.

related_work.en: Prior research in named entity recognition spans early rule-based systems and gazetteers to recent generative and large language model approaches, including zero-shot NER and prompt engineering. For low-resource languages, techniques such as cross-lingual knowledge transfer, translation of existing data, and synthetic data generation via prompting have been explored. However, these methods often struggle with token-level alignment or require substantial manual oversight.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya dalam *named entity recognition* mencakup sistem berbasis aturan awal dan *gazetteer* hingga pendekatan *generative* dan *large language model* terkini, termasuk *zero-shot* NER dan *prompt engineering*. Untuk bahasa *low-resource*, teknik seperti *cross-lingual knowledge transfer*, penerjemahan data yang ada, dan pembuatan data sintetis melalui *prompting* telah dieksplorasi. Namun, metode-metode ini sering kali mengalami kesulitan dalam *token-level alignment* atau memerlukan pengawasan manual yang substansial.

results.en: Experiments show that proprietary models like GPT-5-mini and GPT-5 achieve high agreement with human annotators with a Cohen kappa of 0.62, approaching human inter-annotator agreement. When training encoder models like mBERT, XLM-RoBERTa, and LuxemBERT on judgeWEL, they achieve strong F1-scores above 0.90, and models trained on judgeWEL transfer effectively to existing human-labelled benchmarks.
results.id: Eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *proprietary model* seperti GPT-5-mini dan GPT-5 mencapai tingkat kesesuaian yang tinggi dengan penasihat manusia dengan nilai *Cohen kappa* 0.62, mendekati kesepakatan antar-anotator manusia. Saat melatih *encoder model* seperti *mBERT*, *XLM-RoBERTa*, dan *LuxemBERT* pada judgeWEL, mereka mencapai skor F1 yang kuat di atas 0.90, dan model yang dilatih pada judgeWEL dapat ditransfer secara efektif ke *benchmark* beranotasi manusia yang sudah ada.

tldr.en: This paper presents judgeWEL, a new dataset for named entity recognition in Luxembourgish, constructed using a novel distant supervision pipeline verified by large language models. The results show that proprietary models can effectively judge annotation quality, yielding a high-quality corpus five times larger than existing resources.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan judgeWEL, sebuah *dataset* baru untuk *named entity recognition* dalam bahasa Luksemburg, yang dibangun menggunakan *pipeline* *distant supervision* baru yang diverifikasi oleh *large language model*. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *proprietary model* dapat menilai kualitas anotasi secara efektif, menghasilkan korpus berkualitas tinggi yang lima kali lebih besar daripada sumber daya yang ada.

acl:2026.lrec-1.612.title: Do LLMs Judge Distantly Supervised Named Entity Labels Well? Constructing the JudgeWEL Dataset
acl:2026.lrec-1.612.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.627.abstract: DBpedia is a community-driven project that extracts structured knowledge from Wikipedia via language-specific chapters. We present the first steps toward the Amharic DBpedia chapter by extending the DBpedia Extraction Framework (DEF) to support Amharic Wikipedia, including language-specific components such as Ethiopian date parsers, an Ethiopian–Gregorian calendar converter, an Arabic–Ge’ez number converter, and Amharic template mappings, together with automated extraction pipelines and the publication of the resulting knowledge graph through a live website, DBpedia Databus collection, and query endpoints. For mapping, we evaluate the zero-shot NLLB-200 translation model on Amharic infobox property names, achieving a BLEU score of 45.31.
