The gloss sequences of the spoken Bangla sentences are made up of individual glosses which are Bangla sign supported words and serve as an intermediate representation for a continuous sign. Our dataset consists of 1000 high quality Bangla sentences that are manually annotated into a gloss sequence by a professional signer. The augmentation process incorporates rule-based linguistic strategies and prompt engineering techniques that we have adopted by critically analyzing our human annotated sentence-gloss pairs and by working closely with our professional signer. Furthermore, we fine-tune several transformer-based models such as mBart50, Google mT5, GPT4.1-nano and evaluate their sentence-to-gloss translation performance using BLEU scores, based on these evaluation metrics we compare the model’s gloss-translation consistency across our dataset and the RWTH-PHOENIX-2014T benchmark.
acl:2026.lrec-1.820.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.820.title: Introducing a Bangla Sentence – Gloss Pair Dataset for Bangla Sign Language Translation and Research
acl:2026.lrec-1.820.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.822.abstract: Transformer-based language models have revolutionized NLP, yet their adaptation to morphologically rich and dialectally diverse languages such as Arabic remains non-trivial. We introduce ModernAraBERT, a resource-efficient adaptation of the English-pretrained ModernBERT for Arabic, employing continued pretraining on large Arabic corpora followed by lightweight head-only fine-tuning with a frozen encoder. This strategy retains cross-lingual knowledge while capturing Arabic morphology and orthographic variation, offering a scalable alternative to training monolingual models from scratch. We evaluate ModernAraBERT on three representative Arabic NLP tasks, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and extractive question answering, against strong Arabic-specific and multilingual baselines (AraBERTv1, AraBERTv2, MARBERT, mBERT). Across all tasks, ModernAraBERT achieves consistent and often substantial improvements, particularly for sentence and token-level understanding, demonstrating that modern English encoder architectures can be efficiently transferred to Arabic through language-adaptive pretraining. Beyond Arabic, our findings highlight a generalizable paradigm for extending state-of-the-art models to morphologically complex and underrepresented languages with reduced computational overhead.
acl:2026.lrec-1.822.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Proses melanjutkan pelatihan *model bahasa* pada korpus bahasa baru untuk mentransfer pengetahuan.
*Encoder* yang parameternya dikunci selama tahap *fine-tuning* agar tidak mengalami perubahan.
Tugas *NLP* di mana model harus mengekstrak jawaban langsung berupa teks dari dokumen konteks.
Tugas *NLP* untuk mengidentifikasi dan mengklasifikasikan entitas bernama seperti nama orang, lokasi, atau organisasi.
Metode memecah kata menjadi unit subkata untuk memperluas cakupan kosakata pada *tokenizer*.
Metode penyematan posisi yang mengenalkan informasi urutan token melalui transformasi rotasi pada vektor.

background.en: Adapting transformer-based language models to morphologically rich and dialectally diverse languages like Arabic remains a central challenge in natural language processing. Arabic features complex morphology, extensive affixation, orthographic variation, and widespread syntactic and lexical differences between Modern Standard Arabic and regional dialects. Direct transfer from English models is difficult, while training models from scratch requires immense computational resources and large data investments, creating a need for efficient cross-lingual adaptation strategies.
background.id: Adaptasi model bahasa berbasis *transformer* untuk bahasa yang kaya morfologi dan beragam dialek seperti Arab masih menjadi tantangan utama dalam pemrosesan bahasa alami. Bahasa Arab memiliki morfologi yang kompleks, afiksasi ekstensif, variasi ortografi, serta perbedaan sintaksis dan leksikal yang luas antara bahasa Arab Standar Modern dan berbagai dialek regional. Transfer langsung dari model bahasa Inggris sangatlah sulit, sementara melatih model dari awal membutuhkan sumber daya komputasi yang besar dan investasi data yang masif, sehingga muncul kebutuhan akan strategi adaptasi lintas bahasa yang efisien.

contributions.en: The paper presents ModernAraBERT, the first adaptation of the ModernBERT architecture to Arabic using continued pretraining and frozen-head fine-tuning. It provides a comprehensive comparative evaluation across sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and extractive question answering against strong baselines. The study analyzes the computational efficiency, resource utilization, and VRAM trade-offs of head training, and discusses tokenizer-level effects regarding the Byte-Level BPE tokenizer of ModernBERT on Arabic span-extraction performance.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyajikan ModernAraBERT, yaitu adaptasi pertama dari arsitektur ModernBERT ke bahasa Arab menggunakan *continued pretraining* dan *fine-tuning* dengan *frozen head*. Makalah ini menyediakan evaluasi komparatif yang komprehensif pada analisis sentimen, pengenalan entitas bernama, dan tanya jawab ekstraktif terhadap *baseline* yang kuat. Studi ini menganalisis efisiensi komputasi, pemanfaatan sumber daya, dan pertukaran *VRAM* dari pelatihan *head*, serta mendiskusikan efek tingkat *tokenizer* terkait *Byte-Level BPE tokenizer* pada performa ekstraksi rentang bahasa Arab.

future_work.en: The authors note that the full pretraining followed by head-only fine-tuning design limits deeper task-specific optimization of the encoder. They also point out that the inherited Byte-BPE tokenizer can underperform on extractive QA tasks compared to WordPiece or SentencePiece tokenizers due to unstable span boundaries. Future work will explore morphology-aware tokenization, selective layer fine-tuning, broader downstream applications, and dialectal datasets.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat bahwa desain *full pretraining* yang diikuti oleh *head-only fine-tuning* membatasi optimisasi spesifik tugas yang lebih mendalam pada *encoder*. Mereka juga menunjukkan bahwa *Byte-BPE tokenizer* bawaan dapat memiliki performa lebih rendah pada tugas *QA* ekstraktif dibandingkan *tokenizer* WordPiece atau SentencePiece karena batas rentang yang tidak stabil. Pekerjaan masa depan akan mengeksplorasi *tokenization* yang sadar morfologi, *fine-tuning layer* selektif, aplikasi hilir yang lebih luas, dan dataset dialek.

method.en: The methodology utilizes ModernBERT-base with 22 transformer layers, extending its Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding vocabulary with 80,000 Arabic-specific tokens derived from a normalized corpus processed via the Farasa segmenter. Pretraining follows the Masked Language Modeling objective for three epochs on a 17 GB Arabic corpus consisting of OSIAN, Arabic Billion Words, Wikipedia, and OSCAR datasets. The fine-tuning strategy keeps the pretrained encoder backbone frozen while optimizing only task-specific classification heads over sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and extractive question answering benchmarks.
method.id: Metodologi ini menggunakan ModernBERT-base dengan 22 *layer transformer*, yang memperluas kosakata *Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding* dengan 80.000 token khusus bahasa Arab yang bersumber dari korpus dinormalisasi melalui *segmenter* Farasa. *Pralatih* mengikuti tujuan *Masked Language Modeling* selama tiga epoch pada korpus bahasa Arab 17 GB yang terdiri atas dataset OSIAN, Arabic Billion Words, Wikipedia, dan OSCAR. Strategi *fine-tuning* menjaga *backbone encoder* pralatih tetap beku sementara hanya mengoptimalkan *head* klasifikasi khusus tugas pada *benchmark* analisis sentimen, pengenalan entitas bernama, dan tanya jawab ekstraktif.

related_work.en: Prior Arabic NLP research introduced models like AraBERT, AraBERTv1, AraBERTv2, ARBERT, MARBERT, and CAMeLBERT, which were pretrained from scratch on massive Arabic corpora. While successful, these models demand extensive compute resources and remain limited by monolingual training strategies. Multilingual encoders like mBERT and XLM-R cover Arabic but dilute morphological representations due to shared subword vocabularies. Previous cross-lingual adaptation studies focused on older architectures like BERT or RoBERTa and did not explore modern English encoder designs.
related_work.id: Penelitian *NLP* bahasa Arab sebelumnya telah mengenalkan model seperti AraBERT, AraBERTv1, AraBERTv2, ARBERT, MARBERT, dan CAMeLBERT, yang dilatih pralatih dari awal pada korpus bahasa Arab berskala besar. Meskipun berhasil, model-model tersebut menuntut sumber daya komputasi yang luas dan terbatas oleh strategi pelatihan ekabahasa. *Encoder* multilingual seperti mBERT dan XLM-R mencakup bahasa Arab tetapi mengencerkan representasi morfologis akibat kosakata subkata yang dibagikan. Studi adaptasi lintas bahasa sebelumnya berfokus pada arsitektur lama seperti BERT atau RoBERTa dan belum mengeksplorasi desain *encoder* bahasa Inggris modern.

results.en: ModernAraBERT consistently outperforms all baselines across sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and extractive question answering tasks. It achieves macro-F1 improvements of up to plus 16.7% for sentiment analysis and plus 11.5% for named entity recognition, alongside an exact match score of 27.10% on extractive question answering. The authors interpret these gains as evidence that modern English encoder architectures can be efficiently transferred to morphologically rich languages through targeted language-adaptive pretraining while maintaining competitive computational efficiency.
results.id: ModernAraBERT secara konsisten mengungguli semua *baseline* pada tugas analisis sentimen, pengenalan entitas bernama, dan tanya jawab ekstraktif. Model ini mencapai peningkatan *macro-F1* hingga plus 16,7% untuk analisis sentimen dan plus 11,5% untuk pengenalan entitas bernama, beserta skor *exact match* sebesar 27,10% pada tanya jawab ekstraktif. Para penulis menginterpretasikan peningkatan ini sebagai bukti bahwa arsitektur *encoder* bahasa Inggris modern dapat ditransfer secara efisien ke bahasa yang kaya morfologi melalui *continued pretraining* yang ditargetkan dengan tetap mempertahankan efisiensi komputasi yang kompetitif.

tldr.en: This paper introduces ModernAraBERT, an efficient adaptation of the English-pretrained ModernBERT for Arabic language processing. The results show that continued pretraining and frozen-encoder fine-tuning achieve substantial performance improvements across multiple Arabic NLP tasks.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan ModernAraBERT, yaitu sebuah adaptasi efisien dari ModernBERT pralatih bahasa Inggris untuk pemrosesan bahasa Arab. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa *continued pretraining* dan *fine-tuning* dengan *frozen encoder* mampu mencapai peningkatan performa yang signifikan di berbagai tugas *NLP* bahasa Arab.

acl:2026.lrec-1.822.title: Efficient Adaptation of English Language Models for Morphologically Rich and Underrepresented Languages: The Case of Arabic
acl:2026.lrec-1.822.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.825.abstract: Despite significant advances in Automated Essay Scoring (AES), progress in Arabic AES remains limited by the scarcity and imbalance of publicly available datasets. Manual curation of such data is labor-intensive and lacks scalability. To address this, we introduce COrE, a corruption-based data augmentation method that targets the organization trait of Arabic essays. COrE generates synthetic essays by intentionally disrupting the organization of well-written essays through controlled, distance-aware sentence swapping. Our experiments are conducted on TAQAE, a dataset of 620 essays across 4 distinct writing prompts. We evaluate the effectiveness of COrE using two widely-adopted pre-trained models: AraBERTv2 and CAMeLBERT-mix. Both models show improved performance with COrE, achieving gains of 9-17% over the no-augmentation baseline. These results highlight the potential of trait-specific augmentation to address data scarcity and enhance AES performance for low-resource languages.
acl:2026.lrec-1.825.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.825.title: Corruption-Based Data Augmentation for Arabic Essay Scoring: A Preliminary Study on the Organization Trait
acl:2026.lrec-1.825.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.832.abstract: This paper presents UrduLLaMA 1.1 and UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny, two instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) designed to advance natural language processing for Urdu, a low-resource language with limited representation in multilingual corpora. These instruction-tuned models are derived from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct architectures, respectively by conducting continual pretraining on 800 million diverse Urdu tokens curated from public and proprietary sources, followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) using LoRA on 432K Urdu instructions spanning diverse NLP tasks. Rigorous evaluation across 14 culturally-specific domains using our novel Urdu LLM Evaluation Dataset demonstrates superior performance. UrduLLaMA 1.1 achieves 65.3 average accuracy (GPT-5 Nano evaluation), outperforming its Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct base (50.7) across all categories and surpassing Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (62.7) in 8 out of 14 domains. UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny transforms Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (38.8) into a (61.2) performer. Human evaluation by native Urdu linguists confirms these gains (3.51/5 vs. 2.61/5 base). Our results validate targeted adaptation strategies combining continual pretraining with instruction tuning as computationally efficient solutions for low-resource languages, enabling state-of-the-art Urdu LLM models with accessible hardware.
acl:2026.lrec-1.832.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Proses melanjutkan pelatihan *large language model* yang sudah ada pada korpus bahasa baru untuk meningkatkan pemahaman bahasa tersebut.
Tahap pelatihan lanjutan pada *large language model* menggunakan data beranotasi yang terdiri dari instruksi dan respons agar model dapat mengikuti perintah dengan lebih baik.
Teknik *parameter-efficient finetuning* yang melatih matriks rank rendah secara efisien tanpa memperbarui seluruh parameter *large language model*.
Proses menghapus data duplikat atau kembar dari *training dataset* untuk mencegah memorisasi berlebih dan meningkatkan kemampuan generalisasi model.
Unit teks terkecil yang diproses oleh *tokenizer* dalam *large language model*, yang dapat berupa kata atau bagian kata.

background.en: Language modeling has advanced rapidly through large language models, yet multilingual models frequently struggle with low-resource languages like Urdu due to limited representation in training datasets. This data gap restricts vocabulary coverage and encoding efficiency, reducing performance on Urdu natural language processing tasks. Overcoming this limitation is crucial to unlocking the full potential of language models for underrepresented languages.
background.id: *Language modeling* telah berkembang pesat melalui *large language model*, namun model multilingual sering kali menghadapi kendala dengan *low-resource language* seperti bahasa Urdu karena representasi yang terbatas dalam *training dataset*. Kesenjangan data ini membatasi cakupan *vocabulary* dan efisiensi *encoding*, sehingga menurunkan performa pada tugas *natural language processing* bahasa Urdu. Mengatasi keterbatasan ini sangat krusial untuk membuka potensi penuh dari *language model* pada bahasa-bahasa yang kurang terwakili.

contributions.en: The paper introduces UrduLLaMA 1.1 and UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny, which are the first comprehensive instruction-tuned models for Urdu derived from Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. The authors curate a large-scale pretraining corpus of 800 million Urdu tokens and a high-quality instruction-tuning dataset of 432K examples. Additionally, they develop a novel Urdu LLM Evaluation Dataset spanning 14 culturally specific domains to rigorously assess model capabilities.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan UrduLLaMA 1.1 dan UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny, yang merupakan model *instruction-tuned* komprehensif pertama untuk bahasa Urdu yang diturunkan dari Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct dan Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct. Para penulis mengkurasi korpus *pretraining* skala besar sebanyak 800 juta *token* bahasa Urdu dan *instruction-tuning dataset* berkualitas tinggi sebanyak 432 ribu contoh. Selain itu, mereka mengembangkan *Urdu LLM Evaluation Dataset* baru yang mencakup 14 domain spesifik kultural untuk menilai kemampuan model secara ketat.

future_work.en: The authors note limitations including training on a limited portion of the Urdu dataset due to computational and cost constraints, which leads to gaps in knowledge on benchmark datasets. Additionally, detoxification processes were not incorporated during training, leaving the models uncensored and potentially prone to generating harmful or offensive content, which requires caution during deployment.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat keterbatasan termasuk pelatihan pada sebagian kecil dari *dataset* bahasa Urdu karena kendala komputasi dan biaya, yang mengarah pada kesenjangan pengetahuan pada *benchmark dataset*. Selain itu, proses detoksifikasi tidak dimasukkan selama pelatihan, membuat model tidak disensor dan berpotensi rentan menghasilkan konten berbahaya atau menyinggung, yang memerlukan kehati-hatian selama penyebaran.

method.en: The development pipeline consists of data collection, preprocessing, continual pretraining, and supervised fine-tuning. The raw text underwent language filtering using the CLE Urdu Language Identification API, data standardization, quality filtering, and deduplication to yield 1.08 billion tokens, from which 800 million tokens were selected for continual pretraining. The models were continually pretrained using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) with bf16 precision on 3 NVIDIA L40 48GB GPUs. This was followed by supervised fine-tuning on 432,759 instruction-response pairs combining translated datasets and generated data derived from Urdu news articles using the GPT-4o-mini API.
method.id: Alur pengembangan terdiri dari pengumpulan data, *preprocessing*, *continual pretraining*, dan *supervised fine-tuning*. Teks mentah menjalani penyaringan bahasa menggunakan CLE Urdu Language Identification API, standardisasi data, penyaringan kualitas, dan deduplikasi untuk menghasilkan 1,08 miliar *token*, di mana 800 juta *token* dipilih untuk *continual pretraining*. Model-model tersebut menjalani *continual pretraining* menggunakan *Low-Rank Adaptation* (LoRA) dengan presisi bf16 pada 3 GPU NVIDIA L40 48GB. Langkah ini diikuti oleh *supervised fine-tuning* pada 432.759 pasangan instruksi-respons yang menggabungkan *dataset* terjemahan dan data bangkitan yang berasal dari artikel berita berbahasa Urdu menggunakan API GPT-4o-mini.

related_work.en: Prior research has explored adapting large language models for various Asian and low-resource languages using the LLaMA framework. Examples include Tamil-Llama for Tamil, Taiwan-LLM for Traditional Chinese, PersianLLaMA for Persian, AceGPT for Arabic, Airavata for Hindi, and SeaLLMs for Southeast Asian languages. Despite these efforts, apart from a recent model named Alif, no other known study has explored continual pretraining of large language models specifically for Urdu, highlighting the pressing need for dedicated Urdu models.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu telah mengeksplorasi adaptasi *large language model* untuk berbagai bahasa di Asia dan bahasa bersumber daya rendah menggunakan kerangka kerja LLaMA. Contohnya meliputi Tamil-Llama untuk bahasa Tamil, Taiwan-LLM untuk bahasa Mandarin Tradisional, PersianLLaMA untuk bahasa Persia, AceGPT untuk bahasa Arab, Airavata untuk bahasa Hindi, dan SeaLLMs untuk bahasa-bahasa di Asia Tenggara. Terlepas dari upaya tersebut, selain model baru bernama Alif, belum ada studi lain yang mengeksplorasi *continual pretraining* dari *large language model* secara khusus untuk bahasa Urdu, yang menyoroti kebutuhan mendesak akan model khusus bahasa Urdu.

results.en: Evaluated using GPT-5 Nano and human native Urdu linguists across 14 domains, UrduLLaMA 1.1 achieves an average accuracy of 65.3, outperforming its base model Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (50.7) and surpassing Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (62.7) in 8 out of 14 domains. UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny achieves an average accuracy of 61.2, substantially improving over its Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct base (38.8). Human evaluations confirm these improvements, showing that the models successfully capture cultural nuances, idiomatic expressions, and contextual relevancies.
results.id: Dievaluasi menggunakan GPT-5 Nano dan penutur asli linguis bahasa Urdu di 14 domain, UrduLLaMA 1.1 mencapai akurasi rata-rata 65,3, mengungguli model dasarnya Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (50,7) serta melampaui Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct (62,7) di 8 dari 14 domain. UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny mencapai akurasi rata-rata 61,2, yang meningkat secara substansial dari basis Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct (38,8). Evaluasi manusia mengonfirmasi peningkatan ini, menunjukkan bahwa model-model tersebut berhasil menangkap nuansa budaya, ekspresi idiomatis, dan relevansi kontekstual.

tldr.en: This paper presents UrduLLaMA 1.1 and UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny, two instruction-tuned large language models designed to advance natural language processing for Urdu. Evaluations demonstrate that these models significantly outperform their base architectures and rival larger models across diverse domains.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan UrduLLaMA 1.1 dan UrduLLaMA 1.1 Tiny, dua *large language model* yang di-*fine-tune* untuk memajukan *natural language processing* dalam bahasa Urdu. Evaluasi menunjukkan bahwa model-model ini secara signifikan mengungguli arsitektur dasarnya dan menyaingi model yang lebih besar di berbagai domain.

acl:2026.lrec-1.832.title: Instruction-Tuned Urdu LLMs: Efficient Adaptation of Llama Models and Evaluation Resources for Urdu
acl:2026.lrec-1.832.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.834.abstract: Large language models often underperform in many European languages due to the dominance of English and a few high-resource languages in training data. This paper presents TildeOpen LLM, a 30-billion-parameter open-weight foundational model trained on 34 European languages to promote linguistic equity and improve performance for low-resource languages. To address the data imbalance, we combine dataset upsampling with a curriculum-based training schedule that alternates between uniform and natural language distributions. The resulting model performs favorably compared to other multilingual LLMs despite being trained with significantly fewer computing resources. Evaluation across multiple multilingual benchmarks shows that TildeOpen surpasses existing open-weight models in text generation and comprehension, particularly for Baltic, Finno-Ugric, and Slavic languages. Human evaluations confirm an up to tenfold reduction in linguistic errors relative to leading baselines. The model and associated resources are fully open-weight and publicly available at huggingface.co/TildeAI/TildeOpen-30b. These outcomes demonstrate that careful data curation and balanced training strategies can substantially enhance multilingual model quality without increasing model size or training volume.
acl:2026.lrec-1.834.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Teknik penambahan jumlah instansi data pada kelas atau bahasa yang memiliki sedikit data agar proporsinya lebih seimbang.
Strategi pelatihan model di mana data disajikan secara bertahap dari tingkat yang lebih mudah atau terstruktur ke distribusi yang lebih kompleks.
Kondisi di mana teks dari berbagai bahasa diterjemahkan ke dalam jumlah *token* yang relatif setara oleh *tokenizer*.
Arsitektur jaringan saraf tiruan berbasis *transformer* yang hanya menggunakan komponen *decoder*, yang saat ini menjadi standar untuk model bahasa besar generatif.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur seberapa baik sebuah *model bahasa* memprediksi sampel teks berdasarkan tingkat kebingungan per karakter.
Proses pelatihan lanjutan pada *model bahasa* menggunakan pasangan instruksi dan respons agar model dapat mengikuti perintah dengan lebih baik.

background.en: Large language models often underperform in many European languages due to the dominance of English and a few high-resource languages in training data. As models scale, the relative share of non-English data continues to decline, which risks further eroding linguistic and cultural diversity. Consequently, European languages outside of major Western European families remain insufficiently supported, raising concerns about Europe AI sovereignty.
background.id: Model bahasa besar sering kali menunjukkan performa yang kurang optimal pada banyak bahasa Eropa karena dominasi bahasa Inggris dan beberapa bahasa *high-resource* dalam data pelatihan. Seiring dengan peningkatan skala model, proporsi data non-Inggris terus menurun, yang berisiko mengikis keragaman linguistik dan budaya lebih lanjut.

contributions.en: The paper introduces TildeOpen LLM, a 30-billion-parameter foundational model supporting 34 European languages, built using dataset upsampling and a novel three-phase curriculum learning schedule that alternates between uniform and natural language distributions. The authors also propose a tokenizer design ensuring tokenization equity for focus languages and release fully open-weight resources publicly.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan TildeOpen LLM, sebuah *foundational model* dengan 30 miliar parameter yang mendukung 34 bahasa Eropa, yang dibangun menggunakan *upsampling* dataset dan jadwal *curriculum learning* tiga fase yang berganti-ganti antara distribusi bahasa seragam dan alami. Para penulis juga mengusulkan desain *tokenizer* yang memastikan kesetaraan tokenisasi untuk bahasa fokus serta merilis sumber daya berbobot terbuka secara publik.

future_work.en: The authors plan to extend the model by increasing its context length to evaluate capabilities on document-level reasoning and translation tasks, and to instruction-tune the model for various downstream tasks to understand whether language equity during pre-training helps in downstream fine-tuning.
future_work.id: Para penulis berencana untuk memperluas model dengan meningkatkan panjang konteksnya untuk mengevaluasi kemampuan pada penalaran tingkat dokumen dan tugas terjemahan, serta melakukan *instruction-tuning* pada model untuk berbagai tugas hilir untuk memahami apakah kesetaraan bahasa selama *pre-training* membantu dalam *fine-tuning* di hilir.

method.en: The authors train a 30B parameter dense decoder-only transformer based on the Llama 3 architecture using 2 trillion tokens. To address data imbalance, low-resource languages are upsampled up to 2.5 times, followed by a curriculum learning approach with three phases: uniform language exposure during initial and final phases, and a natural distribution during the intermediate phase. The tokenizer uses SentencePiece with Byte Pair Encoding and a vocabulary size of 131,072.
method.id: Para penulis melatih *transformer* padat *decoder-only* dengan 30 miliar parameter berdasarkan arsitektur Llama 3 menggunakan 2 triliun token. Untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan data, bahasa *low-resource* di-*upsampling* hingga 2,5 kali, diikuti oleh pendekatan *curriculum learning* dengan tiga fase: paparan bahasa seragam pada fase awal dan akhir, serta distribusi alami pada fase menengah. *Tokenizer* menggunakan SentencePiece dengan algoritma Byte Pair Encoding dan ukuran kosa kata 131.072.

related_work.en: Several initiatives have aimed to develop highly multilingual European models such as EuroLLM, Tueken, and Salamandra, but they largely address the problem by limiting the share of English rather than rebalancing the representation of smaller languages. For instance, EuroLLM allocates roughly 50 percent of its training data to English and only 9 percent to all other European languages combined.
related_work.id: Beberapa inisiatif telah bertujuan untuk mengembangkan model Eropa yang sangat multibahasa seperti EuroLLM, Tueken, dan Salamandra, tetapi mereka sebagian besar mengatasi masalah tersebut dengan membatasi porsi bahasa Inggris daripada menyeimbangkan kembali representasi bahasa-bahasa yang lebih kecil. Sebagai contoh, EuroLLM mengalokasikan sekitar 50 persen data pelatihannya untuk bahasa Inggris dan hanya 9 persen untuk semua bahasa Eropa lainnya.

results.en: Evaluation across multiple multilingual benchmarks shows that TildeOpen surpasses existing open-weight models in text generation and comprehension, particularly for Baltic, Finno-Ugric, and Slavic languages. Human evaluations confirm an up to tenfold reduction in linguistic errors relative to leading baselines like Gemma 2, despite being trained on significantly fewer tokens.
results.id: Evaluasi di berbagai *benchmark* multibahasa menunjukkan bahwa TildeOpen melampaui model berbobot terbuka yang ada dalam generasi dan pemahaman teks, terutama untuk bahasa-bahasa Baltik, Finno-Ugric, dan Slavia. Evaluasi manusia mengkonfirmasi pengurangan kesalahan linguistik hingga sepuluh kali lipat relatif terhadap *baseline* utama seperti Gemma 2, meskipun dilatih pada token yang jauh lebih sedikit.

tldr.en: This paper presents TildeOpen LLM, a 30-billion-parameter open-weight foundational model trained on 34 European languages to promote linguistic equity. The results show that combining dataset upsampling with a curriculum-based training schedule significantly improves performance and reduces linguistic errors for low-resource languages.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mempresentasikan TildeOpen LLM, sebuah *foundational model* berbobot terbuka dengan 30 miliar parameter yang dilatih pada 34 bahasa Eropa untuk mempromosikan keadilan linguistik. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggabungan *upsampling* dataset dengan jadwal *curriculum learning* secara signifikan meningkatkan performa dan mengurangi kesalahan linguistik pada bahasa *low-resource*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.834.title: TildeOpen LLM: Leveraging Curriculum Learning to Achieve Equitable Language Representation
acl:2026.lrec-1.834.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.838.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) gain instruction-following abilities through instruction-tuning, a method which relies on datasets of instruction–response pairs. However, for low-resource languages, collecting human-authored instructions is costly, raising the question of whether synthetic instructions can substitute human-authored instructions for non-English languages. We compare instruction-tuning of a smaller pretrained LLM in four Nordic languages using (a) human-authored instructions paired with synthetic responses and (b) fully synthetic instruction–response pairs generated with a minimal-effort pipeline. Native-speaker evaluations show that models instruction-tuned on synthetic instructions perform on par with those trained on human-authored instructions for the largest Nordic languages, suggesting that minimal-effort synthetic instructions can serve as a practical alternative. In contrast, response quality deteriorates sharply for Icelandic, underscoring the limitations of current synthetic data generation pipelines when the LLM competence in the target language is weak. Overall, our results highlight that while synthetic instructions can enable cost-efficient instruction-tuning for the largest Nordic languages, they remain insufficient for Icelandic, clarifying when minimal-effort synthetic approaches suffice and when they fall short.

glossary.explanation_id: Proses pelatihan *fine-tuning* pada *large language model* menggunakan pasangan instruksi dan respons agar model mampu mengikuti perintah pengguna.
Kondisi di mana suatu bahasa atau domain memiliki ketersediaan data teks dan sumber daya komputasi yang sangat terbatas.
Tahap pelatihan lanjutan pada *pretrained* *model bahasa* menggunakan *dataset* khusus untuk tugas tertentu.
Arsitektur *Transformer* yang hanya menggunakan komponen *decoder*, yang saat ini mendominasi sebagian besar *large language model* generatif.
Sistem atau model yang mampu mendukung dan memproses berbagai bahasa secara bersamaan.
Representasi vektor numerik dari teks yang menangkap makna semantik dalam ruang berdimensi tinggi.
Standar atau *dataset* pengujian baku yang digunakan untuk mengukur dan membandingkan performa berbagai *model bahasa*.

background.en: Pretrained large language models gain instruction-following abilities through instruction-tuning, which relies on datasets of instruction-response pairs. However, collecting human-authored instructions for non-English and low-resource languages is costly and time-consuming, widening the gap between high- and low-resource languages.
background.id: *Pretrained* *large language model* memperoleh kemampuan mengikuti instruksi melalui *instruction-tuning*, yang bergantung pada *dataset* pasangan instruksi dan respons. Namun, mengumpulkan instruksi buatan manusia untuk bahasa non-Inggris dan *low-resource* memerlukan biaya dan waktu yang mahal, memperlebar kesenjangan antara bahasa *high-resource* dan *low-resource*.

contributions.en: The main contributions include a direct comparison of human- versus synthetic-instruction fine-tuning across four Nordic languages of varying resource levels, examining when minimal-effort synthetic data suffices. The paper provides empirical insights showing that synthetic instructions can replace human-authored ones for larger Nordic languages but fall short for Icelandic, while also demonstrating that response quality has a stronger impact than instruction quality.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama meliputi perbandingan langsung antara *fine-tuning* instruksi buatan manusia versus sintetis di empat bahasa Nordik dengan tingkat sumber daya yang berbeda, serta meneliti kapan data sintetis upaya minimal sudah memadai. Makalah ini memberikan wawasan empiris yang menunjukkan bahwa instruksi sintetis dapat menggantikan instruksi buatan manusia untuk bahasa Nordik yang lebih besar tetapi gagal untuk bahasa Islandia, sekaligus menunjukkan bahwa kualitas respons memiliki dampak yang lebih kuat daripada kualitas instruksi.

future_work.en: Future work should focus on improving the quality and linguistic robustness of the synthetic data generation pipeline, incorporating human engagement via seed-instruction methods, utilizing stronger target-language models, and strengthening evaluation methodology through multi-annotator setups and error taxonomies.
future_work.id: Penelitian masa depan harus berfokus pada peningkatan kualitas dan ketahanan linguistik dari *pipeline* pembuatan data sintetis, memasukkan keterlibatan manusia melalui metode *seed-instruction*, memanfaatkan model bahasa target yang lebih kuat, dan memperkuat metodologi evaluasi melalui pengaturan *multi-annotator* serta taksonomi kesalahan.

method.en: The authors conduct a controlled comparison using a 7.8B parameter µP-parametrized decoder-only Transformer base model trained on the OpenGPT-X dataset. They evaluate three configurations per language: models trained on human-authored instructions paired with synthetic responses, and models trained on fully synthetic pairs at 1K and 10K scales generated using Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct and filtered via quality assessment prompts and FAISS embedding distance. Evaluation is performed via native-speaker preference rankings over 100 held-out prompts.
method.id: Para penulis melakukan perbandingan terkontrol menggunakan *base model* *Transformer* decoder-only berparameter 7.8B dengan *µP*-parameterisasi yang dilatih pada *dataset* OpenGPT-X. Mereka mengevaluasi tiga konfigurasi per bahasa: model yang dilatih pada instruksi buatan manusia yang dipasangkan dengan respons sintetis, dan model yang dilatih pada pasangan sepenuhnya sintetis pada skala 1K dan 10K yang dihasilkan menggunakan Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct serta difilter melalui *prompt* penilaian kualitas dan jarak *embedding* FAISS. Evaluasi dilakukan melalui peringkat preferensi penutur asli atas 100 *prompt* yang ditahan.

related_work.en: Previous research on instruction-tuning dataset creation ranges from large-scale human annotations and hybrid web-sourced approaches to synthetic data generation using powerful LLMs. While recent studies explore synthetic data for low-resource languages via reverse translation or seed-free frameworks, their effectiveness relative to human-authored instructions, particularly in multilingual settings, remains underexplored.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya mengenai pembuatan *dataset* *instruction-tuning* berkisar dari anotasi manusia skala besar dan pendekatan hibrida berbasis web hingga pembuatan data sintetis menggunakan *LLM* yang kuat. Meskipun studi terbaru mengeksplorasi data sintetis untuk bahasa *low-resource* melalui *reverse translation* atau kerangka kerja bebas benih, efektivitasnya relatif terhadap instruksi buatan manusia, terutama dalam pengaturan *multilingual*, masih kurang dieksplorasi.

results.en: Native-speaker evaluations show that synthetic instructions perform on par with human-authored instructions for Swedish, Danish, and Norwegian, with scaling to 10K samples yielding modest gains for Danish and Norwegian. In contrast, Icelandic models suffer from severe degradation due to compounding errors in the synthetic data pipeline caused by weak target language competence.
results.id: Evaluasi penutur asli menunjukkan bahwa instruksi sintetis berkinerja setara dengan instruksi buatan manusia untuk bahasa Swedia, Denmark, dan Norwegia, di mana penskalaan ke 10K sampel menghasilkan peningkatan moderat untuk bahasa Denmark dan Norwegia. Sebaliknya, model bahasa Islandia mengalami penurunan drastis karena kesalahan komparatif dalam *pipeline* data sintetis yang disebabkan oleh kompetensi bahasa target yang lemah.

tldr.en: This paper investigates whether minimal-effort synthetic instructions can substitute human-authored instructions for instruction-tuning large language models across four Nordic languages. The results show that synthetic instructions perform on par with human-authored data for the largest Nordic languages, but fail for low-resource Icelandic due to weak model competence.
tldr.id: Makalah ini meneliti apakah instruksi sintetis dengan upaya minimal dapat menggantikan instruksi buatan manusia untuk *instruction-tuning* *large language model* di empat bahasa Nordik. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa instruksi sintetis berkinerja setara dengan data buatan manusia untuk bahasa Nordik terbesar, namun gagal untuk bahasa Islandia yang *low-resource* karena kompetensi model yang lemah.

acl:2026.lrec-1.838.title: Synthetic Instruction Generation for Low-Resource Nordic Languages: Viability and Limitations in LLM Instruction-Tuning
acl:2026.lrec-1.838.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.841.abstract: We present a methodology for creating high-quality instruction prompts for low-resource Germanic languages that addresses a critical challenge: small annotator pools risk producing datasets reflecting narrow individual interests rather than diverse user needs. In this work, native speakers reformulate existing English prompts from OpenAssistant or create entirely original prompts, adapting them to reflect local contexts and natural language patterns while preserving broad task and topic diversity. This approach produced high-quality prompt datasets totaling 6,950 prompts across seven Germanic languages (German, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian Bokmål/Nynorsk, Danish, Icelandic and Faroese) with validated coverage of diverse tasks and topics. Blind evaluation demonstrates that human-reformulated prompts significantly outperform synthetically generated prompts in naturalness and comprehensibility, particularly for low-resource languages like Icelandic and Faroese. For the bigger Scandinavian lan- guage, Danish, the difference was less pronounced. The prompt dataset is released under an open-source license at https://huggingface.co/datasets/AnnikaSimonsen/TrustLLM-reformulation-prompts.
acl:2026.lrec-1.841.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.841.title: Reformulate and Create, Don’t Translate: Creating Natural Prompts for Underserved Languages
acl:2026.lrec-1.841.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.844.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled scalable synthetic data generation, yet their effective adaptation to low-resource languages remains underexplored. We introduce an LLM-based generate and annotate paradigm to create synthetic datasets for low-resource NLP classification tasks. The framework employs a smaller model for text generation and a stronger model for automatic annotation. Using Farsi Natural Language Inference (NLI) as a case study, we construct a large-scale synthetic dataset of 100,000 labeled instances. We provide a systematic empirical analysis of annotation quality, label-distribution effects, and training regimes. We compare GPT-4o-mini, Aya-23-35B, and DeBERTa as annotators and examine how annotation variability propagates to downstream performance. Our results show that a warm-up phase with synthetic data consistently outperforms data mixing and reversed ordering. Notably, open-source annotation (Aya-23-35B) achieves comparable downstream performance to the proprietary model (GPT-4o-mini), with significant cost implications for deploying pipelines in low-resource settings. The dataset and code are publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/Solmazp/text2entail.

glossary.explanation_id: Tugas *natural language processing* untuk menentukan apakah suatu premis mengimplikasikan, bertentangan dengan, atau netral terhadap suatu *hipotesis*.
Kemampuan *model* untuk melakukan tugas baru tanpa memerlukan contoh pelatihan atau penyesuaian sebelumnya.
Metode augmentasi *data* dengan menerjemahkan teks ke bahasa lain lalu menerjemahkannya kembali ke bahasa sumber.
Rasio yang mengukur keragaman leksikal dalam korpus teks dengan membagi jumlah kata unik dengan total kata.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur area di bawah kurva *receiver operating characteristic* untuk mengukur kemampuan diskriminasi *model* klasifikasi.
Proses pelatihan lanjutan pada *model* pra-latih menggunakan *data* spesifik tugas.
Unit teks terkecil yang diproses oleh *model* *bahasa* setelah melalui proses *tokenizer*.
Kumpulan terstruktur yang berisi *data* untuk keperluan *pelatihan* dan *evaluasi* *model* *machine learning*.

background.en: The success of large language models in natural language processing tasks heavily depends on access to large-scale labeled training data, which remains scarce for the majority of the world languages. This scarcity is particularly acute for tasks such as Natural Language Inference, where data creation and annotation require fine-grained linguistic judgment. Farsi, spoken by over 110 million people, highlights this scale gap because the largest available Farsi natural language inference dataset contains fewer than 10,000 examples compared to hundreds of thousands in English resources. The resulting digital divide limits the applicability of advanced natural language processing methods to speakers of low-resource languages.
background.id: Keberhasilan *large language model* pada tugas *natural language processing* sangat bergantung pada akses terhadap *data* *pelatihan* beranotasi skala besar yang masih langka bagi sebagian besar bahasa di dunia. Kelangkaan ini sangat parah pada tugas seperti *natural language inference*, di mana pembuatan dan *anotasi* *data* memerlukan penilaian linguistik yang cermat. Bahasa Farsi, yang dituturkan oleh lebih dari 110 juta orang, menyoroti kesenjangan skala ini karena *dataset* *natural language inference* Farsi terbesar yang tersedia hanya berisi kurang dari 10.000 contoh dibandingkan ratusan ribu pada sumber daya bahasa Inggris.

contributions.en: The paper makes three main contributions to low-resource natural language processing. First, it proposes a cost-effective and task-agnostic framework for synthetic data generation in paired-text classification tasks and releases a 100K Farsi natural language inference dataset as a concrete output. Second, it conducts a systematic comparison of heterogeneous annotator types including proprietary models, open multilingual models, and task-specialized models, showing that open-source annotation achieves comparable downstream performance. Third, it demonstrates that a synthetic to gold warm-up training regime consistently outperforms data mixing and reversed ordering while identifying a saturation point of 10K to 20K examples.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memberikan tiga kontribusi utama pada *natural language processing* *low-resource*. Pertama, makalah ini mengusulkan kerangka kerja yang hemat biaya dan *task-agnostic* untuk pembuatan *data* sintetik pada tugas klasifikasi teks berpasangan serta merilis *dataset* *natural language inference* Farsi 100K sebagai luaran konkret. Kedua, penelitian ini melakukan perbandingan sistematis terhadap berbagai jenis *annotator* termasuk *model* *proprietary*, *model* multilingual *open-source*, dan *model* khusus tugas, yang menunjukkan bahwa *anotasi* *open-source* mencapai kinerja hilir yang sebanding.

future_work.en: The authors note several limitations that suggest future research directions, including focusing primarily on a single task and language, and using smaller models that may not exhibit the same scaling behaviors as instruction-tuned models with tens of billions of parameters. Future work should explore larger models, alternative hypothesis generation strategies to avoid entitlement bias, and prompt enrichment techniques such as few-shot examples and chain-of-thought reasoning to improve LLM annotation reliability.
future_work.id: Penulis mencatat beberapa keterbatasan yang menyarankan arah penelitian masa depan, termasuk fokus utama pada satu tugas dan bahasa, serta penggunaan *model* berukuran lebih kecil yang mungkin tidak menunjukkan perilaku penskalaan yang sama seperti *model* hasil *instruction-tuning* dengan puluhan miliar parameter. Pekerjaan di masa depan harus mengeksplorasi *model* yang lebih besar, strategi *generasi* *hipotesis* alternatif untuk menghindari bias *entailment*, dan teknik pengayaan *prompt* seperti contoh *few-shot* dan penalaran *chain-of-thought* untuk meningkatkan keandalan *anotasi* *large language model*.

method.en: The proposed framework generates synthetic data for any text classification task involving two input texts through a two-step pipeline. First, an auxiliary text generation model creates candidate hypothesis sequences from premise texts sourced from the Farsi portion of the XLSum dataset. Second, an annotator model labels each generated pair as Entailment, Contradiction, or Neutral using task-specific zero-shot prompts. For the case study on Farsi Natural Language Inference, the authors use an mT5-base model fine-tuned on Farsi summarization as the generator and evaluate GPT-4o-mini, Aya-23-35B, and DeBERTa as annotators. The final evaluation uses a balanced 50K subset trained across four distinct training regimes with mT5-small and mT5-base architectures.
method.id: Kerangka kerja yang diusulkan menghasilkan *data* sintetik untuk setiap tugas klasifikasi teks yang melibatkan dua teks masukan melalui *pipeline* dua langkah. Pertama, *model* *generasi* teks bantu membuat urutan *hipotesis* kandidat dari teks premis yang bersumber dari bagian Farsi *dataset* XLSum. Kedua, *model* *annotator* melabeli setiap pasangan yang dihasilkan sebagai *Entailment*, *Contradiction*, atau *Neutral* menggunakan *prompt* *zero-shot* khusus tugas. Evaluasi akhir menggunakan *subset* 50K seimbang yang dilatih melalui empat *regime* pelatihan yang berbeda dengan arsitektur *mT5-small* dan *mT5-base*.

related_work.en: Prior approaches to address data scarcity in low-resource languages include cross-lingual transfer learning using multilingual models such as mBERT and XLM-R, and back-translation to derive datasets like XNLI and XQuAD from English benchmarks. Although these methods provide valuable resources, cross-lingual transfer often necessitates task-specific fine-tuning which requires the very labeled data that is unavailable, while back-translation frequently introduces artifacts that severely affect model generalization. Additionally, prior work has explored using large language models as generators and weak annotators, but their effective adaptation to low-resource languages and paired-text classification remains underexplored.
related_work.id: Pendekatan terdahulu untuk mengatasi kelangkaan *data* dalam bahasa *low-resource* mencakup *cross-lingual transfer learning* menggunakan *model* multilingual seperti mBERT dan XLM-R, serta *back-translation* untuk menurunkan *dataset* seperti XNLI dan XQuAD dari *benchmark* bahasa Inggris. Meskipun metode ini menyediakan sumber daya yang berharga, *transfer* lintas bahasa sering kali memerlukan *fine-tuning* spesifik tugas yang membutuhkan *data* beranotasi yang justru tidak tersedia, sementara *back-translation* kerap memperkenalkan artefak yang memengaruhi *generalisasi* *model* secara parah.

results.en: Experimental results demonstrate that a synthetic to gold warm-up training regime achieves the best performance across all metrics, with mT5-base obtaining 0.812 ROC-AUC, 0.611 accuracy, and 0.612 weighted-F1. Synthetic data yields a substantial 23 percent accuracy improvement over gold-only baselines. Furthermore, the analysis reveals a performance plateau beyond 10K to 20K examples due to annotator noise accumulation and model capacity constraints. Notably, the open-source annotator Aya-23-35B achieves downstream performance comparable to the proprietary GPT-4o-mini model when paired with the warm-up training regime.
results.id: Hasil eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *regime* pelatihan *warm-up* dari sintetik ke emas mencapai kinerja terbaik di semua metrik, di mana *mT5-base* memperoleh 0.812 ROC-AUC, 0.611 akurasi, dan 0.612 *weighted-F1*. *Data* sintetik menghasilkan peningkatan akurasi sebesar 23 persen dibandingkan *baseline* yang hanya menggunakan *data* emas. Lebih lanjut, analisis mengungkapkan adanya *plateau* kinerja di luar 10K hingga 20K contoh karena akumulasi derau *annotator* dan keterbatasan kapasitas *model*.

tldr.en: This paper introduces an LLM-based generate and annotate paradigm to create synthetic datasets for low-resource NLP classification tasks. The results show that a warm-up phase using synthetic data significantly outperforms data mixing and reversed ordering while open-source annotators match proprietary performance.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan *paradigma* *generate* dan *annotate* berbasis *large language model* untuk membuat *dataset* sintetik pada tugas klasifikasi *natural language processing* *low-resource*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa fase *warm-up* menggunakan data sintetik mengungguli pencampuran data secara signifikan sementara *annotator* *open-source* menyamai kinerja model *proprietary*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.844.title: SynthLLM: An LLM-based Scalable Synthetic Data Generation Pipeline for Low-Resource Languages
acl:2026.lrec-1.844.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.862.abstract: Text embeddings are central to modern natural language processing, enabling several downstream tasks. Despite their significance, existing evaluation frameworks primarily target English and other high-resource languages, leaving critical gaps for languages such as Turkish. To address this, we present TR-TEB (Turkish Text Embedding Benchmark), the first comprehensive, standardized, and reproducible benchmark for Turkish text embeddings. TR-TEB spans five core task categories: classification, pair classification, clustering, retrieval, and semantic textual similarity. It is supported by a diverse dataset portfolio that integrates 14 curated open-source resources, 26 high-quality translated datasets, and 7 newly constructed Turkish-specific datasets designed to capture the language’s unique characteristics. We test our framework by comparing 45 well-known open-source embedding models. As the first unified evaluation suite, TR-TEB serves as a core tool for the Turkish embedding research community, establishing a systematic basis for model comparison and improvement. Furthermore, its benchmarking methodology and dataset creation process provide a blueprint for extending robust embedding evaluation to other low-resource languages.
acl:2026.lrec-1.862.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.862.title: TR-TEB: Turkish Text Embedding Benchmark
acl:2026.lrec-1.862.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.863.abstract: The URIEL+ linguistic knowledge base supports multilingual research by encoding languages through geographic, genetic, and typological vectors. However, data sparsity (e.g. missing feature types, incomplete language entries, and limited genealogical coverage) remains prevalent. This limits the usefulness of URIEL+ in cross-lingual transfer, particularly for supporting low-resource languages. To address this sparsity, we extend URIEL+ by introducing script vectors to represent writing system properties for 7,488 languages, integrating Glottolog to add 18,710 additional languages, and expanding lineage imputation for 26,449 languages by propagating typological and script features across genealogies. These improvements reduce feature sparsity by 14% for script vectors, increase language coverage by up to 19,015 languages (1,007%), and boost imputation quality metrics by up to 35%. Our benchmark on cross-lingual transfer tasks (oriented around low-resource languages) shows occasionally divergent performance compared to URIEL+, with performance gains up to 6% in certain setups.
acl:2026.lrec-1.863.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Vektor numerik yang merepresentasikan properti struktural dan sosial dari sistem penulisan suatu bahasa.
Metode pengisian nilai fitur yang hilang pada bahasa anak dengan menyalin data dari bahasa induk berdasarkan hubungan silsilah.
Kondisi di mana sebagian besar data atau nilai fitur dalam sebuah *knowledge base* bernilai kosong atau hilang.
Vektor yang mengodekan fitur sintaksis, fonologis, dan inventaris struktural suatu bahasa.
Metode transfer pengetahuan dari bahasa sumber yang kaya sumber daya ke bahasa target yang miskin sumber daya.
Algoritma berbasis *matrix completion* yang digunakan untuk mengimputasi nilai yang hilang dalam matriks data.
Kerangka kerja berbasis model *gradient-boosted decision trees* untuk meranking dan memilih bahasa sumber terbaik untuk tugas *cross-lingual transfer*.
Teknik representasi data kategorikal menjadi vektor biner yang hanya bernilai nol atau satu.

background.en: Multilingual natural language processing relies on linguistic knowledge bases like URIEL+, which encode languages through geographic, genetic, and typological vectors to facilitate cross-lingual transfer learning. However, data sparsity remains a critical issue due to missing feature types, incomplete language entries, and limited genealogical coverage, which severely limits its usefulness for low-resource languages.
background.id: Pengolahan bahasa alami multilinguas bergantung pada *knowledge base* linguistik seperti URIEL+, yang mengenkodekan bahasa melalui *vector* geografis, genetik, dan tipologis untuk memfasilitasi *cross-lingual transfer learning*. Namun, *data sparsity* tetap menjadi masalah krusial akibat jenis fitur yang hilang, entri bahasa yang tidak lengkap, dan cakupan silsilah yang terbatas, sehingga sangat membatasi kegunaannya untuk bahasa *low-resource*.

contributions.en: The paper makes three core contributions to extend URIEL+: introducing script vectors from ScriptSource for 7,488 languages, integrating 18,710 additional languages from Glottolog, and expanding lineage imputation across 26,449 languages to propagate typological and script features. These enhancements reduce script feature sparsity by 14%, increase language coverage by up to 1,007%, and improve imputation quality metrics by up to 35%.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memberikan tiga kontribusi inti untuk memperluas URIEL+: memperkenalkan *script vector* dari ScriptSource untuk 7.488 bahasa, mengintegrasikan 18.710 tambahan bahasa dari Glottolog, dan memperluas *lineage imputation* di antara 26.449 bahasa untuk mempropagasi fitur tipologis dan sistem tulisan. Peningkatan ini mengurangi *feature sparsity* sistem tulisan sebesar 14%, meningkatkan cakupan bahasa hingga 1..007%, dan memperbaiki metrik kualitas *imputation* hingga 35%.

future_work.en: The authors plan to explore more advanced imputation schemes that better leverage the tree-like structure of language phylogeny and intend to periodically synchronize URIEL+ with new releases from Glottolog and ScriptSource. Limitations include reliance on existing external database biases, potential inaccuracies in phylogenetic feature propagation for evolving dialects, and increased computational time for integrating large language datasets.
future_work.id: Para penulis berencana untuk mengeksplorasi skema *imputation* yang lebih canggih yang mampu memanfaatkan struktur mirip pohon dari filogeni bahasa dengan lebih baik, serta berniat untuk menyinkronkan URIEL+ secara berkala dengan rilis baru dari Glottolog dan ScriptSource. Keterbatasan yang ada mencakup ketergantungan pada bias basis data eksternal yang ada, potensi ketidakakuratan dalam propagasi fitur filogenetik untuk dialek yang terus berkembang, serta peningkatan waktu komputasi untuk mengintegrasikan dataset bahasa yang besar.

method.en: The authors binarized script properties from ScriptSource using one-hot encoding and applied a logical OR operation for languages with multiple scripts, computing distances using normalized angular distance. They integrated Glottolog languages to establish a complete genealogical backbone and extended lineage imputation using a breadth-first search algorithm across language trees. Evaluation was conducted through imputation quality tests and benchmarking cross-lingual transfer tasks using the LangRank framework across nine sub-tasks.
method.id: Para penulis melakukan binerisasi properti sistem tulisan dari ScriptSource menggunakan *one-hot encoding* dan menerapkan operasi *logical OR* untuk bahasa dengan banyak sistem tulisan, serta menghitung jarak menggunakan *normalized angular distance*. Mereka mengintegrasikan bahasa Glottolog untuk membangun kerangka silsilah yang utuh dan memperluas *lineage imputation* menggunakan algoritma *breadth-first search* pada pohon bahasa. Evaluasi dilakukan melalui uji kualitas *imputation* dan *benchmarking* tugas *cross-lingual transfer* menggunakan kerangka kerja LangRank pada sembilan sub-tugas.

related_work.en: Prior research demonstrates that script properties are first-order determinants of language similarity and crucial for tasks like morphological inflection and multilingual pre-training. However, existing approaches rely on ad-hoc, language-specific preprocessing such as romanization, which exhibits bias toward high-resource languages. Furthermore, resources like Glottolog provide comprehensive genealogical catalogues, while phylogenetic studies show that related languages tend to share structural and typological features.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya menunjukkan bahwa properti sistem tulisan adalah penentu utama kemiripan bahasa dan sangat penting untuk tugas seperti *morphological inflection* dan *multilingual pre-training*. Namun, pendekatan yang ada mengandalkan *preprocessing* ad-hoc yang spesifik untuk bahasa tertentu seperti *romanization*, yang menunjukkan bias terhadap bahasa *high-resource*. Selain itu, sumber daya seperti Glottolog menyediakan katalog silsilah yang komprehensif, sementara studi filogenetik menunjukkan bahwa bahasa-bahasa yang berkerabat cenderung berbagi fitur struktural dan tipologis.

results.en: Results show that script vectors achieve near-perfect SoftImpute performance with accuracy and F1 scores above 0.98. Expanded lineage imputation improves most metrics, particularly for morphological features, though phonological and inventory features experience slight declines. In cross-lingual transfer benchmarking, incorporating script distances yields an average performance improvement of 6%, significantly enhancing transfer predictions in part-of-speech tagging and topic classification tasks.
results.id: Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa *script vector* mencapai performa *SoftImpute* yang hampir sempurna dengan akurasi dan skor F1 di atas 0,98. *Expanded lineage imputation* memperbaiki sebagian besar metrik, terutama untuk fitur morfologis, meskipun fitur fonologis dan inventaris mengalami sedikit penurunan. Dalam *benchmarking cross-lingual transfer*, penggabungan jarak sistem tulisan menghasilkan peningkatan performa rata-rata sebesar 6%, yang secara signifikan meningkatkan prediksi *transfer* pada tugas *part-of-speech tagging* dan *topic classification*.

tldr.en: This paper extends the URIEL+ linguistic knowledge base by introducing script vectors, integrating Glottolog languages, and expanding lineage imputation to reduce data sparsity. These enhancements significantly improve language coverage and boost performance in cross-lingual transfer tasks.
tldr.id: Makalah ini memperluas *knowledge base* linguistik URIEL+ dengan memperkenalkan *script vector*, mengintegrasikan bahasa-bahasa dari Glottolog, dan memperluas *lineage imputation* untuk mengurangi *data sparsity*. Peningkatan ini secara signifikan memperluas cakupan bahasa dan mendongkrak performa pada tugas *cross-lingual transfer*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.863.title: Simple Additions, Substantial Gains: Expanding Scripts, Languages, and Lineage Coverage in URIEL+
acl:2026.lrec-1.863.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.869.abstract: Fact-checking is essential due to the explosion of misinformation in the media ecosystem. Although false information exists in every language and country, most research to solve the problem has mainly concentrated on huge communities like English and Chinese. Low-resource languages like Vietnamese are necessary to explore corpora and models for fact verification. To bridge this gap, we construct ViWikiFC, the first manually annotated open-domain corpus for Vietnamese Wikipedia Fact Checking more than 20K claims generated by converting evidence sentences extracted from Wikipedia articles. We analyze our corpus through many linguistic aspects, from the new dependency rate, the new n-gram rate, and the new word rate. We conducted various experiments for Vietnamese fact-checking, including evidence retrieval and verdict prediction. BM25 and InfoXLM_{Large} achieved the best results in two tasks, with BM25 achieving an accuracy of 88.30% for SUPPORTS, 86.93% for REFUTES, and only 56.67% for the NEI label in the evidence retrieval task. InfoXLM_{Large} achieved an F_1 score of 86.51%. Furthermore, we also conducted a pipeline approach, which only achieved a strict accuracy of 67.00% when using InfoXLM_{Large} and BM25. These results demonstrate that our dataset is challenging for the Vietnamese language model in fact-checking tasks.
acl:2026.lrec-1.869.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.869.title: ViWikiFC: Fact-Checking for Vietnamese Wikipedia-Based Textual Knowledge Source
acl:2026.lrec-1.869.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.87.abstract: Being able to understand information is a key factor for a self-determined life and society. The study of automatic text simplification is often limited by the availability of high quality material for the training and evaluation on automatic simplifiers. This is true for English, but more so for less resourced languages like Spanish, Catalan and Italian. In order to fill this gap, we present a corpus of of original texts with high quality simplification produced by human experts in text simplification. It was developed within a project to assess the impact of Easy-to-Read (E2R) language for democratic participation. The original texts were compiled from domains related to this topic. The corpus includes different text types, selected based on relevance, copyright availability, and ethical standards. All texts were simplified to Easy-to-Read level. The corpora hold significant scientific value, particularly as it includes the first annotated corpora of its kind for the Catalan language. It also represents a noteworthy contribution for Spanish and Italian, offering high-quality, human-annotated language resources that are rarely available in these domains. The corpora will be made freely accessible to the public.
acl:2026.lrec-1.87.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Proses mengurangi kompleksitas linguistik dari suatu teks agar lebih mudah dipahami tanpa mengubah makna utamanya.
Kumpulan data teks terstruktur yang digunakan untuk analisis linguistik dan pelatihan *model bahasa*.
Pemberian label atau metadata tambahan pada data untuk mendeskripsikan fitur atau karakteristik tertentu.
Kondisi di mana suatu bahasa atau domain kekurangan data pelatihan dan sumber daya komputasi yang memadai.
Proses mencocokkan pasangan unit teks, seperti kalimat asli dan kalimat terjemahan atau simplifikasinya.

background.en: Understanding information is crucial for a self-determined life and democratic participation. However, linguistic barriers severely hinder inclusion, especially for the 750 million illiterate adults, persons with disabilities, and migrants who struggle to master complex institutional language. Automatic text simplification systems offer a promising solution to mitigate this problem, but their development is severely constrained by the scarcity of high-quality training and evaluation data, particularly in low-resource settings beyond English.
background.id: Memahami informasi sangat penting bagi kehidupan yang mandiri dan partisipasi demokratis. Namun, hambatan linguistik sangat menghambat inklusi, terutama bagi 750 juta orang dewasa yang buta huruf, penyandang disabilitas, dan migran yang kesulitan menguasai bahasa institusional yang kompleks. Sistem *text simplification* otomatis menawarkan solusi yang menjanjikan untuk mengatasi masalah ini, tetapi pengembangannya sangat terkendala oleh kelangkaan data *training* dan *evaluation* berkualitas tinggi, terutama pada *low-resource setting* di luar bahasa Inggris.

contributions.en: The paper introduces the first annotated Easy-to-Read corpus for Catalan and substantial corpora for Spanish and Italian, focusing on political, deliberative, and participatory domains. The key contributions include a cross-lingual methodology for human simplification, fine-grained annotations of applied simplification criteria by trained experts, and openly accessible JSON-formatted datasets aligned at the sentence level.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan korpus *Easy-to-Read* beranotasi pertama untuk bahasa Katalan serta korpus yang substansial untuk bahasa Spanyol dan Italia, dengan fokus pada domain politik, deliberatif, dan partisipatif. Kontribusi utamanya mencakup metodologi lintas bahasa untuk simplifikasi manusia, anotasi terperinci dari kriteria simplifikasi yang diterapkan oleh para ahli terlatih, serta dataset berformat JSON yang dapat diakses secara terbuka dan disejajarkan pada tingkat kalimat.

future_work.en: The authors acknowledge limitations arising from human bias, subjective interpretations, and the challenge for expert translators to explicitly annotate their tacit processes. Future directions include expanding the dataset with additional data points to enhance broader applicability and utilizing the corpora for evaluating shared tasks and advancing multilingual natural language processing.
future_work.id: Para penulis mengakui adanya keterbatasan yang timbul dari bias manusia, interpretasi subjektif, serta tantangan bagi penerjemah ahli untuk menganotasi proses taksid mereka secara eksplisit. Arah masa depan mencakup perluasan dataset dengan tambahan titik data untuk meningkatkan keterapan yang lebih luas serta memanfaatkan korpus untuk mengevaluasi *shared task* dan memajukan *natural language processing* multibahasa.

method.en: The corpus was constructed through a collaborative effort involving 12 institutions and professional Easy-to-Read translators. Original texts were selected from government, news, political, and legislative domains based on relevance and copyright standards. Translators manually simplified sentences to an A2 CEFR proficiency equivalent while adhering to a unified mapping of annotation criteria, documenting applied tags such as syntax restructuring and vocabulary simplification within a spreadsheet format.
method.id: Korpus ini dibangun melalui upaya kolaboratif yang melibatkan 12 institusi dan penerjemah profesional *Easy-to-Read*. Teks asli dipilih dari domain pemerintahan, berita, politik, dan legislatif berdasarkan relevansi dan standar hak cipta. Penerjemah secara manual menyederhanakan kalimat ke tingkat setara kecakapan A2 CEFR sambil mematuhi pemetaan terpadu dari kriteria anotasi, serta mendokumentasikan *tag* terapan seperti restrukturisasi sintaksis dan simplifikasi kosakata dalam format lembar kerja (*spreadsheet*).

related_work.en: Previous research on written content accessibility has explored Plain Language and Easy-to-Read approaches, yet empirical research evaluating these guidelines remains scarce. Existing text simplification corpora, such as Simple English Wikipedia and Newsela, primarily target English and suffer from limitations like being non-parallel, relying on crowdsourced non-expert workers, or being restricted to document-level alignment. Comparable datasets for Spanish, Catalan, and Italian are extremely limited, often restricted to lexical simplification or hindered by restrictive licenses.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya mengenai aksesibilitas konten tertulis telah mengeksplorasi pendekatan *Plain Language* dan *Easy-to-Read*, namun penelitian empiris yang mengevaluasi pedoman ini masih sangat langka. Korpus *text simplification* yang ada, seperti *Simple English Wikipedia* dan *Newsela*, sebagian besar menargetkan bahasa Inggris dan memiliki keterbatasan seperti tidak paralel, mengandalkan pekerja *crowdsourced* non-ahli, atau terbatas pada *document-level alignment*. Kumpulan data yang sebanding untuk bahasa Spanyol, Katalan, and Italia sangat terbatas, seringkali hanya sebatas *lexical simplification* atau terkendala oleh lisensi yang restriktif.

results.en: The resulting corpora comprise three sub-corpora containing thousands of words and sentence segments across Spanish, Catalan, and Italian. Quantitative analysis shows that simplified texts generally feature more sentence segments and fewer words per segment compared to originals. Annotation frequency analysis reveals that primary simplification strategies across all languages include using frequent verbs and nouns, eliminating abstract terms, and separating ideas using line breaks, periods, or commas.
results.id: Korpus yang dihasilkan terdiri dari tiga sub-korpus yang mencakup ribuan kata dan *sentence segment* dalam bahasa Spanyol, Katalan, dan Italia. Analisis kuantitatif menunjukkan bahwa teks yang disederhanakan umumnya memiliki lebih sedikit kata per segmen dan lebih banyak segmen kalimat dibandingkan teks asli. Analisis frekuensi anotasi mengungkapkan bahwa strategi simplifikasi utama di semua bahasa mencakup penggunaan kata kerja dan kata benda yang sering digunakan, menghilangkan istilah abstrak, serta memisahkan ide menggunakan *line break*, titik, atau koma.

tldr.en: This paper presents a multilingual human-annotated corpus of original and Easy-to-Read texts in Spanish, Catalan, and Italian to support democratic participation. The resulting dataset provides high-quality sentence-level simplifications produced by professional translators, serving as a valuable resource for text simplification research.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan korpus multibahasa beranotasi manusia yang terdiri dari teks asli dan teks *Easy-to-Read* dalam bahasa Spanyol, Katalan, dan Italia untuk mendukung partisipasi demokratis. Kumpulan data ini menghasilkan simplifikasi tingkat kalimat berkualitas tinggi yang dikerjakan oleh penerjemah profesional, serta berfungsi sebagai sumber daya berharga untuk penelitian *text simplification*.

acl:2026.lrec-1.87.title: A Multilingual Human Annotated Corpus of Original and Easy-to-Read Texts to Support Access to Democratic Participatory Processes
acl:2026.lrec-1.87.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.88.abstract: We introduce Proffiliadur, a Python toolkit for text profiling and readability analysis in Welsh. The toolkit computes 141 surface, lexical, morphological, and syntactic indices, designed to capture linguistic variation while incorporating a Welsh-specific tokenisation process that enables accurate morphological analysis and handles phenomena such as initial consonant mutation. Proffiliadur enables systematic assessment of text accessibility and supports applications in education, healthcare, and public communication. We demonstrate the toolkit’s usefulness through two complementary analyses. First, we examine texts written in accordance with the Cymraeg Clîr (“Clear Welsh”) principles and compare them with regular Welsh texts. Second, we analyse texts across CEFR proficiency levels to explore how linguistic complexity varies with learner ability. We also evaluate feature-based and neural classification models for automatic complexity detection, showing that interpretable linguistic indices alone achieve strong predictive performance (F1 = 0.94), comparable to a fine-tuned transformer (F1 = 0.97). Proffiliadur provides the first dedicated text profiling toolkit for Welsh, offering reproducible, linguistically grounded measures of readability for a low-resource language.
acl:2026.lrec-1.88.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.88.title: Proffiliadur: Welsh Language Text Profiling Toolkit
acl:2026.lrec-1.88.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.904.abstract: Grammar refers to the system of rules that governs the structural organization and the semantic relations among linguistic units such as sentences, phrases, and words within a given language. In natural language processing, there remains a notable scarcity of grammar-focused evaluation protocols, a gap that is even more pronounced for low-resource languages. Moreover, the extent to which large language models genuinely comprehend grammatical structure, especially the mapping between syntactic structures and meanings remains under debate. To investigate this issue, we propose a Grammar-Book–Guided evaluation pipeline intended to provide a systematic and generalizable framework for grammar evaluation consisting of four key stages, and in this work we take Luxembourgish as a case study. The results show a weak positive correlation between translation performance and grammatical understanding, indicating that strong translations do not necessarily imply deep grammatical competence. Larger models perform well overall due to their semantic strength but remain weak in morphology and syntax, struggling particularly with Minimal Pair tasks, while strong reasoning ability offers a promising way to enhance their grammatical understanding.
acl:2026.lrec-1.904.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference
acl:2026.lrec-1.904.title: Do Large Language Models Grasp the Grammar? Evidence from Grammar-Book-Guided Probing in Luxembourgish
acl:2026.lrec-1.904.venue: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

acl:2026.lrec-1.911.abstract: Initial consonant mutation is a key feature of Welsh, but its complexity poses significant challenges for both language learners and natural language processing (NLP) systems. While existing tools can reliably detect mutated forms, they provide no information about why a mutation occurs, i.e. what grammatical or lexical factors trigger the change. This paper introduces the novel task of mutation trigger labelling, representing the first computational attempt to analyse and explain the reasons behind Welsh mutations. Two preliminary approaches are explored: (i) a linguistically-informed rule-based system integrating Constraint Grammar rules, and (ii) large language models (LLMs), prompted in few-shot settings. Our experiments test the feasibility of automatically identifying and labelling linguistic triggers behind Welsh mutations using a dataset constructed from grammar reference books and public corpora, and establish baseline insights into how context-aware mutation analysis can be achieved. By framing mutation trigger labelling as a linguistic computational problem, this work lays important groundwork within Welsh NLP and contributes to the broader development of explainable grammatical analysis for low-resource languages.
acl:2026.lrec-1.911.journal_ref: Proceedings of the Fifteenth Language Resources and Evaluation Conference

glossary.explanation_id: Sebuah kerangka kerja linguistik komputasi yang menggunakan aturan berbasis batasan untuk melakukan *disambiguasi* morfologis.
Fenomena linguistik yang berkaitan dengan interaksi antara morfologi dan fonologi suatu bahasa.
Metode *prompting* di mana *large language model* diberi beberapa contoh tugas sebelum diminta melakukan prediksi.
Perangkat komputasi untuk menetapkan kelas kata seperti nomina atau verba ke setiap token dalam teks.
Proses pengubahan bentuk kata yang diinfleksikan ke bentuk dasar atau *lemma* kamusnya.
Jenis perubahan konsonan awal dalam bahasa rumpun Keltik di mana bunyi konsonan melunak.
Analisis struktur sintaksis kalimat untuk menentukan hubungan dependensi antar kata.

background.en: Initial consonant mutation is a defining morphophonological feature of Welsh where the first consonant of a word changes based on its grammatical context.
