doi:10.33087/sjee.v10i2.428.abstract: Indonesia is a country with extraordinary linguistic diversity, with more than 718 regional languages, making almost all elementary school students grow up in multilingual environments. This study aims to identify the complexity of multilingual use among elementary school students in Indonesia, examine its implications for speaking and listening skills in Indonesian language learning, and formulate appropriate and responsive learning strategies. The method employed is a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) by searching Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, and Publish or Perish databases using keywords for the period 2016–2026, yielding 15 selected articles after four rigorous selection stages from 150 initial sources. The findings reveal that multilingual complexity among elementary students manifests in three main forms: language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching, all of which directly affect students' speaking and listening achievement. In speaking skills, first-language interference and low self-confidence are the primary barriers, while storytelling methods, role-playing, and integrated multilingual programs have proven effective in overcoming them. In listening skills, multilingual cognitive load and monotonous teaching methods are obstacles that can be addressed through audiovisual media and locally-based cultural media. This study affirms that multilingualism is not an obstacle but a linguistic potential that must be managed through translanguaging approaches, experience-based learning, creative media utilization, and inclusive curriculum design. Teachers' competence in understanding students' linguistic diversity is the key to the success of all these strategies.

glossary.explanation_id: Praktik pedagogis yang memanfaatkan seluruh repertoar linguistik siswa multibahasa sebagai sumber daya dalam proses pembelajaran.
Fenomena peralihan penuh dari satu bahasa ke bahasa lain secara bergantian dalam suatu percakapan.
Penyisipan unsur kata atau frasa dari bahasa lain ke dalam tuturan bahasa utama yang sedang digunakan.
Masuknya unsur sistem bahasa pertama ke dalam penggunaan bahasa kedua yang sedang dipelajari.
Metode tinjauan pustaka sistematis untuk mengidentifikasi, menilai, dan menganalisis seluruh penelitian yang tersedia terkait topik tertentu.
Kesadaran kritis yang dikembangkan dalam ruang belajar untuk memahami dan menghargai keberagaman budaya serta linguistik.

background.en: Indonesia possesses extraordinary linguistic diversity with over 718 regional languages, causing almost all elementary school students to grow up in multilingual environments where they acquire a regional language as their first language and Indonesian as a second language learned formally at school. This situation creates a unique linguistic complexity that directly affects students' cognitive development and learning processes. However, learning policies and classroom practices tend to be monolingual, placing elementary teachers in a dilemma between enforcing formal Indonesian and allowing regional languages.
background.id: Indonesia memiliki keragaman bahasa yang luar biasa dengan lebih dari 718 bahasa daerah, menyebabkan hampir seluruh siswa sekolah dasar tumbuh di lingkungan multibahasa tempat mereka memperoleh bahasa daerah sebagai bahasa pertama dan bahasa Indonesia sebagai bahasa kedua yang dipelajari secara formal di sekolah. Situasi ini menciptakan kompleksitas linguistik unik yang berdampak langsung pada perkembangan kognitif dan proses pembelajaran siswa. Namun, kebijakan pembelajaran dan praktik di kelas cenderung bersifat monolingual, menempatkan guru sekolah dasar dalam dilema antara menegakkan bahasa Indonesia formal dan membiarkan bahasa daerah.

contributions.en: This study contributes a systematic literature review analyzing fifteen selected articles from an initial pool of one hundred fifty sources published between 2016 and 2026. It systematically identifies the three main forms of multilingual complexity—language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching—and maps their specific impacts on speaking and listening skills. Furthermore, it formulates concrete pedagogical strategies, including the translanguaging approach, experience-based learning methods, and creative media utilization for Indonesian language classrooms.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi melalui *systematic literature review* yang menganalisis lima belas artikel terpilih dari total seratus lima puluh sumber awal yang diterbitkan antara tahun 2016 hingga 2026. Studi ini secara sistematis mengidentifikasi tiga bentuk utama kompleksitas multibahasa—interferensi bahasa, campur kode, dan alih kode—serta memetakan dampak spesifiknya terhadap keterampilan berbicara dan menyimak. Selain itu, studi ini merumuskan strategi pedagogis konkret, termasuk pendekatan *translanguaging*, metode pembelajaran berbasis pengalaman, dan pemanfaatan media kreatif untuk kelas pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia.

future_work.en: The paper does not explicitly detail formal future work limitations, but it recommends that future researchers conduct deeper empirical and experimental studies on the relationship between multilingualism and listening skills across various regional contexts in Indonesia.
future_work.id: Makalah ini tidak secara eksplisit merinci keterbatasan pekerjaan masa depan, tetapi merekomendasikan agar peneliti selanjutnya melakukan studi empiris dan eksperimental yang lebih mendalam mengenai hubungan antara multibahasa dan keterampilan menyimak di berbagai konteks daerah di Indonesia.

method.en: The research employs a Systematic Literature Review methodology. Literature searches were conducted across Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, and Publish or Perish databases using Boolean keywords such as multilingualism, listening skills, speaking skills, elementary school, and Indonesian language. Out of one hundred fifty initial search results, a rigorous four-stage selection process based on title relevance, abstract and keyword screening, and deep content evaluation yielded fifteen primary articles for detailed analysis.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan metodologi *Systematic Literature Review*. Pencarian literatur dilakukan di basis data Google Scholar, Garuda, Semantic Scholar, dan Publish or Perish menggunakan kata kunci Boolean seperti multibahasa, keterampilan menyimak, keterampilan berbicara, sekolah dasar, and bahasa Indonesia. Dari seratus lima puluh hasil pencarian awal, proses seleksi empat tahap yang ketat berdasarkan relevansi judul, penyaringan abstrak dan kata kunci, serta evaluasi konten mendalam menghasilkan lima belas artikel utama untuk analisis terperinci.

related_work.en: Prior research on multilingualism covers the cognitive and academic impacts on early childhood, showing both multilingual advantages and challenges. Other studies have explored translanguaging practices as a pedagogical resource and phonological or morphological interference in local contexts. However, prior research specifically connecting multilingualism to listening skills remains relatively limited, and existing classroom practices often fail to accommodate the complex linguistic realities of students.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu mengenai multibahasa mencakup dampak kognitif dan akademis pada anak usia dini, yang menunjukkan baik manfaat maupun tantangan dari *multilingualism*. Studi lain telah mengeksplorasi praktik *translanguaging* sebagai sumber daya pedagogis serta interferensi fonologis atau morfologis pada konteks lokal. Namun, penelitian terdahulu yang secara khusus menghubungkan multibahasa dengan keterampilan menyimak masih relatif terbatas, dan praktik kelas yang ada sering kali gagal mengakomodasi realitas linguistik siswa yang kompleks.

results.en: The findings show that multilingual complexity manifests in three main forms: language interference, code-mixing, and code-switching. In speaking skills, first-language interference and low self-confidence serve as primary barriers, which can be mitigated through storytelling, role-playing, and integrated programs like Sarigabah. In listening skills, multilingual cognitive load and monotonous teaching methods hinder comprehension, but these are successfully addressed using audiovisual media and locally-based cultural media such as shadow puppets.
results.id: Temuan menunjukkan bahwa kompleksitas multibahasa bermanifestasi dalam tiga bentuk utama: interferensi bahasa, campur kode, dan alih kode. Dalam keterampilan berbicara, interferensi bahasa pertama dan rendahnya rasa percaya diri bertindak sebagai hambatan utama, yang dapat dikurangi melalui metode bercerita, bermain peran, dan program terintegrasi seperti Sarigabah. Dalam keterampilan menyimak, beban kognitif multibahasa dan metode pengajaran yang monoton menghambat pemahaman, namun hal ini berhasil diatasi dengan menggunakan media audiovisual dan media budaya berbasis kearifan lokal seperti pertunjukan wayang.

tldr.en: This paper investigates the complexity of multilingual use among elementary school students in Indonesia and its implications for Indonesian language learning. The findings reveal that multilingualism manifests through interference, code-mixing, and code-switching, requiring responsive strategies like translanguaging and inclusive curriculum design.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyelidiki kompleksitas penggunaan multibahasa pada siswa sekolah dasar di Indonesia serta implikasinya terhadap pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia. Temuannya mengungkapkan bahwa multibahasa bermanifestasi melalui interferensi, campur kode, dan alih kode, yang memerlukan strategi responsif seperti *translanguaging* dan perancangan kurikulum inklusif.

doi:10.33087/sjee.v10i2.428.title: Kompleksitas Penggunaan Multibahasa Pada Siswa Sekolah Dasar: Implikasinya Terhadap Keterampilan Berbicara dan Menyimak dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia

doi:10.33093/jclc.2026.6.2.26.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI)-based teaching approaches have gained increasing attention in Malaysia’s higher education system, particularly in relation to the Higher Education Development Plan 2026–2035. Although previous studies have reported low to moderate levels of AI literacy among educators, limited empirical attention has been given to AI literacy within language education contexts, where pedagogical interaction, communicative competence, and ethical considerations are central topics. Drawing on a multidimensional AI literacy framework encompassing cognitive, affective, behavioural, and ethical dimensions, this study assessed AI literacy among language academics at the Faculty of Major Language Studies (FPBU) at Universiti Sains Islam Malaysia (USIM). A bilingual Malay–English version of the Artificial Intelligence Literacy Questionnaire (AILQ) was administered to 72 academic staff. Data were analysed using descriptive and inferential methods to determine overall AI literacy levels, relationships between demographic factors and AI literacy, and correlations among the AI literacy dimensions. The findings revealed a high level of self-reported AI literacy among the participants. Further analysis showed no significant relationship between gender, age, years of services and the participants’ AI literacy. However, significant correlations were found between affective and behavioural learning and between affective and cognitive learning, while the correlation between affective and ethical learning was relatively low. Overall, the findings suggest that language academics at FPBU USIM report relatively high AI literacy across the measured dimensions. This study contributes to the theoretical understanding of AI literacy dimensions and offers practical implications for institutional policy, professional development, and AI integration strategies in language education.
authors: ASSOC. PROF. DR AZLAN SHAIFUL BAHARUM

doi:10.33306/mjssh/466.abstract: This study aimed to examine the effectiveness of Kadazandusun language teaching and learning methods employed by primary school teachers specializing in the instruction of the Kadazandusun language. The research focused on the implementation of systematic pedagogical approaches that incorporate a variety of instructional techniques and strategies to enhance the teaching and learning process. Specifically, the study investigated the application of teaching methods such as dialogue-based activities, role-playing, drilling, singing, demonstrations, and educational games in facilitating language acquisition and learner engagement. A total of 20 Kadazandusun language teachers from primary schools across the Tambunan District, Sabah, participated in the study. A quantitative research approach employing a descriptive survey design was adopted to obtain insights into teachers’ perceptions of the effectiveness of these instructional methods. Data were collected using a structured questionnaire comprising 30 items and subsequently analyzed using the Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) version 23.0. Descriptive statistical analyses, including mean scores and standard deviations, were utilized to interpret the data. The findings revealed that the overall level of acceptance and perceived effectiveness of the teaching methods was positive, with an overall mean score of 3.05. This result suggests that the instructional approaches employed by the teachers were generally effective in supporting the teaching and learning of the Kadazandusun language. Nevertheless, the findings also indicate the need for greater integration of learner-centered instructional models and the more effective utilization of teaching resources and educational materials. Such enhancements may contribute to improved classroom management practices, increased effectiveness of teaching and learning activities, and a reduction in teachers’ instructional workload. Based on these findings, several recommendations are proposed to strengthen pedagogical practices and further improve the quality of Kadazandusun language education in primary schools.

glossary.explanation_id: Desain *survey* deskriptif adalah metode penelitian yang bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan karakteristik suatu fenomena atau populasi tanpa memanipulasi variabel.
Skor rata-rata adalah nilai aritmatika yang diperoleh dengan membagi jumlah total nilai dengan jumlah pengamatan dalam suatu set data.
Pendekatan yang berpusat pada pembelajar menempatkan siswa sebagai pusat proses pembelajaran, di mana guru bertindak sebagai fasilitator.

background.en: The study addresses the need to enhance indigenous language education by examining instructional methods used for teaching the Kadazandusun language in primary schools. Effective pedagogical approaches are crucial for facilitating language acquisition and learner engagement among students in Sabah, yet there remains a need to evaluate current teaching practices.
background.id: Penelitian ini membahas kebutuhan untuk meningkatkan pendidikan bahasa pribumi dengan menguji metode instruksional yang digunakan untuk pengajaran bahasa Kadazandusun di sekolah dasar. Pendekatan pedagogis yang efektif sangat krusial untuk memfasilitasi pemerolehan bahasa dan keterlibatan pembelajar di kalangan siswa di Sabah, namun masih terdapat kebutuhan untuk mengevaluasi praktik pengajaran saat ini.

contributions.en: The primary contribution is an empirical evaluation of pedagogical techniques utilized by Kadazandusun language teachers, providing insights into teachers' perceptions of instructional effectiveness within the Tambunan District.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utamanya adalah evaluasi empiris terhadap teknik pedagogis yang digunakan oleh guru bahasa Kadazandusun, yang memberikan wawasan tentang persepsi guru terhadap efektivitas instruksional di dalam Distrik Tambunan.

future_work.en: The authors propose several recommendations to strengthen pedagogical practices and improve the quality of Kadazandusun language education, though specific future research directions are not explicitly detailed.
future_work.id: Para penulis mengusulkan beberapa rekomendasi untuk memperkuat praktik pedagogis dan meningkatkan kualitas pendidikan bahasa Kadazandusun, meskipun arah penelitian masa depan yang spesifik tidak dirinci secara eksplisit.

method.en: The study adopted a quantitative research approach employing a descriptive survey design. Data were collected from 20 Kadazandusun language primary school teachers in the Tambunan District using a structured questionnaire with 30 items, and were subsequently analyzed using descriptive statistics such as mean scores and standard deviations via SPSS version 23.0.
method.id: Penelitian ini mengadopsi pendekatan penelitian kuantitatif dengan menggunakan desain *survey* deskriptif. Data dikumpulkan dari 20 guru sekolah dasar bahasa Kadazandusun di Distrik Tambunan menggunakan *kuesioner* terstruktur dengan 30 butir, dan selanjutnya dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif seperti skor rata-rata dan simpangan baku melalui *SPSS* versi 23.0.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas karya terkait secara rinci.

results.en: The findings revealed an overall positive level of acceptance and perceived effectiveness of the teaching methods, with an overall mean score of 3.05. However, the results also highlight the need for greater integration of learner-centered instructional models and better utilization of teaching resources to reduce instructional workload.
results.id: Temuan mengungkapkan tingkat penerimaan dan efektivitas persepsian yang positif secara keseluruhan terhadap metode pengajaran, dengan skor rata-rata keseluruhan sebesar 3,05. Namun, hasilnya juga menyoroti perlunya integrasi yang lebih besar dari model instruksional yang berpusat pada pembelajar dan pemanfaatan sumber daya pengajaran yang lebih baik untuk mengurangi beban kerja instruksional.

tldr.en: This study examines the effectiveness of various teaching methods used by primary school teachers for Kadazandusun language instruction in Sabah. The findings reveal a positive overall perception of these instructional approaches among teachers.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengkaji efektivitas berbagai metode pengajaran yang digunakan oleh guru sekolah dasar untuk pengajaran bahasa Kadazandusun di Sabah. Temuan menunjukkan persepsi positif secara keseluruhan terhadap pendekatan instruksional ini di kalangan guru.

doi:10.33395/jmp.v15i2.16581.abstract: The rapid proliferation of digital connectivity in Indonesia has catalyzed an unprecedented surge in harmful online content, necessitating robust automated systems for hate speech detection that can generalize across diverse digital platforms. Traditional models often struggle with domain shift and the linguistic complexities of Indonesian social media discourse, including informal slang and code-mixing. This research proposes a multi-domain detection framework leveraging the IndoBERT-base-p1 architecture integrated with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), a parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) strategy. The study utilizes a multi-source corpus from Instagram, Twitter, and news portals, employing back-translation to augment scarce Instagram data and stratified downsampling to ensure domain equilibrium. By training only 1–2% of the total 110 million parameters, specifically targeting the query and value attention modules, the model achieves significant computational savings with a training loss of 0.345. Experimental results demonstrate high robustness, with the framework attaining F1-scores of 0.83 for both Instagram and Twitter, and 0.81 for news portals, while maintaining accuracies between 0.81 and 0.85. Qualitative validation through word cloud analysis further confirms the model's ability to distinguish between aggressive sociopolitical triggers and neutral functional discourse. This study contributes a scalable and resource-efficient solution for real-time content moderation, proving effective across both formal journalistic Indonesian and informal digital dialects. The findings indicate that IndoBERT+LoRA provides a promising and resource-efficient approach for multi-domain Indonesian hate and abusive speech classification, while stricter leave-one-domain-out evaluation remains an important direction for future work.

glossary.explanation_id: Sebuah metode *fine-tuning* yang efisien secara parameter dengan menginjeksikan matriks berperingkat rendah ke dalam lapisan *transformer*.
Strategi *fine-tuning* yang melatih hanya sebagian kecil parameter dari model *language model* yang besar.
Teknik augmentasi data dengan menerjemahkan teks ke bahasa lain lalu menerjemahkannya kembali ke bahasa asal untuk menghasilkan variasi sintaksis.
Metode pengurangan jumlah sampel data secara proporsional untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas atau *domain*.
Perubahan distribusi data antara data latih dan data uji yang berasal dari lingkungan atau platform yang berbeda.
Penggunaan dua bahasa atau lebih secara bergantian dalam satu kalimat atau percakapan.

background.en:
The rapid expansion of digital connectivity in Indonesia has led to a significant increase in harmful online content, making automated hate speech detection essential for social stability. However, detecting abusive language in Indonesian social media is hindered by domain shifts and linguistic complexities such as informal slang, known as alay, and code-mixing with regional dialects.

Traditional models struggle to generalize across diverse digital platforms like Instagram, Twitter, and news portals due to varying communication styles and data distributions. This research addresses the gap by developing a robust multi-domain detection framework capable of handling both formal journalistic text and informal social media discourse.
background.id:
Ekspansi konektivitas digital yang pesat di Indonesia telah menyebabkan peningkatan signifikan pada konten daring yang berbahaya, menjadikan deteksi ujaran kebencian otomatis sangat penting untuk stabilitas sosial. Kendati demikian, deteksi bahasa abusif di media sosial Indonesia terkendala oleh pergeseran *domain* dan kompleksitas linguistik seperti bahasa gaul informal yang dikenal sebagai alay serta pencampuran bahasa dengan dialek regional.

Model tradisional kesulitan untuk melakukan generalisasi di berbagai platform digital seperti Instagram, Twitter, dan portal berita karena variasi gaya komunikasi dan distribusi data. Penelitian ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan mengembangkan kerangka kerja deteksi *multi-domain* yang tangguh yang mampu menangani teks jurnalistik formal maupun wacana media sosial informal.

contributions.en:
This study contributes a scalable and resource-efficient multi-domain detection framework for Indonesian hate and abusive speech classification. By integrating Low-Rank Adaptation into the IndoBERT-base-p1 architecture, the model optimizes only 1 to 2 percent of its total parameters, specifically targeting the query and value attention modules.

Additionally, the research introduces a data augmentation pipeline using back-translation to address data scarcity in the Instagram domain, combined with stratified downsampling to ensure domain equilibrium across Instagram, Twitter, and news portal corpora.
contributions.id:
Studi ini berkontribusi menyediakan kerangka kerja deteksi *multi-domain* yang terskala dan efisien secara sumber daya untuk klasifikasi ujaran kebencian dan abusif bahasa Indonesia. Dengan mengintegrasikan *Low-Rank Adaptation* ke dalam arsitektur IndoBERT-base-p1, model ini mengoptimalkan hanya 1 hingga 2 persen dari total parameternya, dengan target khusus pada modul atensi *query* dan *value*.

Selain itu, penelitian ini memperkenalkan alur augmentasi data menggunakan *back-translation* untuk mengatasi kelangkaan data pada *domain* Instagram, yang dikombinasikan dengan *stratified downsampling* untuk memastikan ekuilibrium *domain* di seluruh korpus Instagram, Twitter, dan portal berita.

future_work.en: The authors suggest that future work should incorporate stricter cross-domain evaluation settings, such as leave-one-domain-out evaluation, where one domain is completely excluded from training and used exclusively for testing to rigorously assess true zero-shot domain generalization.
future_work.id: Penulis menyarankan agar pekerjaan di masa mendatang memasukkan pengaturan evaluasi lintas *domain* yang lebih ketat, seperti evaluasi *leave-one-domain-out*, di mana satu *domain* dikecualikan sepenuhnya dari pelatihan dan digunakan secara eksklusif untuk pengujian guna menilai generalisasi *domain zero-shot* secara ketat.

method.en:
The research utilizes a multi-source corpus comprising data from Twitter, Instagram, and news portals. Text preprocessing involved lowercase conversion, noise removal via regular expressions, and slang normalization using a colloquial lexicon. Data augmentation through back-translation was applied to the Instagram training set to double its size, followed by stratified downsampling to balance the dominant Twitter and news portal domains.

The model employs the indobert-base-p1 architecture with injected LoRA matrices, training approximately 1-2 percent of the parameters while keeping base weights frozen. Hyperparameter optimization was conducted via grid search, leading to a configuration with rank r = 4, alpha = 32, batch size of 8, AdamW optimizer, and mixed precision FP16. Evaluation was performed globally and per domain using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
method.id:
Penelitian ini menggunakan korpus multi-sumber yang mencakup data dari Twitter, Instagram, dan portal berita. Pra-pemrosesan teks melibatkan konversi huruf kecil, penghapusan derau melalui *regular expressions*, dan normalisasi slang menggunakan leksikon kolokial. Augmentasi data melalui *back-translation* diterapkan pada data latih Instagram untuk menggandakan ukurannya, diikuti oleh *stratified downsampling* untuk menyeimbangkan *domain* Twitter dan portal berita yang mendominasi.

Model ini menggunakan arsitektur indobert-base-p1 dengan matriks *LoRA* yang diinjeksikan, melatih sekitar 1-2 persen parameter sementara bobot dasar dibekukan. Optimasi *hiperparameter* dilakukan melalui *grid search*, menghasilkan konfigurasi dengan *rank* r = 4, alfa = 32, *batch size* 8, *optimizer* AdamW, dan *mixed precision* FP16. Evaluasi dilakukan secara global dan per *domain* menggunakan akurasi, *precision*, *recall*, dan *F1-score*.

related_work.en:
Previous research on Indonesian hate speech detection has transitioned from classical machine learning methods, such as Support Vector Machines, Naive Bayes, and Random Forest Decision Trees relying on manual feature extraction, to advanced deep learning and transformer-based architectures. While classical methods offer efficiency, they often achieve limited accuracy on complex datasets.

Recent studies have explored transformer models like IndoBERT and IndoBERTweet combined with architectures such as BiLSTM or Graph Neural Networks to capture sequential patterns and relational nuances. Despite these advancements, a persistent limitation in existing literature is the lack of generalization and evaluation across heterogeneous digital platforms.
related_work.id:
Penelitian sebelumnya mengenai deteksi ujaran kebencian bahasa Indonesia telah bergeser dari metode *machine learning* klasik, seperti *Support Vector Machines*, *Naive Bayes*, dan *Random Forest Decision Trees* yang mengandalkan ekstraksi fitur manual, menuju arsitektur *deep learning* dan *transformer* yang canggih. Meskipun metode klasik menawarkan efisiensi, metode tersebut seringkali mencapai akurasi yang terbatas pada *dataset* yang kompleks.

Studi-studi terbaru telah mengeksplorasi model *transformer* seperti IndoBERT dan IndoBERTweet yang dikombinasikan dengan arsitektur seperti *BiLSTM* atau *Graph Neural Networks* untuk menangkap pola sekuensial dan nuansa relasional. Terlepas dari kemajuan ini, keterbatasan yang persisten dalam literatur yang ada adalah kurangnya generalisasi dan evaluasi di berbagai platform digital yang heterogen.

results.en:
The fine-tuned IndoBERT+LoRA model demonstrated high robustness and rapid convergence with a training loss of 0.345 within 5 epochs. In per-domain evaluations, the framework achieved F1-scores of 0.83 for Instagram and Twitter, and 0.81 for news portals, with overall accuracies ranging between 0.81 and 0.85.

Qualitative validation through word clouds confirmed the model's ability to prioritize explicit derogatory terms and sociopolitical slurs in hate speech while recognizing neutral functional words in normal text. The authors note that while the model minimizes false negatives, a slight tendency toward false positives indicates a conservative bias when encountering emotionally charged non-hate text.
results.id:
Model IndoBERT+LoRA yang telah di-*fine-tune* menunjukkan ketahanan tinggi dan konvergensi cepat dengan *training loss* sebesar 0,345 dalam 5 *epoch*. Dalam evaluasi per *domain*, kerangka kerja ini mencapai *F1-score* sebesar 0,83 untuk Instagram dan Twitter, serta 0,81 untuk portal berita, dengan akurasi keseluruhan berkisar antara 0,81 hingga 0,85.

Validasi kualitatif melalui *word cloud* mengonfirmasi kemampuan model untuk memprioritaskan istilah deregatif eksplisit dan makian sosiopolitik dalam ujaran kebencian sambil mengenali kata fungsional netral pada teks normal. Penulis mencatat bahwa meskipun model meminimalkan *false negatives*, sedikit kecenderungan terhadap *false positives* mengindikasikan bias konservatif ketika menemui teks non-kebencian yang bermuatan emosional.

tldr.en: This research proposes a multi-domain hate speech detection framework using IndoBERT integrated with LoRA for Indonesian digital platforms. The model achieves strong performance across Instagram, Twitter, and news portals while training only a small fraction of its parameters.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengusulkan kerangka kerja deteksi ujaran kebencian *multi-domain* menggunakan IndoBERT yang diintegrasikan dengan *LoRA* untuk platform digital Indonesia. Model ini mencapai performa yang kuat di Instagram, Twitter, dan portal berita dengan melatih hanya sebagian kecil parameternya.

doi:10.33395/jmp.v15i2.16581.title: Indonesian Hate Speech Detection Across Diverse Domains Using Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with IndoBERT and LoRA

doi:10.33395/jmp.v15i3.16145.abstract: The Board of Peace is an international body initiated by U.S. President Donald Trump. The government’s decision to join this body has naturally sparked debate among the public, particularly on the social media platform X. The social media platform X (Twitter) is one of the best platforms for monitoring public opinion on various topics, including government policies—such as those implemented by President Prabowo Subianto. Twitter provides users with a space to follow the latest developments, participate in conversations, and express their opinions on public policy and leadership. In Indonesia, Twitter is frequently used for planning social events, sharing information, and voicing criticism or expectations toward national leaders. This study aims to analyze public sentiment regarding Indonesia’s joining the Board of Peace using the IndoBERT and NusaBERT algorithms. The dataset used, consisting of 290 data points, was obtained through data crawling techniques from the social media platform X. The research stages included Data Collection, Data Pre-Processing, Data Balancing, Fine-Tuning of the Transformer Model, and Model Evaluation (accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score). The results of this study show that the IndoBERT algorithm achieved an accuracy of 90%, while NusaBERT achieved an accuracy of 97%. This indicates that the NusaBERT algorithm has a 7% advantage in accuracy. This study underscores the importance of selecting the appropriate algorithm to enhance the performance of sentiment analysis systems on public policy topics.

glossary.explanation_id: Proses penyesuaian bobot pada *model bahasa* pralatih menggunakan *dataset* target tertentu.
Teknik pengumpulan data otomatis dari halaman web atau media sosial menggunakan skrip pemrogram.
Tahap penormalan teks untuk mengubah seluruh huruf kapital menjadi huruf kecil.
Prosedur penambahan sampel pada kelas minoritas untuk menyeimbangkan distribusi *dataset*.
Tabel evaluasi yang membandingkan prediksi model dengan label aktual untuk mengukur performa *klasifikasi*.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur ketepatan prediksi positif dari keseluruhan hasil prediksi positif.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur kemampuan model dalam menemukan kembali seluruh instans kelas positif.
Rata-rata harmonis dari *precision* dan *recall* yang memberikan ukuran performa *model* secara menyeluruh.

background.en:
The Indonesian government decision to join the Board of Peace, an international body initiated by U.S. President Donald Trump, has sparked widespread public debate. Monitoring public opinion regarding this government policy is essential for understanding societal perspectives. Platform X serves as a primary digital space where citizens voice opinions, criticisms, and expectations toward national leadership under President Prabowo Subianto.

Analyzing public sentiment from social media data presents challenges due to the volume and nuances of informal text. The paper addresses the need to evaluate how advanced transformer models process policy-related discourse in Indonesian, highlighting that algorithm selection directly impacts the performance of sentiment analysis systems.
background.id:
Keputusan pemerintah Indonesia untuk bergabung dengan *Board of Peace*, sebuah badan internasional yang diinisiasi oleh Presiden Amerika Serikat Donald Trump, telah memicu perdebatan luas di tengah masyarakat. Memantau opini publik mengenai kebijakan pemerintah ini sangat penting untuk memahami perspektif masyarakat. Platform X berfungsi sebagai ruang digital utama tempat warga menyuarakan pendapat, kritik, dan harapan terhadap kepemimpinan nasional di bawah Presiden Prabowo Subianto.

Menganalisis sentimen publik dari data media sosial menghadirkan tantangan karena volume dan nuansa teks informal. Makalah ini membahas kebutuhan untuk mengevaluasi bagaimana *model transformer* mutakhir memproses wacana terkait kebijakan dalam bahasa Indonesia, serta menekankan bahwa pemilihan algoritma berdampak langsung pada performa sistem analisis sentimen.

contributions.en:
The primary contribution of this research is a comparative evaluation of IndoBERT and NusaBERT applied specifically to public sentiment regarding Indonesia joining the Board of Peace. The study utilizes a crawled dataset from platform X subjected to a rigorous data preprocessing and balancing pipeline.

Additionally, the work provides empirical evidence showing the performance advantage of NusaBERT over IndoBERT in capturing regional language nuances within policy discussions. It establishes a clear benchmark for sentiment classification accuracy and metric evaluation in this specific geopolitical domain.
contributions.id:
Kontribusi utama dari penelitian ini adalah evaluasi komparatif antara *IndoBERT* dan *NusaBERT* yang diterapkan secara khusus pada sentimen publik mengenai bergabungnya Indonesia ke *Board of Peace*. Penelitian ini memanfaatkan *dataset* hasil *crawling* dari platform X yang melalui rangkaian *preprocessing* data dan penyeimbangan data yang ketat.

Selain itu, karya ini memberikan bukti empiris yang menunjukkan keunggulan performa *NusaBERT* atas *IndoBERT* dalam menangkap nuansa bahasa regional di dalam diskusi kebijakan. Penelitian ini menetapkan *benchmark* yang jelas untuk akurasi klasifikasi sentimen dan evaluasi metrik pada domain geopolitik khusus ini.

future_work.en: The paper does not discuss future work in detail.
future_work.id: Makalah tidak membahas pekerjaan masa depan secara rinci.

method.en:
The research methodology follows a systematic pipeline consisting of problem identification, data collection, data preprocessing, data balancing, transformer model fine-tuning, and model evaluation. Data collection involved scraping 290 tweets from platform X using Tweet-Harvest via Node.js based on relevant keywords. The data was stored in CSV format and processed using Python in Google Colab.

Data preprocessing included cleaning to remove URLs, punctuation, hashtags, HTML tags, and symbols, followed by case folding and automated lexicon-based labeling into positive, negative, and neutral classes. To address class imbalance where the neutral class dominated, random oversampling was applied. The dataset was split into 80 percent training data and 20 percent testing data. Fine-tuning utilized HuggingFace Transformers and PyTorch for IndoBERT and NusaBERT, while evaluation metrics comprised accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score derived from a Multiclass Confusion Matrix 3x3.
method.id:
Metodologi penelitian mengikuti alur sistematis yang terdiri dari identifikasi masalah, pengumpulan data, *preprocessing* data, penyeimbangan data, *fine-tuning model transformer*, dan evaluasi model. Pengumpulan data melibatkan *scraping* 290 tweet dari platform X menggunakan *Tweet-Harvest* melalui *Node.js* berdasarkan kata kunci yang relevan. Data disimpan dalam format CSV dan diproses menggunakan *Python* di *Google Colab*.

*Preprocessing* data mencakup *cleaning* untuk menghapus URL, tanda baca, *hashtag*, tag HTML, dan simbol, dilanjutkan dengan *case folding* dan pelabelan otomatis berbasis *lexicon* ke dalam kelas positif, negatif, dan netral. Untuk mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas di mana kelas netral mendominasi, diterapkan *oversampling* acak. *Dataset* dibagi menjadi 80 persen data latih dan 20 persen data uji. *Fine-tuning* memanfaatkan *HuggingFace Transformers* dan *PyTorch* untuk *IndoBERT* dan *NusaBERT*, sementara metrik evaluasi mencakup *accuracy*, *precision*, *recall*, dan *F1-score* yang diperoleh dari *Multiclass Confusion Matrix* 3x3.

related_work.en:
The study builds upon prior research utilizing transformer models for sentiment analysis in Indonesian political and social contexts. Previous investigations applied IndoBERT to free nutritious meal policy sentiment and political hoax detection, achieving high accuracy rates. Other works explored NusaBERT for sentiment classification of football supporters and LGBT issues on platform X.

These prior studies demonstrated that models like IndoBERT and NusaBERT maintain robust baseline accuracies ranging from 70 percent to 90 percent. However, the authors note that comparative evaluations specifically targeting international policy decisions like the Board of Peace using these regional transformer variants remain necessary.
related_work.id:
Penelitian ini dibangun berdasarkan studi terdahulu yang memanfaatkan *model transformer* untuk analisis sentimen dalam konteks politik dan sosial di Indonesia. Investigasi sebelumnya menerapkan *IndoBERT* pada sentimen kebijakan makan bergizi gratis dan deteksi hoaks politik, serta mencapai tingkat akurasi yang tinggi. Karya lain mengeksplorasi *NusaBERT* untuk klasifikasi sentimen suporter sepak bola dan isu LGBT di platform X.

Studi-studi terdahulu ini menunjukkan bahwa model seperti *IndoBERT* dan *NusaBERT* mempertahankan akurasi dasar yang andal pada kisaran 70 persen hingga 90 persen. Namun, para penulis mencatat bahwa evaluasi komparatif yang secara khusus menargetkan keputusan kebijakan internasional seperti *Board of Peace* menggunakan varian *transformer* regional ini masih tetap diperlukan.

results.en:
The experimental results demonstrate that NusaBERT outperforms IndoBERT across all evaluated performance metrics. NusaBERT achieved an accuracy of 0.97 or 97 percent, a precision of 0.99, a recall of 0.90, and an F1-score of 0.94. In contrast, IndoBERT achieved an accuracy of 0.90 or 90 percent, a precision of 0.63, a recall of 0.57, and an F1-score of 0.59.

The authors interpret these findings as proof that NusaBERT possesses a 7 percent accuracy advantage and is more effective at representing the dataset. This performance difference highlights the significance of utilizing models trained on specific regional language data when analyzing public policy sentiment.
results.id:
Hasil eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *NusaBERT* unggul daripada *IndoBERT* pada semua metrik performa yang dievaluasi. *NusaBERT* mencapai akurasi sebesar 0,97 atau 97 persen, *precision* 0,99, *recall* 0,90, dan *F1-score* 0,94. Sebaliknya, *IndoBERT* mencapai akurasi sebesar 0,90 atau 90 persen, *precision* 0,63, *recall* 0,57, dan *F1-score* 0,59.

Para penulis menginterpretasikan temuan ini sebagai bukti bahwa *NusaBERT* memiliki keunggulan akurasi sebesar 7 persen dan lebih efektif dalam merepresentasikan *dataset*. Perbedaan performa ini menyoroti signifikansi penggunaan model yang dilatih pada data bahasa regional tertentu saat menganalisis sentimen kebijakan publik.

tldr.en: This study analyzes public sentiment on platform X regarding Indonesia joining the Board of Peace using IndoBERT and NusaBERT models. The results demonstrate that NusaBERT achieves a superior accuracy of 97 percent compared to IndoBERT at 90 percent.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini menganalisis sentimen publik pada platform X terkait bergabungnya Indonesia ke *Board of Peace* menggunakan model *IndoBERT* dan *NusaBERT*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa *NusaBERT* mencapai akurasi yang lebih unggul sebesar 97 persen dibandingkan *IndoBERT* sebesar 90 persen.

doi:10.33395/jmp.v15i3.16145.title: Analisis Perspektif Mengenai Kebijakan Pemerintah Bergabung Dengan Board Of Peace Menggunakan IndoBERT dan NusaBERT

doi:10.33395/sinkron.v10i3.16294.abstract: Depression has become a major mental health issue in Indonesia, where approximately 167 million of the country’s 273 million citizens actively use social media platforms such as X (Twitter). The informal writing style, code-mixing, and linguistic variability in Indonesian tweets create significant challenges for automated depression detection systems. This study evaluates a fine-tuned IndoBERT model combined with a Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier for detecting depression-related indications from Indonesian-language tweets. A total of 10,082 Indonesian tweets were collected and labeled into two categories: Terindikasi Depresi and Tidak Terindikasi; after deduplication, 3,874 unique tweets were used for modeling. Two scenarios were compared: (1) a fine-tuned IndoBERT model, and (2) fine-tuned IndoBERT CLS embeddings with a linear SVM classifier. The fine-tuned IndoBERT model achieved 73.20% accuracy (AUC-ROC = 0.8212), while the hybrid approach achieved a marginally higher 73.71% accuracy (AUC-ROC = 0.8088); a McNemar’s test found this difference not statistically significant (p = 0.86). Both models outperformed five traditional TF-IDF-based baselines (best: 70.36%) on the same held-out test set. The hybrid model required only 0.01 MB of storage versus 475.24 MB for the full fine-tuned model. Given statistically equivalent accuracy, combining fine-tuned IndoBERT embeddings with SVM offers substantially lower storage requirements at no measurable cost in classification performance, making it a promising, resource-efficient approach for depression detection on Indonesian social media.

glossary.explanation_id: IndoBERT adalah *model bahasa* berbasis *transformer* yang telah dilatih sebelumnya pada korpus teks bahasa Indonesia skala besar.
*Support Vector Machine* adalah algoritma *machine learning* yang mencari hiperbidang optimal untuk memisahkan kelas data yang berbeda.
*Fine-tuning* adalah proses melatih ulang *model bahasa* praterlatih pada tugas hilir tertentu menggunakan *data* beranotasi.
*Embeddings* adalah representasi vektor numerik padat dari teks yang menangkap makna semantik dan kontekstual.
*TF-IDF* adalah metode pembobotan statistik tradisional yang mengukur seberapa penting suatu kata dalam dokumen relatif terhadap korpus.
AUC-ROC adalah metrik evaluasi yang mengukur kemampuan diskriminatif model klasifikasi pada berbagai ambang batas keputusan.
*Transformer* adalah arsitektur *deep learning* yang mengandalkan mekanisme *self-attention* untuk memproses data sekuensial.
*Tokenization* adalah proses memecah teks masukan menjadi unit-unit kecil yang disebut token sebelum diproses oleh model.

background.en: Depression is a major global and national health concern, affecting millions of people worldwide and in Indonesia. With millions of active social media users on platforms like X, online textual data has become a valuable resource for identifying psychological conditions. However, detecting depression from Indonesian-language tweets is challenging due to informal writing styles, slang, code-mixing, and non-standard spelling. These linguistic variations reduce the effectiveness of traditional text classification and present hurdles for transformer-based models.
background.id: Depresi adalah masalah kesehatan global dan nasional yang utama, memengaruhi jutaan orang di seluruh dunia dan di Indonesia. Dengan jutaan pengguna aktif media sosial di platform seperti X, data teks daring telah menjadi sumber daya yang berharga untuk mengidentifikasi kondisi psikologis. Namun, mendeteksi depresi dari cuitan berbahasa Indonesia menjadi tantangan tersendiri karena gaya penulisan yang informal, bahasa gaul, campur kode, dan ejaan non-standar. Variasi linguistik ini mengurangi efektivitas klasifikasi teks tradisional dan menghadirkan hambatan bagi *model bahasa* berbasis *transformer*.

contributions.en: This study makes three main contributions to Indonesian depression detection. First, it provides a systematic evaluation of IndoBERT fine-tuning using a publicly available dataset of Indonesian tweets. Second, it demonstrates that a hybrid IndoBERT-SVM model matches the fully fine-tuned model's classification performance while reducing storage requirements by approximately 47,524 times. Third, it presents a comparative analysis of model performance using accuracy, AUC-ROC, confusion matrices, and storage efficiency.
contributions.id: Studi ini memberikan tiga kontribusi utama untuk deteksi depresi berbahasa Indonesia. Pertama, penelitian ini menyediakan evaluasi sistematis terhadap *fine-tuning* IndoBERT menggunakan dataset cuitan bahasa Indonesia yang tersedia untuk umum. Kedua, penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa model hibrida IndoBERT-SVM mampu menyamai kinerja klasifikasi dari model yang di-*fine-tune* penuh sekaligus mengurangi kebutuhan penyimpanan hingga sekitar 47.524 kali lipat. Ketiga, penelitian ini menyajikan analisis komparatif kinerja model menggunakan akurasi, AUC-ROC, *confusion matrix*, dan efisiensi penyimpanan.

future_work.en: The authors note several limitations, including the lack of independent validation of dataset labels by mental health professionals, regional data coverage limitations, and the absence of explainable AI methods and multimodal features. Future work includes applying explainable-AI techniques like SHAP or LIME, incorporating multimodal information such as images or audio, exploring continual learning strategies, conducting domain adaptation, evaluating large language models, and performing a clinically-supervised validation study.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat beberapa keterbatasan, termasuk kurangnya validasi independen terhadap label dataset oleh profesional kesehatan mental, batasan cakupan data regional, serta ketiadaan metode *explainable AI* dan fitur multimodal. Penelitian masa depan mencakup penerapan teknik *explainable-AI* seperti SHAP atau LIME, memasukkan informasi multimodal seperti gambar atau audio, mengeksplorasi strategi *continual learning*, melakukan adaptasi domain, mengevaluasi *large language model*, dan melaksanakan studi validasi yang diawasi secara klinis.

method.en: The study uses a public dataset of 10,082 Indonesian tweets collected via the Twitter API, which was deduplicated to 3,874 unique tweets. Two main scenarios were evaluated: a fine-tuned IndoBERT model using selective layer unfreezing, and a hybrid model extracting 768-dimensional CLS embeddings from the fine-tuned IndoBERT to train a linear Support Vector Machine classifier. The dataset was split into 80 percent training, 10 percent validation, and 10 percent test sets. Evaluation metrics included accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and AUC-ROC.
method.id: Studi ini menggunakan dataset publik berisi 10.082 cuitan bahasa Indonesia yang dikumpulkan melalui API Twitter, yang kemudian dideplikasi menjadi 3.874 cuitan unik. Dua skenario utama dievaluasi: model IndoBERT yang di-*fine-tune* menggunakan pembekuan lapisan selektif, dan model hibrida yang mengekstrak *embedding* CLS berdimensi 768 dari IndoBERT yang telah di-*fine-tune* untuk melatih pengklasifikasi *Support Vector Machine* linier. Dataset dibagi menjadi 80 persen untuk pelatihan, 10 persen validasi, dan 10 persen pengujian. Metrik evaluasi mencakup akurasi, *precision*, *recall*, *F1-score*, dan AUC-ROC.

related_work.en: Previous research has explored natural language processing and deep learning for mental health analysis on social media. While transformer-based models like BERT and IndoBERT capture contextual semantic information effectively, they generally require large storage capacities and computational resources, making them less practical for resource-constrained environments. Other studies have investigated transformer embeddings combined with classical classifiers such as Support Vector Machines to achieve competitive performance with lower computational complexity.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah mengeksplorasi *natural language processing* dan *deep learning* untuk analisis kesehatan mental di media sosial. Meskipun *model bahasa* berbasis *transformer* seperti BERT and IndoBERT menangkap informasi semantik kontekstual secara efektif, mereka umumnya membutuhkan kapasitas penyimpanan dan sumber daya komputasi yang besar, sehingga kurang praktis untuk lingkungan dengan keterbatasan sumber daya. Studi lain telah menyelidiki *embedding* *transformer* yang dikombinasikan dengan pengklasifikasi klasik seperti *Support Vector Machine* untuk mencapai kinerja yang kompetitif dengan kompleksitas komputasi yang lebih rendah.

results.en: The fine-tuned IndoBERT model achieved an accuracy of 73.20 percent with an AUC-ROC of 0.8212, while the hybrid IndoBERT-SVM approach achieved a slightly higher accuracy of 73.71 percent with an AUC-ROC of 0.8088. A McNemar test confirmed that this performance difference was not statistically significant. Both models outperformed five traditional TF-IDF-based machine learning baselines. Crucially, the hybrid model required only 0.01 MB of storage compared to 475.24 MB for the full fine-tuned model, providing significant efficiency without sacrificing performance.
results.id: Model IndoBERT yang di-*fine-tune* mencapai akurasi sebesar 73,20 persen dengan AUC-ROC 0,8212, sementara pendekatan hibrida IndoBERT-SVM mencapai akurasi yang sedikit lebih tinggi yaitu 73,71 persen dengan AUC-ROC 0,8088. Uji McNemar mengonfirmasi bahwa perbedaan kinerja ini tidak signifikan secara statistik. Kedua model mengungguli lima *baseline* *machine learning* berbasis TF-IDF tradisional. Yang krusial, model hibrida hanya memerlukan penyimpanan 0,01 MB dibandingkan dengan 475,24 MB untuk model yang di-*fine-tune* secara penuh, memberikan efisiensi yang signifikan tanpa mengorbankan kinerja.

tldr.en: This study evaluates a fine-tuned IndoBERT model and a hybrid IndoBERT with Support Vector Machine approach for depression detection on Indonesian tweets. The hybrid model achieves statistically equivalent accuracy while drastically reducing model storage size.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengevaluasi model *fine-tuning* IndoBERT dan pendekatan hibrida IndoBERT dengan *Support Vector Machine* untuk deteksi depresi pada cuitan bahasa Indonesia. Model hibrida mencapai akurasi yang setara secara statistik sekaligus mengurangi ukuran penyimpanan model secara drastis.

doi:10.33395/sinkron.v10i3.16294.title: Depression Detection on Indonesian Social Media Using Fine-Tuned IndoBERT and SVM

doi:10.33480/jitk.v12i1.8222.abstract: Research on sarcasm detection in sentences generally focuses on English and the national languages of certain countries, so that regional languages such as Palembang are still underrepresented in NLP research. This study aims to classify sarcasm in Palembang sentences by applying 12 models and evaluating their performance using a dataset containing 1,952 manually annotated samples. The experiment was also conducted using a 5-fold cross-validation scheme, and the statistical significance of the test results was analyzed using the Friedman t-test ( =41.96, FF=12.90). Contrary to common expectations, the Ensemble classifier achieved the best overall performance, attaining a mean F1-score of 0.877 and outperforming larger pre-trained and dialect-specific models. Even though it is still in the same language family, MelayuBERT's performance is very far behind (F1:0.691). Furthermore, the relatively lower performance of IndoBERT-1.5G (0.731) suggests that model scale alone does not guarantee effectiveness in low-resource language settings. These findings highlight the robustness of feature-engineered classical models compared to large-scale or dialect-specific pre-trained models for sarcasm detection in low-resource regional languages. Our research results with datasets sourced from varied domains have exceeded several national benchmarks. This study can be a baseline for further research.

The results show that the Ensemble classifier outperforms larger pre-trained models, demonstrating the effectiveness of classical approaches in low-resource settings.

doi:10.33480/jitk.v12i1.8327.abstract: Sentiment analysis of hospital patient reviews plays a critical role in evaluating healthcare service quality. However, limited labeled data and class imbalance often affect classification performance and reduce minority-class detection. This study empirically investigates the impact of text augmentation techniques on improving IndoBERT performance for sentiment classification of patient reviews at Dr. Mohammad Hoesin Palembang General Hospital. A total of 1,464 reviews were collected, preprocessed, and weakly labeled using a VADER-based approach, resulting in 1,168 positive and 296 negative instances. To address class imbalance, augmentation was applied exclusively to the training set using back-translation and Easy Data Augmentation (EDA), including synonym replacement, random insertion, random swap, and random deletion. IndoBERT was fine-tuned under consistent hyperparameter settings and evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-macro, and AUC. The baseline model achieved an F1-macro of 70.2%, indicating limited minority-class sensitivity. After augmentation, the random swap technique achieved the highest observed performance within the experimental setup, reaching 96.8% accuracy, 95.3% F1-macro, and 98.9% AUC. These results suggest improved performance within the experimental setting, particularly in minority-class detection. However, it should be noted that the labels were generated through a translation-based weak labeling approach, which may introduce noise and affect the accuracy of the labels. Therefore, the findings should be interpreted within the scope of this experimental setting.

glossary.explanation_id: Teknik *text augmentation* adalah proses memperbanyak *data* teks buatan untuk memperkaya *training set*.
Metode *weak labeling* adalah pelabelan *data* secara otomatis menggunakan aturan atau model heuristik alih-alih anotasi manual.
Kondisi *class imbalance* terjadi ketika jumlah sampel antar-kelas dalam *dataset* sangat tidak seimbang.
Proses *fine-tuning* melibatkan pelatihan lanjutan pada *pretrained model* menggunakan *data* spesifik tugas.
Teknik *back-translation* dilakukan dengan menerjemahkan teks ke bahasa lain lalu menerjemahkannya kembali ke bahasa asli.
Metrik *F1-macro* menghitung rata-rata skor F1 dari seluruh kelas secara merata tanpa memedulikan ukuran kelas.
Sebuah *baseline model* digunakan sebagai titik acuan awal untuk membandingkan performa model baru.
Nilai *AUC* mengukur kemampuan model dalam membedakan antar-kelas pada berbagai ambang batas klasifikasi.

background.en: Sentiment analysis of hospital patient reviews is critical for evaluating healthcare service quality. However, limited labeled data and class imbalance often degrade classification performance and hinder the accurate detection of minority classes. This study addresses these challenges by investigating sentiment classification for patient reviews at Dr. Mohammad Hoesin Palembang General Hospital.
background.id: *Sentiment analysis* dari ulasan pasien rumah sakit sangat krusial untuk mengevaluasi kualitas layanan kesehatan. Namun, keterbatasan *data* beranotasi dan ketidakseimbangan kelas sering kali menurunkan performa klasifikasi serta menghambat deteksi kelas minoritas secara akurat. Studi ini mengatasi tantangan tersebut dengan menyelidiki klasifikasi *sentiment* pada ulasan pasien di RSUD Dr. Mohammad Hoesin Palembang.

contributions.en: The study empirically evaluates the impact of multiple text augmentation techniques specifically tailored to improve IndoBERT performance for healthcare review classification. It demonstrates how techniques such as back-translation and Easy Data Augmentation can alleviate class imbalance issues in low-resource sentiment datasets.
contributions.id: Studi ini mengevaluasi secara empiris dampak berbagai teknik *text augmentation* yang dirancang khusus untuk meningkatkan performa *IndoBERT* pada klasifikasi ulasan kesehatan. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bagaimana teknik seperti *back-translation* dan *Easy Data Augmentation* dapat mengatasi masalah ketidakseimbangan kelas pada *dataset* *sentiment* bersumber daya rendah.

future_work.en: The authors note that the dataset relied on a translation-based weak labeling approach, which may introduce label noise and affect accuracy. Consequently, they emphasize that the findings should be interpreted strictly within the scope of this experimental setting.
future_work.id: Para penulis mencatat bahwa *dataset* mengandalkan pendekatan *weak labeling* berbasis terjemahan, yang dapat menimbulkan derau label dan memengaruhi akurasi. Oleh karena itu, mereka menekankan bahwa temuan tersebut harus diinterpretasikan secara ketat dalam cakupan pengaturan eksperimental ini.

method.en: A total of 1,464 reviews were collected, preprocessed, and weakly labeled using a VADER-based approach, producing 1,168 positive and 296 negative instances. To mitigate class imbalance, augmentation was restricted to the training set using back-translation and Easy Data Augmentation, which includes synonym replacement, random insertion, random swap, and random deletion. IndoBERT was fine-tuned under uniform hyperparameter settings and evaluated using accuracy, precision, recall, F1-macro, and AUC metrics.
method.id: Sebanyak 1.464 ulasan dikumpulkan, dipraproses, dan diberi label secara lemah menggunakan pendekatan berbasis *VADER*, menghasilkan 1.168 instans positif dan 296 negatif. Untuk memitigasi ketidakseimbangan kelas, *augmentation* dibatasi pada *training set* menggunakan *back-translation* dan *Easy Data Augmentation*, yang mencakup *synonym replacement*, *random insertion*, *random swap*, dan *random deletion*. *IndoBERT* di-*fine-tune* di bawah pengaturan *hyperparameter* yang seragam dan dievaluasi menggunakan metrik *accuracy*, *precision*, *recall*, *F1-macro*, dan *AUC*.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas *related work* secara mendetail.

results.en: The baseline model attained an F1-macro of 70.2%, reflecting poor sensitivity toward the minority class. Following augmentation, the random swap technique achieved the highest performance within the experimental setup, yielding 96.8% accuracy, 95.3% F1-macro, and 98.9% AUC, thereby demonstrating substantial improvements in minority-class detection.
results.id: *Baseline model* mencapai *F1-macro* sebesar 70,2%, yang mencerminkan rendahnya sensitivitas terhadap kelas minoritas. Setelah *augmentation*, teknik *random swap* mencapai performa tertinggi dalam pengaturan eksperimental, menghasilkan *accuracy* 96,8%, *F1-macro* 95,3%, dan *AUC* 98,9%, sehingga menunjukkan peningkatan substansial dalam deteksi kelas minoritas.

tldr.en: This paper investigates the impact of text augmentation techniques on IndoBERT performance for hospital review sentiment analysis. The results show that random swap augmentation significantly improves classification performance and minority-class detection.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyelidiki dampak teknik *text augmentation* terhadap performa *IndoBERT* untuk *sentiment analysis* ulasan rumah sakit. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *random swap augmentation* secara signifikan meningkatkan performa klasifikasi dan deteksi kelas minoritas.

doi:10.33545/26646021.2026.v8.i9b.1282.abstract: Critical scholarship increasingly characterizes the global expansion of artificial intelligence as a contin-uation of colonialism, a description which is politically serviceable and analytically loose. Technologyfirms hold no territory, command no armed force and exercise no legal sovereignty over other states, soequating platform capitalism with territorial conquest reduces colonialism to a metaphor. The defensiblecomparison is not with colonialism but with coloniality, the durable patterns of hierarchy and depen-dence which outlasted formal empire. Proceeding from that distinction, the article disaggregates a claimwhich is ordinarily made whole. Algorithmic bias is traced through four separable stages, from pretrain-ing corpora through representation and alignment to deployment, each of which admits a different rem-edy. Linguistic disadvantage is located in the mechanics of tokenization rather than cultural preference,which converts a symbolic harm into a measurable quantity. The Global South is disaggregated by statecapacity, and Southern states treated as potential agents of digital control rather than only its subjects.Digital labor is separated into data subjects, annotators and low-resource language communities, whoseinterests do not coincide. Fanon's account of psychic alienation is retained as a hypothesis which re-quires validation. A paradox in the proposed remedies is identified, model sovereignty is attainablewithout computer sovereignty, and sovereign artificial intelligence built on rented infrastructure relo-cates dependency without reducing it. A six-dimension framework with named indicators is offered sothat competing claims may be assessed rather than asserted.

glossary.explanation_id: Kolonialitas mengacu pada pola hierarki dan ketergantungan yang bertahan lama setelah era kekaisaran formal berakhir.
*Tokenization* adalah proses memecah teks menjadi unit-unit kecil seperti kata atau subkata sebelum diproses oleh *large language model*.
Bias algoritmik adalah penyimpangan sistematis dalam keluaran model yang menghasilkan diskriminasi atau kerugian bagi kelompok tertentu.
Kedaulatan model adalah kondisi ketika suatu entitas memiliki kendali atas *artificial intelligence* yang digunakan tanpa harus memiliki infrastruktur komputasi yang mendasarinya.

background.en: Critical scholarship increasingly characterizes the global expansion of artificial intelligence as a continuation of colonialism. However, technology firms hold no territory or legal sovereignty, making this equation a loose metaphor rather than an accurate description. The paper addresses the gap by shifting the comparison to coloniality, which refers to durable patterns of hierarchy and dependence that outlasted formal empires.
background.id: Kajian kritis semakin mengkarakterisasi ekspansi global dari *artificial intelligence* sebagai kelanjutan dari kolonialisme. Namun, perusahaan teknologi tidak memiliki wilayah atau kedaulatan hukum, sehingga persamaan ini menjadi metafora yang longgar alih-alih deskripsi yang akurat. Artikel ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan mengalihkan perbandingan ke kolonialitas, yang mengacu pada pola hierarki dan ketergantungan yang bertahan lama setelah kekaisaran formal berakhir.

contributions.en: The article contributes by disaggregating claims typically treated as a whole in AI governance debates. It traces algorithmic bias through four stages, locates linguistic disadvantage in tokenization mechanics, distinguishes roles in digital labor, and introduces a six-dimension framework with named indicators to assess competing claims.
contributions.id: Artikel ini memberikan kontribusi dengan memilah klaim yang biasanya dianggap sebagai satu kesatuan dalam perdebatan tata kelola *artificial intelligence*. Artikel ini melacak bias algoritmik melalui empat tahap, menemukan kerugian linguistik pada mekanisme *tokenization*, membedakan peran dalam tenaga kerja digital, dan memperkenalkan kerangka enam dimensi dengan indikator bernama untuk menilai klaim yang bersaing.

future_work.en: The authors retain Fanon's account of psychic alienation as a hypothesis requiring validation, pointing to future investigations needed to verify psychological impacts in digital contexts.
future_work.id: Para penulis mempertahankan pemaparan Fanon tentang alienasi psikis sebagai hipotesis yang memerlukan validasi, yang mengarah pada investigasi masa depan yang diperlukan untuk memverifikasi dampak psikologis dalam konteks digital.

method.en: The paper does not discuss a specific empirical method or dataset in detail.
method.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas metode empiris atau *dataset* tertentu secara mendetail.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas karya terkait secara mendetail.

results.en: The analysis finds that linguistic disadvantage stems from tokenization mechanics rather than cultural preference, converting symbolic harm into a measurable quantity. Furthermore, the authors identify a paradox where model sovereignty is attainable without computer sovereignty, meaning sovereign artificial intelligence built on rented infrastructure relocates dependency instead of reducing it.
results.id: Analisis tersebut menemukan bahwa kerugian linguistik berasal dari mekanisme *tokenization* alih-alih preferensi budaya, yang mengubah kerugian simbolis menjadi kuantitas yang dapat diukur. Selain itu, para penulis mengidentifikasi sebuah paradoks di mana kedaulatan model dapat dicapai tanpa kedaulatan komputer, yang berarti *artificial intelligence* berdaulat yang dibangun di atas infrastruktur sewaan memindahkan ketergantungan alih-alih menguranginya.

tldr.en: This paper reframes the expansion of artificial intelligence through the lens of coloniality rather than territorial colonialism. It disaggregates algorithmic bias, linguistic disadvantage, and digital labor to provide a six-dimension framework for AI governance.
tldr.id: Artikel ini membingkai ulang perluasan *artificial intelligence* melalui lensa kolonialitas alih-alih kolonialisme teritorial. Artikel ini memilah bias algoritmik, kerugian linguistik, dan tenaga kerja digital untuk menyediakan kerangka enam dimensi bagi tata kelola *artificial intelligence*.

doi:10.33545/27076571.2026.v7.i8a.364.abstract: Parts-of-Speech (PoS) tagging and Named Entity Recognition (NER) are fundamental tasks in Natural Language Processing (NLP), supporting downstream applications such as machine translation, information extraction, and sentiment analysis. While these tasks have achieved strong performance in high-resource languages like English, many low-resource languages remain underexplored due to the lack of annotated corpora and computational tools. Tulu - a Dravidian language spoken in coastal Karnataka, India - is one such language, with only limited work on PoS tagging as well as NER. To address this gap, in this paper, we present manually constructed Tulu datasets annotated with 18 PoS tags and 37 NER tags for PoS Tagging and NER respectively. We establish baselines using traditional Machine Learning (ML) algorithms trained with feature fusion of handcrafted features and character embeddings, as well as hybrid models that combine Deep Learning (DL) architectures with Conditional Random Field (CRF). This hybrid design integrates both character and word embeddings to capture richer contextual and morphological information. While the DL component learns long-range dependencies in sequential data, CRF layer ensures globally consistent and valid label sequences by modeling dependencies among output tags. Results demonstrate that hybrid models consistently outperform traditional approaches for both PoS tagging and NER. In summary, this study introduces the first Tulu PoS and NER datasets and strong baselines, laying the foundation for future NLP research in Tulu.

glossary.explanation_id: Proses penetapan kategori gramatikal atau kelas kata pada setiap kata dalam sebuah kalimat.
Tugas ekstraksi informasi untuk mengidentifikasi dan mengklasifikasikan entitas bernama ke dalam kategori yang telah ditentukan.
Model *diskriminatif* probabilistik yang sering digunakan untuk pemodelan data sekuensial.
Metode penggabungan representasi vektor fitur dengan cara merangkainya secara berurutan.
Sifat morfologis bahasa di mana kata dibentuk dengan menggabungkan morfem-morfem tanpa banyak mengubah bentuk dasarnya.
Arsitektur *recurrent neural network* dua arah yang menggunakan *gated recurrent unit* untuk memproses data sekuensial.

background.en: Parts-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition are fundamental sequence labeling tasks in natural language processing that support downstream applications such as machine translation, information extraction, and sentiment analysis. While these tasks achieve strong performance in high-resource languages like English, many low-resource languages remain underexplored due to a lack of annotated corpora and computational tools. Tulu, a Dravidian language spoken in coastal Karnataka, India, is one such language that lacks digital content and datasets, further complicated by its agglutinative morphology and orthographic inconsistencies.
background.id: Penandaan *part-of-speech* dan *named entity recognition* adalah tugas pelabelan urutan fundamental dalam pemrosesan bahasa alami yang mendukung aplikasi hilir seperti *terjemahan mesin*, *ekstraksi informasi*, dan analisis sentimen. Meskipun tugas-tugas ini mencapai performa tinggi pada bahasa *high-resource* seperti bahasa Inggris, banyak bahasa *low-resource* yang masih kurang dieksplorasi karena kurangnya korpus beranotasi dan alat komputasi. Bahasa Tulu, sebuah bahasa Dravida yang dituturkan di pesisir Karnataka, India, adalah salah satu bahasa yang kekurangan konten digital dan dataset, yang semakin diperumit oleh morfologi aglutinatif dan inkonsistensi ortografisnya.

contributions.en: This study makes several key contributions to advancing natural language processing research in Tulu. It introduces the first manually constructed and structured datasets for part-of-speech tagging and named entity recognition in Tulu, derived from educational textbooks and online newspapers. Additionally, the paper establishes strong baselines using traditional machine learning algorithms with feature fusion and character embeddings, as well as hybrid neural models combining recurrent architectures with conditional random fields.
contributions.id: Studi ini memberikan beberapa kontribusi penting untuk memajukan penelitian pemrosesan bahasa alami dalam bahasa Tulu. Studi ini memperkenalkan dataset terstruktur yang dibangun secara manual yang pertama untuk penandaan *part-of-speech* dan *named entity recognition* dalam bahasa Tulu, yang bersumber dari buku teks pendidikan dan surat kabar daring. Selain itu, makalah ini menetapkan *baseline* yang kuat menggunakan algoritma *machine learning* tradisional dengan fusi fitur dan *embedding* karakter, serta model saraf hibrida yang menggabungkan arsitektur rekuren dengan *conditional random field*.

future_work.en: The authors state that future work will focus on expanding the annotated corpus to improve model accuracy and generalization. They also aim to explore transformer-based architectures such as mBERT and XLM-RoBERTa to better capture contextual and semantic information for low-resource languages.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyatakan bahwa pekerjaan di masa mendatang akan berfokus pada perluasan korpus beranotasi untuk meningkatkan akurasi dan generalisasi model. Mereka juga bertujuan untuk mengeksplorasi arsitektur berbasis *transformer* seperti *mBERT* dan *XLM-RoBERTa* untuk menangkap informasi kontekstual dan semantik dengan lebih baik bagi bahasa *low-resource*.

method.en: The authors collected approximately 7,500 sentences from Tulu textbooks and the online newspaper Times of Kudla, resulting in 7,206 cleaned sentences and 123,822 tokens after preprocessing. The dataset was annotated with an 18-tag part-of-speech tagset based on Universal Dependencies and a 37-tag named entity recognition tagset following the BIO format. Two sets of baseline models were implemented: traditional machine learning classifiers trained on sparse feature matrices and character embeddings, and hybrid neural models combining recurrent architectures like LSTM, BiLSTM, GRU, and BiGRU with a conditional random field output layer.
method.id: Para penulis mengumpulkan sekitar 7.500 kalimat dari buku teks Tulu dan surat kabar daring Times of Kudla, yang menghasilkan 7.206 kalimat bersih dan 123.822 token setelah *pra-pemrosesan*. Dataset tersebut dianotasi dengan *tagset* *part-of-speech* 18 tag berdasarkan *Universal Dependencies* dan *tagset* *named entity recognition* 37 tag yang mengikuti format BIO. Dua set model *baseline* diimplementasikan: pengklasifikasi *machine learning* tradisional yang dilatih pada matriks fitur berjarak dan *embedding* karakter, serta model saraf hibrida yang menggabungkan arsitektur rekuren seperti *LSTM*, *BiLSTM*, *GRU*, dan *BiGRU* dengan lapisan keluaran *conditional random field*.

related_work.en: Research in low-resource sequence labeling has evolved from rule-based and statistical methods to modern deep learning and transformer-based architectures. Early approaches for Indian languages heavily relied on handcrafted rules and statistical models like conditional random fields, which achieved competitive results for languages like Kannada. Subsequent work explored recurrent neural networks and pre-trained models to capture contextual and morphological patterns without heavy feature engineering. However, the scarcity of large annotated datasets and linguistic diversity continues to hinder robust development in severely under-resourced languages.
related_work.id: Penelitian dalam pelabelan urutan *low-resource* telah berkembang dari metode berbasis aturan dan statistik ke arsitektur *deep learning* dan berbasis *transformer* modern. Pendekatan awal untuk bahasa-bahasa di India sangat mengandalkan aturan buatan tangan dan model statistik seperti *conditional random field*, yang mencapai hasil kompetitif untuk bahasa seperti Kannada. Penelitian selanjutnya mengeksplorasi *recurrent neural network* dan model *pra-latih* untuk menangkap pola kontekstual dan morfologis tanpa rekayasa fitur yang berat. Namun, kelangkaan dataset beranotasi yang besar dan keragaman linguistik terus menghambat pengembangan yang kuat pada bahasa-bahasa yang sangat minim sumber daya.

results.en: Experimental evaluations show that hybrid models consistently outperform traditional machine learning classifiers across both sequence labeling tasks. For part-of-speech tagging, traditional models using DictVectorizer-based feature fusion achieved strong results, with XGBoost reaching an F1-score of 0.9352. For named entity recognition, hybrid models with feature concatenation demonstrated substantial improvements, where the BiGRU model achieved the highest F1-scores of 0.7087 with feature concatenation and 0.7196 with HashVectorizer. The authors interpret these findings as evidence that handcrafted features provide strong baselines for simpler tagging tasks, whereas embedding-based hybrid architectures are essential for capturing complex morphological and contextual patterns in named entity recognition.
results.id: Evaluasi eksperimental menunjukkan bahwa model hibrida secara konsisten mengungguli pengklasifikasi *machine learning* tradisional pada kedua tugas pelabelan urutan. Untuk penandaan *part-of-speech*, model tradisional yang menggunakan fusi fitur berbasis *DictVectorizer* mencapai hasil yang kuat, dengan *XGBoost* mencapai skor F1 sebesar 0,9352. Untuk *named entity recognition*, model hibrida dengan *feature concatenation* menunjukkan peningkatan yang substansial, di mana model *BiGRU* mencapai skor F1 tertinggi sebesar 0,7087 dengan *feature concatenation* dan 0,7196 dengan *HashVectorizer*. Para penulis menginterpretasikan temuan ini sebagai bukti bahwa fitur buatan tangan menyediakan *baseline* yang kuat untuk tugas penandaan yang lebih sederhana, sementara arsitektur hibrida berbasis *embedding* sangat penting untuk menangkap pola morfologis dan kontekstual yang kompleks dalam *named entity recognition*.

tldr.en: This paper presents the first manually constructed part-of-speech and named entity recognition datasets for the low-resource language Tulu, along with comprehensive machine learning and hybrid deep learning baselines. Results demonstrate that hybrid models consistently outperform traditional approaches for both tasks.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan dataset *part-of-speech* dan *named entity recognition* yang pertama kali dibangun secara manual untuk bahasa *low-resource* Tulu, beserta *baseline* *machine learning* dan *deep learning* hibrida yang komprehensif. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa model hibrida secara konsisten mengungguli pendekatan tradisional untuk kedua tugas tersebut.

doi:10.33545/27076571.2026.v7.i8a.364.title: Exploring low-resource Tulu NLP: A case study of PoS tagging and NER

doi:10.33578/kpd.v5i3.p329-343.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengembangkan alat evaluasi berbasis game edukasi menggunakan aplikasi Quizizz pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas VIII di SMP Negeri 21 Makassar. Pengembangan dilakukan untuk menjawab kebutuhan guru dan siswa terhadap alat evaluasi yang lebih interaktif, menarik, dan efisien dibandingkan evaluasi konvensional. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode Research and Development (R&D) dengan model ADDIE yang meliputi tahap Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, dan Evaluation. Subjek penelitian terdiri atas siswa kelas VIII dan guru Bahasa Indonesia SMP Negeri 21 Makassar. Teknik pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui wawancara, angket, tes, dan dokumentasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa siswa dan guru memiliki kebutuhan yang tinggi terhadap penggunaan Quizizz sebagai alat evaluasi pembelajaran. Produk yang dikembangkan divalidasi oleh ahli media dengan persentase 96,6% dan ahli materi sebesar 96% sehingga termasuk kategori sangat valid. Hasil uji coba kelompok kecil memperoleh persentase 91,3% dan uji coba kelompok besar memperoleh persentase 91,1% yang termasuk kategori sangat praktis. Hasil tanggapan guru juga menunjukkan respons yang sangat positif terhadap penggunaan media. Dengan demikian, alat evaluasi berbasis game edukasi menggunakan Quizizz dinyatakan valid dan praktis digunakan sebagai alternatif evaluasi pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas VIII SMP Negeri 21 Makassar
