doi:10.48017/dj.v11i3.3627.abstract: English is the medium of instruction in school as early as in Grades 1 to Grade 3 in some private schools. Some students have English as their second language (L2), especially those graders who are taught Mother Tongue – Based Multilingual Education (MTB-MLE) in public school, while some students even if they are non-native speakers use English as their first language (L1). In Cebu, there are students who are non-native speakers of English but English is still their first language (L1). This phenomenon paved this paper to investigate the L1 performance of English-speaking Grade 1 Cebuano students. Vocabulary is vital to the process of learning English because if learners lack enough vocabulary it would be difficult for them to express their ideas and understand other people. Thus, this study focused on the L1 Vocabulary Performance of Grade 1 English-speaking Cebuano Students. Through descriptive quantitative design, this study identified the vocabulary performance of three (3) Grade 1 students in a private school in Cebu City. To identify their vocabulary performance, the vocabulary exercises in their class work were used. The findings revealed the following conclusions. English-speaking Cebuano students performed well in their English vocabulary classwork based on their high percentage scores. The students have a good vocabulary performance in their first language (L1) which is evident from the consistently good scores in the vocabulary tasks from the first grading period to the second grading period. The findings also rejected the assumption that the Grade 1 students will have low performance in their English vocabulary classwork being non-native English speakers.
doi:10.48017/dj.v11i3.3627.title: First Language (L1) Vocabulary Acquisition of Grade 1 English-Speaking Cebuano Students

doi:10.48048/asi.2026.292098.abstract: The Education First (EF) English Proficiency Index has consistently reported a decline in the English proficiency of Filipinos. This emphasizes the need to strengthen students’ vocabulary development. In response, this study examined the effectiveness of podcasting as a pedagogical tool and channel to improve English Proficiency of Senior High School students. The study employed an experimental method with a non-randomized pretest–posttest control group design. Two sections of Grade 12 students under Humanities and Social Science strand from Nueva Ecija High School in Nueva Ecija, Philippines were assigned as the control group (traditional teaching) and the experimental group (podcast intervention). The intervention lasted for three sessions over one week, with vocabulary-focused podcasts developed by English teachers of 3–5 minutes in duration, and were made available through Spotify. Data were gathered using pretest and posttest quiz-type questionnaires. This was supported by a Likert-scale survey on students’ interest in podcasts, and validated through a focus group discussion. Results revealed that students in the experimental group showed significant improvement in vocabulary acquisition compared to the control group. Moreover, their level of interest significantly increased after the podcast intervention, with overall responses shifting from “Agree” to “Strongly Agree.” The findings suggest that podcasts are not only effective in enhancing vocabulary but also serve as engaging, accessible, and enjoyable learning tools. This study recommends integrating podcasting into classroom instruction as a modern approach to enrich students’ vocabulary learning and support language proficiency. Highlights● Podcast-based instruction significantly improved English vocabulary acquisition among students compared to traditional teaching methods.● Vocabulary podcasts proved to be an engaging and accessible learning tool, increasing students’ interest.The study demonstrates that podcasting is an effective pedagogical intervention that could contribute to improving vocabulary learning and supporting language proficiency in the Philippines.
doi:10.48048/asi.2026.292098.title: Podcasting as a Pedagogical Intervention for English Vocabulary Development among Senior High School Students in the Philippines

doi:10.48084/etasr.18415.abstract: Low-resource languages face significant challenges in Machine Translation (MT) due to the scarcity of high-quality parallel datasets. This study presents a low-resource language translation system using a multilingual Neural Machine Translation (NMT) approach. The proposed system employs the Multilingual Bidirectional and Auto-Regressive Transformer-50 (mBART-50) model. mBART-50 is a transformer-based multilingual architecture, fine-tuned on the Samanantar dataset to enhance translation quality for Indic languages. English–Tamil and English–Telugu translations are the primary experimental focus, in which cross-lingual transfer learning is leveraged to improve performance despite data scarcity. Model performance is evaluated using the Bilingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) score, which demonstrates an improvement over the pretrained baseline model. The mBART-50 is designed to be multilingual to enable its easy generalization to other low-resource Indic languages. This study extends previous research by assessing the effectiveness of multilingual transfer under the low-resource conditions of Indic languages. The fine-tuned model achieves BLEU scores of 45.91 for English–Tamil and 31.23 for English–Telugu, significantly outperforming the pretrained baseline. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of multilingual transfer learning in low-resource settings.

glossary.explanation_id: Neural Machine Translation adalah pendekatan *terjemahan mesin* yang menggunakan jaringan saraf tiruan untuk menghasilkan terjemahan secara end-to-end.
Transfer learning adalah teknik pembelajaran mesin di mana pengetahuan yang diperoleh dari pelatihan pada satu tugas digunakan kembali untuk meningkatkan kinerja pada tugas kedua yang berbeda.
Tokenization adalah proses memecah teks masukan menjadi unit-unit kecil yang disebut *token* seperti kata atau *subword* sebelum diproses oleh model.
Back-translation adalah teknik augmentasi data di mana teks diterjemahkan ke bahasa lain lalu diterjemahkan kembali ke bahasa sumber untuk menghasilkan pasangan kalimat sintetis.
Fine-tuning adalah proses melatih lebih lanjut model pra-latih pada *dataset* spesifik untuk tugas tertentu guna meningkatkan performa.
BLEU adalah metrik evaluasi otomatis yang mengukur kemiripan *n-gram* antara teks hasil terjemahan mesin dan terjemahan referensi manusia.
Catastrophic forgetting adalah fenomena di mana model kehilangan pengetahuan yang dipelajari sebelumnya saat mempelajari informasi baru.
Label smoothing adalah teknik regularisasi yang melembutkan distribusi probabilitas target untuk mencegah model menjadi terlalu percaya diri.

background.en: Low-resource languages face significant challenges in machine translation due to the severe scarcity of high-quality parallel datasets, poor linguistic instruments, and a lack of domain-specific corpora. Although neural machine translation is widely used, traditional systems rely heavily on massive datasets, causing inefficiency in low-resource settings. This study addresses the gap of exploring multilingual models under constrained data environments with much smaller datasets.
background.id: Bahasa *low-resource* menghadapi tantangan besar dalam *terjemahan mesin* karena kelangkaan *dataset* paralel berkualitas tinggi yang parah, instrumen linguistik yang buruk, dan kurangnya korpus spesifik domain. Meskipun *neural machine translation* banyak digunakan, sistem tradisional sangat bergantung pada *dataset* berukuran masif, yang menyebabkan ketidakefisienan pada pengaturan *low-resource*. Studi ini mengatasi kesenjangan dalam mengeksplorasi model multilingual di bawah lingkungan data yang terbatas dengan *dataset* yang jauh lebih kecil.

contributions.en: The novelty of this work lies in demonstrating that competitive translation is possible with much smaller datasets and fewer computational resources. The key contributions include an experimental multilingual fine-tuning system for low-resource Indic machine translation with limited computing, the adaptation of mBART-50 using limited sentence pairs from the Samanantar corpus, a comparative analysis showing the effectiveness of multilingual transfer learning, and a qualitative error analysis illustrating ongoing challenges in morphologically rich Indic languages.
contributions.id: Kebaruan dari pekerjaan ini terletak pada peragaan bahwa terjemahan yang kompetitif dimungkinkan dengan *dataset* yang jauh lebih kecil dan sumber daya komputasi yang lebih sedikit. Kontribusi utamanya meliputi sistem eksperimental *fine-tuning* multilingual untuk *terjemahan mesin* India *low-resource* dengan komputasi terbatas, adaptasi mBART-50 menggunakan pasangan kalimat terbatas dari korpus Samanantar, analisis komparatif yang menunjukkan efektivitas *transfer learning* multilingual, serta analisis kesalahan kualitatif yang mengilustrasikan tantangan yang sedang berlangsung pada bahasa India yang kaya secara morfologi.

future_work.en: Future work will focus on fine-tuning the model using domain-specific parallel corpora such as healthcare and agriculture, exploring support for additional low-resource Indic languages like Kannada once tokenizer coverage improves, investigating parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as LoRA to reduce computational requirements, and incorporating larger-scale human evaluation and additional semantic metrics.
future_work.id: Pekerjaan di masa mendatang akan berfokus pada *fine-tuning* model menggunakan korpus paralel spesifik domain seperti kesehatan dan pertanian, mengeksplorasi dukungan untuk bahasa India *low-resource* tambahan seperti Kannada setelah cakupan *tokenizer* meningkat, menyelidiki metode *fine-tuning* yang efisien parameter seperti LoRA untuk mengurangi kebutuhan komputasi, serta memasukkan evaluasi manusia berskala lebih besar dan metrik semantik tambahan.

method.en: The study employs a curated subset of approximately 30,000 sentence pairs per language from the Samanantar corpus for English-Tamil and English-Telugu translation. The preprocessing pipeline incorporates Unicode normalization, script cleaning, punctuation standardization, and subword tokenization using the mBART SentencePiece tokenizer, alongside back-translation and short-sentence augmentation. The architecture uses mBART-50 with twelve encoder and twelve decoder layers, where the encoder was frozen initially to prevent catastrophic forgetting. Training was conducted using a single NVIDIA Tesla T4 GPU with mixed precision, an Adam optimizer, gradient accumulation, and regularization strategies including dropout and label smoothing.
method.id: Studi ini menggunakan bagian terpilih dari sekitar 30.000 pasangan kalimat per bahasa dari korpus Samanantar untuk terjemahan bahasa Inggris-Tamil dan Inggris-Telugu. Alur *preprocessing* mencakup normalisasi Unicode, pembersihan skrip, standardisasi tanda baca, dan *subword* *tokenization* menggunakan *tokenizer* mBART SentencePiece, di samping *back-translation* dan augmentasi kalimat pendek. Arsitekturnya menggunakan mBART-50 dengan dua belas lapisan *encoder* dan dua belas lapisan *decoder*, di mana *encoder* dibekukan pada awalnya untuk mencegah *catastrophic forgetting*. Pelatihan dilakukan menggunakan satu GPU NVIDIA Tesla T4 dengan presisi campuran, pengoptimal Adam, akumulasi gradien, dan strategi regularisasi termasuk *dropout* dan *label smoothing*.

related_work.en: Prior research has investigated low-resource machine translation based on multilingual pretraining and transfer learning. Systems such as mBART and IndicBART have demonstrated enhanced translation performance across various languages, and high-resource to low-resource language transfer learning has been widely explored. However, most current methods rely on massive datasets of over 150,000 to 200,000 sentence pairs and significant computing power, restricting their use in real-world applications with limited data and hardware.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya telah menyelidiki *terjemahan mesin* *low-resource* berdasarkan *pretraining* multilingual dan *transfer learning*. Sistem seperti mBART dan IndicBART telah mendemonstrasikan peningkatan performa terjemahan di berbagai bahasa, dan *transfer learning* dari bahasa *high-resource* ke *low-resource* telah banyak dieksplorasi. Namun, sebagian besar metode saat ini bergantung pada *dataset* masif yang melebihi 150.000 hingga 200.000 pasangan kalimat dan daya komputasi yang signifikan, sehingga membatasi penggunaannya dalam aplikasi dunia nyata dengan data dan perangkat keras yang terbatas.

results.en: The fine-tuned mBART-50 model achieved BLEU scores of 45.91 for English-Tamil and 31.23 for English-Telugu, significantly outperforming the pretrained baseline scores of 28.42 and 20.37 respectively. Evaluation using the chrF2 metric further confirmed improvements at the character level, yielding 65.8 for Tamil and 38.5 for Telugu. Qualitative analysis showed that the fine-tuned model improved fluency, word order, and contextual accuracy, particularly for short and declarative sentences.
results.id: Model mBART-50 yang telah di-*fine-tune* mencapai skor *BLEU* sebesar 45.91 untuk bahasa Inggris-Tamil dan 31.23 untuk bahasa Inggris-Telugu, mengungguli secara signifikan skor *baseline* pra-latih masing-masing sebesar 28.42 dan 20.37. Evaluasi menggunakan metrik chrF2 semakin mengonfirmasi peningkatan pada tingkat karakter, menghasilkan 65.8 untuk Tamil dan 38.5 untuk Telugu. Analisis kualitatif menunjukkan bahwa model yang telah di-*fine-tune* meningkatkan kefasihan, urutan kata, dan akurasi kontekstual, terutama untuk kalimat pendek dan deklaratif.

tldr.en: This study presents a data-efficient multilingual neural machine translation system using the mBART-50 model fine-tuned on limited Indic language datasets. The fine-tuned model achieves significant improvements in BLEU scores for English-Tamil and English-Telugu translations compared to the pretrained baseline.
tldr.id: Studi ini menyajikan sistem *terjemahan mesin* saraf multilingual yang efisien data menggunakan model mBART-50 yang di-*fine-tune* pada *dataset* bahasa India yang terbatas. Model yang telah di-*fine-tune* mencapai peningkatan signifikan pada skor *BLEU* untuk terjemahan bahasa Inggris-Tamil dan Inggris-Telugu dibandingkan dengan *baseline* pra-latih.

doi:10.48084/etasr.18415.title: A Data-Efficient Multilingual Neural Machine Translation Model for Low-Resource Indic Languages

doi:10.48084/etasr.18615.abstract: While cultural preservation and the digitization of historical manuscripts have a long history, low-resource writing systems continue to be poorly represented due to the absence of reliable ground truth datasets. This paper describes a reproducible engineering process for building a ground truth-validated dataset for deteriorated Old Sundanese manuscripts from the Geusan Ulun Museum in Indonesia. The Old Sundanese Manuscripts Dataset (OSMD) was constructed by combining controlled digitization, contrast enhancement, edge-based object extraction, morphological image processing, expert annotation, and optimized dataset packaging. The dataset contains 1,300 word-level samples for five consonant classes: Ha, Na, Ca, Ra, and Ka. To assess the potential of the dataset, baseline classification experiments were conducted using HOG+SVM and a lightweight CNN, where the latter outperformed (p<0.01) with 0.842 accuracy and 0.833 macro F1-score. The absence of contrast enhancement resulted in a notable drop in performance, and cross-validation demonstrated low variance (±0.006). The process followed in this study can be applied to low-resource historical scripts, connecting cultural heritage and computational modeling.

glossary.explanation_id: CLAHE adalah metode *contrast enhancement* yang beroperasi secara lokal untuk memperjelas batas goresan tinta pada manuskrip yang pudar tanpa memperkuat *noise* latar belakang secara berlebihan.
Canny edge detection adalah algoritma deteksi tepi yang digunakan untuk menemukan batas garis atau goresan karakter pada citra dokumen historis.
HOG adalah teknik *feature extraction* yang mendeskripsikan bentuk objek melalui distribusi orientasi gradien atau arah tepi dalam sebuah citra.
Stratified sampling adalah teknik pengambilan sampel yang memastikan proporsi setiap kelas dalam *dataset* tetap seimbang antara *training set* dan *test set*.
Rarangken adalah tanda diakritik atau pengubah vokal dalam sistem aksara Sunda.
Morphological closing adalah operasi pengolahan citra berupa dilusi diikuti erosi untuk menutup celah kecil atau menyambungkan kembali goresan yang terputus.
Macro F1-score adalah metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rata-rata nilai *F1-score* dari setiap kelas secara merata tanpa memandang jumlah sampel.

background.en: Cultural preservation and digitization of historical manuscripts have a long history, yet low-resource writing systems remain poorly represented due to the absence of reliable ground truth datasets. In particular, the computational analysis of Southeast Asian scripts, especially the Old Sundanese language preserved in museums such as the Geusan Ulun Museum, is significantly underdeveloped. Deteriorated manuscript pages with fading ink, uneven illumination, paper wear, and background discoloration pose considerable obstacles to automated evaluation and recognition tasks.
background.id: Pelestarian budaya dan digitalisasi manuskrip historis memiliki sejarah yang panjang, namun sistem penulisan *low-resource* masih kurang terwakili karena ketiadaan *dataset* *ground truth* yang andal. Analisis komputasi aksara Asia Tenggara, khususnya bahasa Sunda Kuno yang disimpan di museum seperti Museum Geusan Ulun, tertinggal secara signifikan. Halaman manuskrip yang mengalami degradasi akibat tinta pudar, pencahayaan tidak merata, keausan kertas, dan discolored background menimbulkan hambatan besar bagi tugas evaluasi dan pengenalan otomatis.

contributions.en: This study introduces the Old Sundanese Manuscripts Dataset (OSMD), consisting of 1,300 word-level samples across five consonant classes, constructed through a reproducible engineering pipeline. The contributions include combining controlled digitization, contrast enhancement, edge-based object extraction, morphological image processing, and expert annotation to minimize semantic label noise. Additionally, the work establishes baseline classification experiments and complexity metrics tailored to deteriorated historical scripts.
contributions.id: Studi ini memperkenalkan Old Sundanese Manuscripts Dataset (OSMD) yang terdiri dari 1.300 sampel tingkat kata di lima kelas konsonan, yang dibangun melalui *pipeline* rekayasa yang dapat direproduksi. Kontribusinya mencakup penggabungan digitalisasi terkontrol, peningkatan kontras, ekstraksi objek berbasis tepi, pemrosesan citra morfologis, dan anotasi ahli untuk meminimalkan *semantic label noise*. Selain itu, penelitian ini menetapkan eksperimen klasifikasi *baseline* dan metrik kompleksitas yang disesuaikan untuk manuskrip historis yang mengalami degradasi.

future_work.en: Future research may enhance the dataset by incorporating Rarangken modifiers, increasing page coverage, implementing advanced data augmentation strategies, and utilizing transfer learning with more extensive script corpora. Furthermore, future corpora could benefit from semi-supervised or self-supervised methods to decrease reliance on manual annotations.
future_work.id: Penelitian masa depan dapat memperkaya *dataset* dengan memasukkan pengubah Rarangken, memperluas cakupan halaman, menerapkan strategi *data augmentation* tingkat lanjut, dan memanfaatkan *transfer learning* dengan korpus aksara yang lebih ekstensif. Selain itu, korpus masa depan dapat memperoleh manfaat dari metode *semi-supervised* atau *self-supervised* untuk mengurangi ketergantungan pada anotasi manual.

method.en: Ten sheets containing travel notes of Prabu Siliwangi from the Geusan Ulun Museum were digitized using a CZUR scanner at 600 dpi in lossless PNG format. The preprocessing pipeline involved grayscale transformation, Gaussian blur for noise reduction, and Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization for contrast enhancement. Canny edge detection and morphological closing were applied to extract contours, filtered using geometric rules to form bounding boxes for word image segments. A philological expert performed annotations through a two-step quality assurance system for five consonant classes: Ha, Na, Ca, Ra, and Ka. The dataset was split into an 80 percent training set and a 20 percent testing set using stratified sampling, and evaluated using HOG+SVM and a lightweight CNN.
method.id: Sepuluh lembar yang berisi catatan perjalanan Prabu Siliwangi dari Museum Geusan Ulun didigitalisasi menggunakan pemindai CZUR pada resolusi 600 dpi dalam format PNG nirhilang. *Pipeline* *preprocessing* melibatkan transformasi ke *grayscale*, *Gaussian blur* untuk reduksi *noise*, dan *Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization* untuk peningkatan kontras. *Canny edge detection* dan *morphological closing* diterapkan untuk mengekstrak kontur, yang disaring menggunakan aturan geometris untuk membentuk *bounding box* bagi segmen citra kata. Seorang ahli filologi melakukan anotasi melalui sistem penjaminan kualitas dua langkah untuk lima kelas konsonan: Ha, Na, Ca, Ra, dan Ka. *Dataset* dibagi menjadi 80 persen data latih dan 20 persen data uji menggunakan *stratified sampling*, dan dievaluasi menggunakan HOG+SVM serta CNN ringan.

related_work.en: Previous digitization projects for historical manuscripts were mostly descriptive in nature and focused on cataloguing rather than engineering datasets for machine learning. Existing semi-automatic methods for generating ground truths for historical documents involve limited automation and rely heavily on expert assessments with high annotation costs. Furthermore, most historical OCR benchmarks exhibit a bias toward high-resource scripts, leaving low-resource languages without standardized guidelines for dataset annotation, partitioning, and reproducibility.
related_work.id: Proyek digitalisasi sebelumnya untuk manuskrip historis sebagian besar bersifat deskriptif dan berfokus pada katalogisasi alih-alih merekayasa *dataset* untuk *machine learning*. Metode semi-otomatis yang ada untuk menghasilkan *ground truth* dokumen historis hanya melibatkan otomatisasi terbatas dan sangat bergantung pada penilaian ahli dengan biaya anotasi yang tinggi. Selain itu, sebagian besar *benchmark* OCR historis menunjukkan bias terhadap skrip *high-resource*, sehingga bahasa *low-resource* tidak memiliki pedoman terstandar untuk anotasi *dataset*, partisi, dan reproduisibilitas.

results.en: The lightweight CNN baseline achieved an accuracy of 0.842 and a macro F1-score of 0.833, outperforming the HOG+SVM model which attained 0.762 accuracy. An ablation study demonstrated that removing contrast enhancement caused a notable drop in accuracy to 0.801. Five-fold cross-validation showed high stability with a mean accuracy of 0.842 and a low standard deviation of plus or minus 0.006, and a paired t-test confirmed the statistical significance of the CNN's improvement.
results.id: *Baseline* CNN ringan mencapai akurasi sebesar 0,842 dan *macro F1-score* sebesar 0,833, mengungguli model HOG+SVM yang memperoleh akurasi 0,762. Studi ablasi menunjukkan bahwa penghilangan peningkatan kontras menyebabkan penurunan akurasi yang signifikan menjadi 0,801. *Cross-validation* lima lipatan menunjukkan stabilitas tinggi dengan akurasi rata-rata 0,842 dan simpangan baku rendah sebesar plus minus 0,006, serta uji-t berpasangan mengonfirmasi signifikansi statistik dari peningkatan performa CNN tersebut.

tldr.en: This paper presents a reproducible engineering pipeline for building a ground truth-validated dataset of deteriorated Old Sundanese manuscripts. Experiments show that a lightweight CNN baseline outperforms HOG+SVM in classifying ancient script characters.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan *pipeline* rekayasa yang dapat direproduksi untuk membangun *dataset* beranotasi *ground truth* dari manuskrip Sunda Kuno yang mengalami degradasi. Eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa *baseline* CNN ringan mengungguli HOG+SVM dalam mengklasifikasikan karakter aksara kuno.

doi:10.48084/etasr.18615.title: Towards the Automated Recognition of Ancient Sundanese Scripts: Groundtruth Generation at the Geusan Ulun Museum

doi:10.48175/ijarsct-37896.abstract: Cross-lingual communication remains constrained by translation tools that fail to preserve sentence-level meaning, par-ticularly for idiomatic phrasing, long or multi-clause sentences, and low-resource languages. This paper presents the design and evaluation of a browser-accessible multilingual translation plat-form built around a Transformer encoder–decoder network. A sin-gle shared model is fine-tuned across five languages – English, Hindi, French, Spanish, and German – using subword vocabu-lary construction, automatic source-language identification, and an attention-based explainability layer that exposes token-level align-ment through heatmap visualization. The system was evaluated on a held-out multilingual test set using BLEU, ROUGE-L, and accuracy metrics, achieving a macro-averaged translation accuracy of 92.7%, exceeding a 90% target and outperforming LSTM, GRU, statistical, and rule-based baselines by a wide margin. Average inference la-tency remained below 185 milliseconds per request, supporting in-teractive use. The results indicate that a moderately sized, shared self-attention architecture can deliver production-quality multilin-gual translation within the resource constraints of an academic de-ployment, while surfacing clear directions – low-resource language coverage, domain adaptation, and speech-based extension – for con-tinued development
authors: Darshan Gowda D H and Dr. Kruti R
doi:10.48175/ijarsct-37896.journal_ref: International Journal of Advanced Research in Science Communication and Technology

glossary.explanation_id: Arsitektur jaringan saraf tiruan yang sepenuhnya mengandalkan mekanisme *self-attention* untuk memproses urutan data secara paralel.
Algoritma *tokenization* subkata yang memecah kata jarang menjadi fragmen yang dapat digunakan kembali untuk memperkecil ukuran kosakata.
Metrik otomatis yang digunakan untuk mengevaluasi kualitas teks hasil terjemahan dengan membandingkannya terhadap referensi manusia.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur tumpang tindih urutan kata terpanjang antara teks hasil sistem dan teks referensi.
Mekanisme yang memungkinkan model untuk menghubungkan setiap token dalam sebuah urutan dengan token lainnya secara langsung.
Kemampuan model untuk menerjemahkan pasangan bahasa yang belum pernah dilihat secara eksplisit selama pelatihan.

background.en: Cross-lingual communication remains constrained by translation tools that fail to preserve sentence-level meaning, particularly for idiomatic phrasing, long or multi-clause sentences, and low-resource languages. Existing commercial services are closed-source and depend on paid infrastructure, whereas academic prototypes often lack the surrounding application features needed to move from a research demonstration to a usable tool.
background.id: Komunikasi lintas bahasa masih terkendala oleh perangkat *translation* yang gagal mempertahankan makna tingkat kalimat, terutama untuk frasa idiomatis, kalimat panjang atau berkalusa banyak, dan bahasa *low-resource*. Layanan komersial yang ada bersifat *closed-source* dan bergantung pada infrastruktur berbayar, sedangkan prototipe akademis sering kali kekurangan fitur aplikasi pendukung yang dibutuhkan untuk bergeser dari demonstrasi penelitian menjadi perangkat yang dapat digunakan.

contributions.en: The paper introduces a browser-accessible multilingual translation platform that fine-tunes a single shared Transformer model across five languages using a unified subword vocabulary and automatic source-language identification. It integrates an attention-based explainability layer with heatmap visualization, confidence scoring, translation history, and report generation while outperforming recurrent, statistical, and rule-based baselines.
contributions.id: Makalah ini memperkenalkan platform *translation* multibahasa berbasis *browser* yang melakukan *fine-tuning* pada satu model *Transformer* bersama di lima bahasa menggunakan kosakata *subword* terpadu dan identifikasi bahasa sumber otomatis. Sistem ini mengintegrasikan lapisan *explainability* berbasis *attention* dengan visualisasi *heatmap*, penilaian *confidence*, riwayat *translation*, dan pembuatan laporan, serta mengungguli *baseline* rekuren, statistik, dan berbasis aturan.

future_work.en: Future work includes extending language coverage to additional high-demand and low-resource languages, incorporating larger and more domain-diverse training corpora including conversational text, conducting real-world user evaluations, and extending the platform toward speech capabilities and domain-specific adaptation.
future_work.id: Pekerjaan masa depan mencakup memperluas cakupan bahasa ke bahasa *high-demand* dan *low-resource* tambahan, memasukkan korpus pelatihan yang lebih besar dan beragam domain termasuk teks percakapan, melakukan *evaluasi* pengguna di dunia nyata, serta memperluas platform ke arah kapabilitas suara dan adaptasi spesifik domain.

method.en: The model uses an encoder-decoder Transformer architecture trained on parallel sentence pairs from OPUS, WMT, and Helsinki-NLP corpora across English, Hindi, French, Spanish, and German. Preprocessing involves BPE subword tokenization with a 32,000-unit shared vocabulary, and evaluation is conducted on a held-out test set using BLEU, ROUGE-L, and accuracy metrics.
method.id: Model ini menggunakan arsitektur *Transformer* *encoder-decoder* yang dilatih pada pasangan kalimat paralel dari korpus OPUS, WMT, dan Helsinki-NLP di bahasa Inggris, Hindi, Prancis, Spanyol, dan Jerman. Pra-pemrosesan melibatkan *tokenization* *subword* BPE dengan kosakata bersama sejumlah 32.000 unit, dan *evaluasi* dilakukan pada *test set* yang ditahan menggunakan metrik BLEU, ROUGE-L, dan akurasi.

related_work.en: Translation technology has progressed through rule-based systems, statistical machine translation, and neural machine translation using recurrent encoder-decoder pairs and the Transformer architecture. While large multilingual models and commercial APIs offer broad coverage, they often incur high computational costs and inconsistent translation quality for languages with limited parallel data.
related_work.id: Teknologi *translation* telah berkembang melalui sistem berbasis aturan, *statistical machine translation*, dan *neural machine translation* yang menggunakan pasangan *encoder-decoder* rekuren serta arsitektur *Transformer*. Meskipun model multibahasa berskala besar dan API komersial menawarkan cakupan yang luas, keduanya sering kali menimbulkan biaya komputasi yang tinggi dan kualitas *translation* yang tidak konsisten untuk bahasa dengan data paralel yang terbatas.

results.en: The system achieved a macro-averaged translation accuracy of 92.7 percent and an average inference latency below 185 milliseconds per request, outperforming LSTM, GRU, statistical, and rule-based baselines. Error analysis revealed that mistakes were primarily driven by idiomatic expressions, domain terminology, and long sentences.
results.id: Sistem ini mencapai akurasi *translation* rata-rata makro sebesar 92,7 persen dan *latency* *inference* rata-rata di bawah 185 milidetik per permintaan, mengungguli *baseline* LSTM, GRU, statistik, dan berbasis aturan. Analisis kesalahan mengungkapkan bahwa kesalahan terutama didorong oleh ekspresi idiomatis, terminologi domain, dan kalimat panjang.

tldr.en: This paper presents a browser-accessible multilingual translation platform built around a shared Transformer encoder-decoder network. The system achieves a macro-averaged translation accuracy of 92.7 percent across five languages while maintaining real-time inference latency below 185 milliseconds.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan platform *translation* multibahasa berbasis *browser* yang dibangun di sekitar jaringan *Transformer* *encoder-decoder* bersama. Sistem ini mencapai akurasi *translation* rata-rata makro sebesar 92,7 persen di lima bahasa dengan mempertahankan *latency* *inference* *real-time* di bawah 185 milidetik.

doi:10.51494/jpdf.v7i3.3298.abstract: Abstrak: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh kesulitan guru dalam meningkatkan aktivitas dan hasil belajar siswa pada pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia. Tujuan penelitian ini mendeskripsikan proses dan peningkatan hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia melalui integrasi penerapan pendekatan pembelajaran mendalam dan berdiferensiasi pada siswa sekolah dasar. Subjek penelitian ini adalah siswa kelas 4 sekolah dasar yang terbagi pada dua lokasi yakni Subjek 1 di daerah perkotaan dan Subjek 2 di daerah pedesaan. Jenis penelitian yang dipilih yaitu penelitian tindakan kelas. Teknik pengumpulan data dikelompokkan menjadi dua bagian yaitu data proses dan data hasil. Analisis data penelitian menggunakan analisis data kualitatif dan kuantitatif. Target indikator keberhasilan penelitian ini berdasarkan nilai individu siswa yakni sebesar >65 dan kriteria ketuntasan secara klasikal sebesar >80%. Hasil temuan penelitian ini bahwa adanya perubahan pada profil, minat dan kesiapan belajar yang meningkat sebagai dampak penerapan prinsip pembelajaran berdiferensiasi. Hasil temuan berikutnya yakni keterampilan mengajar guru menerapkan pendekatan pembelajaran dan berdiferensiasidikategorikan sangat baik. Hasil belajar siswa pada siklus 1 dari subjek 1 sebesar 67% dan dari subjek 2 sebesar 60%. Setelah dilakukan refleksi pada siklus 2 diperoleh dari subjek 1 sebesar 89% dan subjek 2 sebesar 82%. Maka masing-masing pada subjek 1 dan subjek 2 dari siklus 1 ke siklus 2 diperoleh peningkatan sebesar 22%. Sehingga disimpulkan bahwa integrasi pendekatan pembelajaran mendalam dan pembelajaran berdiferensiasi terbukti dapat dikuasai oleh guru dengan sangat baik dan berdampak pada aktivitas serta hasil belajar siswa di sekolah dasar daerah perkotaan dan pedesaan. Abstract: This research is motivated by the difficulties teachers face in improving student learning activities and outcomes in Indonesian language learning. The purpose of this study is to describe the process and improvement of Indonesian language learning outcomes through the integration of the application of in-depth and differentiated learning approaches to elementary school students. The subjects of this study were 4th-grade elementary school students divided into two locations: Subject 1 in an urban area and Subject 2 in a rural area. The type of research chosen was classroom action research. Data collection techniques were grouped into two parts: process data and outcome data. Research data analysis used qualitative and quantitative data analysis. The target indicators for success of this study were based on individual student scores of >65 andclassical completion criteria of >80%. The findings of this study indicate changes in the profile, interest, and readiness to learn that have increased as a result of the application of differentiated learning principles. The next finding is that the teaching skills of teachers applying learning and differentiated approaches are categorized as very good. Student learning outcomes in cycle 1 from subject 1 were 67% and from subject 2 were 60%. After reflection in cycle 2, it was obtained from subject 1 at 89% and subject 2 at 82%. Thus, each subject 1 and subject 2 saw a 22% increase from cycle 1 to cycle 2. Therefore, it can be concluded that the integration of in-depth learning and differentiated learning approaches has been proven to be very effective for teachers and hasimpacted student activities and learning outcomes in elementary schools in both urban and rural areas.
doi:10.51494/jpdf.v7i3.3298.title: Integrasi Pendekatan Pembelajaran Mendalam dan Pembelajaran Berdiferensiasi untuk Meningkatkan Hasil Belajar Bahasa Indonesia di Sekolah Dasar Perkotaan dan Pedesaan

doi:10.51494/jpdf.v7i3.3619.abstract: Abstrak: Minimnya ketersediaan bahan ajar digital yang kontekstual dengan budaya lokal serta masih rendahnya prestasi belajar Bahasa Indonesia murid sekolah dasar mendorong dilakukannya penelitian ini. Tujuan utamanya yakni menghasilkan produk e-book interaktif bermuatan cerita rakyat Bali dan menguji kualitas validitas, kepraktisan, hingga efektivitas peningkatannya pada siswa kelas III. Melalui pendekatan Research and Development (R&D) dengan alur ADDIE, penelitian ini melibatkan validator materi, media, dan bahasa, serta 20 siswa SD Negeri 2 Pempatan dalam kelompok uji coba terbatas. Pengumpulan data mengandalkan instrumen validasi expert judgment, angket kepraktisan guru dan siswa, serta lembar tes (pre-test dan post-test). Temuan lapangan mengonfirmasi bahwa produk mencapai kriteria sangat valid dengan skor Aiken’s V dari ahli materi 0,99; ahli media 0,97; dan ahli bahasa 0,98. Kepraktisan media berada di kategori sangat praktis melalui rata-rata respon guru 4,9 dan siswa 4,8. Media juga menunjukkan efektivitas peningkatan pemahaman materi yang tergolong tinggi dengan N-Gain Score 0,82. Hal ini menyimpulkan bahwa e-book interaktif bermuatan kearifan lokal Bali teruji layak serta efektif sebagai alternatif inovasi pembelajaran di sekolah dasar. Abstract: The scarcity of contextual digital learning materials integrated with local culture and the low achievement in Indonesian language learning outcomes among elementary school students prompted this study. The primary objective was to develop an interactive e-book containing Balinese folklore and to evaluate its validity, practicality, and effectiveness in enhancing third-grade students' performance. Utilizing a Research and Development (R&D) approach structured around the ADDIE model, this study involved expert validators in material, media, and language, alongside 20 third-grade students from SD Negeri 2 Pempatan in a limited field trial. Data collection relied on expert evaluation sheets, teacher and student practicality questionnaires, and learning outcome assessments (pre-test and post-test). Empirical findings confirmed that the developed product achieved an exceptionally high level of validity, with Aiken’s V scores of 0.99 from the material expert, 0.97 from the media expert, and 0.98 from the language expert. The media's practicality was categorized as very high, evidenced by average response scores of 4.9 from the teacher and 4.8 from students. Furthermore, the media demonstrated a significant improvement in student comprehension, falling into the high category with a Normalized Gain (N-Gain) score of 0.82. Consequently, the interactive e-book embedded with Balinese cultural heritage is proven to be feasible and effective as an innovative learning media alternative in elementary education.
doi:10.51494/jpdf.v7i3.3619.title: Inovasi Pembelajaran Digital Berbasis Kearifan Lokal: Pengembangan E-Book Interaktif Cerita Rakyat Bali pada Mata Pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di Sekolah Dasar

doi:10.51817/jpdr.v6i2.2518.abstract: Bahasa Indonesia bagi Penutur Asing (BIPA) materials for junior and senior high school learners frequently emphasize grammar and decontextualized vocabulary, limiting opportunities for adolescent learners to engage with the Indonesian language through meaningful cultural and social practices. This study examines how Nusantara cultural values can be recontextualized in BIPA materials to support communicative competence, intercultural understanding, and learner engagement within contemporary language pedagogy. Using a descriptive qualitative design based on library research, the study synthesizes scholarly literature on BIPA material development, local wisdom, regional cultural practices, adolescent language learning, and digitally mediated instruction published between 2013 and 2026. The analysis identifies four pedagogical pathways for integrating cultural content into BIPA instruction. First, values such as gotong royong and subak can be incorporated into reading texts to develop comprehension while introducing social and ecological perspectives. Second, regional speech levels and culturally appropriate expressions can be taught through dialogue, role play, and other interactional activities that foreground politeness and relational meaning. Third, digital folklore can function as multimodal material for reading comprehension, narrative interpretation, and moral reflection. Fourth, regional songs can support listening development while exposing learners to linguistic variation, cultural memory, and local identity. The findings suggest that cultural integration is most effective when local traditions are treated not as decorative content but as discursive resources for communication, comparison, and critical reflection. The study proposes a culturally sustaining framework that connects Nusantara heritage with communicative, intercultural, and digital approaches to language education. Its implications are relevant to BIPA teachers, curriculum developers, materials designers, and policymakers seeking to develop context-sensitive learning resources for adolescent international learners.

doi:10.51817/jpdr.v6i2.2518.title: RECONTEXTUALIZING NUSANTARA CULTURAL VALUES IN BIPA MATERIALS DISCOURSE: A CULTURALLY SUSTAINING FRAMEWORK FOR ADOLESCENT LEARNERS

doi:10.51878/edutech.v6i3.14592.abstract: ABSTRACT The need to create learning experiences that connect information comprehension with the use of numerical concepts underlies the development of the Digital Literacy and Numeracy Game (GELINDA). The media was designed for Grade III Indonesian language learning by integrating reading, information comprehension, and numeracy problem-solving activities through a digital game. The product was developed using the Research and Development (R&D) method and the ADDIE model, comprising Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation, involving 20 third-grade students at SD Negeri Padarama. Product feasibility was assessed by media and language experts and a subject matter expert, while the quality of the test instrument was reviewed by an instrument expert. Practicality was determined through teacher and student responses, whereas effectiveness was examined using a One-Group Pretest–Posttest design. GELINDA was categorized as highly feasible by the media and language experts and the subject matter expert, while the test instrument was considered feasible. User responses also placed the media in the highly practical category. Students’ abilities improved significantly after using the media, with an N-Gain score of 0.5740 or 57.3961%, which falls within the moderate or fairly effective category. These findings position GELINDA as an alternative digital learning medium that can connect Indonesian language instruction with the development of literacy and numeracy skills in a more contextual learning experience. ABSTRAK Kebutuhan untuk menghadirkan pengalaman belajar yang menghubungkan kemampuan memahami informasi dengan penggunaan konsep numerik menjadi salah satu pertimbangan dalam pengembangan Game Literasi dan Numerasi Digital (GELINDA). Media ini dirancang untuk pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas III dengan memadukan aktivitas membaca, memahami informasi, dan penyelesaian persoalan numerasi melalui permainan digital. Produk dikembangkan melalui metode Research and Development (R&D) menggunakan model ADDIE yang meliputi Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, dan Evaluation, dengan melibatkan 20 siswa kelas III SD Negeri Padarama. Kelayakan produk diperiksa oleh ahli media dan bahasa serta ahli materi, sementara kualitas instrumen ditelaah oleh ahli instrumen soal. Kepraktisan diketahui melalui respons guru dan siswa, sedangkan efektivitas ditinjau menggunakan desain One-Group Pretest–Posttest. GELINDA memperoleh kategori sangat layak dari ahli media dan bahasa serta ahli materi, sedangkan instrumen soal dinyatakan layak. Respons pengguna juga menempatkan media pada kategori sangat praktis. Perubahan kemampuan siswa setelah penggunaan media terbukti signifikan, dengan nilai N-Gain 0,5740 atau 57,3961% yang termasuk kategori sedang atau cukup efektif. Temuan tersebut menempatkan GELINDA sebagai alternatif media digital yang dapat digunakan untuk mempertemukan pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia dengan penguatan literasi dan numerasi secara lebih kontekstual.

doi:10.51878/edutech.v6i4.13344.abstract: Indonesian language learning on intrinsic story elements in elementary schools still faces limitations in the use of interactive digital learning media. This condition makes students less active and motivated and causes difficulties in understanding intrinsic story elements. This study aimed to develop a Genially Game for teaching intrinsic story elements to fourth-grade elementary school students and to determine its validity and practicality. The study employed Research and Development (R&D) using the ADDIE model, consisting of analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation. The subjects were fourth-grade students at SDN 4 Made Lamongan. Data were collected through observation, interviews, expert validation, student response questionnaires, and teacher activity questionnaires. The results showed that the media achieved very high validity based on assessments from subject matter experts (93.7%), media experts (93%), and design experts (92.2%). The practicality of the media was demonstrated by student responses of 92% in the limited trial and 93% in the field trial, supported by teacher activity scores of 80% and 90%, respectively. The Genially Game was therefore considered suitable for use as interactive learning media for teaching intrinsic story elements in elementary schools. ABSTRAK Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia pada materi unsur intrinsik cerita di sekolah dasar masih menghadapi keterbatasan penggunaan media digital yang interaktif. Kondisi tersebut menyebabkan siswa kurang aktif, kurang termotivasi, dan mengalami kesulitan memahami unsur-unsur intrinsik cerita. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengembangkan media Game Genially pada materi unsur intrinsik cerita untuk siswa kelas IV sekolah dasar serta mengetahui validitas dan kepraktisannya. Penelitian menggunakan metode Research and Development (R&D) dengan model ADDIE yang meliputi analysis, design, development, implementation, dan evaluation. Subjek penelitian adalah siswa kelas IV SDN 4 Made Lamongan. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, validasi ahli, angket respons siswa, dan angket aktivitas guru. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa media memperoleh validitas sangat tinggi berdasarkan penilaian ahli materi sebesar 93,7%, ahli media 93%, dan ahli desain 92,2%. Kepraktisan media ditunjukkan melalui respons siswa sebesar 92% pada uji coba terbatas dan 93% pada uji coba lapangan, serta aktivitas guru sebesar 80% dan 90%. Media Game Genially dinyatakan layak digunakan sebagai media pembelajaran interaktif pada materi unsur intrinsik cerita di sekolah dasar.

glossary.explanation_id: *ADDIE* adalah model pengembangan produk pembelajaran yang terdiri dari lima tahapan sistematis yaitu *analysis*, *design*, *development*, *implementation*, dan *evaluation*.
*Genially* adalah platform berbasis web yang digunakan untuk membuat konten visual dan interaktif seperti presentasi, infografis, dan media pembelajaran.
*Research and Development* adalah metode penelitian yang digunakan untuk menghasilkan produk tertentu dan menguji ke efektifannya.
*Game-Based Learning* adalah pendekatan pembelajaran yang menggunakan elemen permainan untuk meningkatkan motivasi dan keterlibatan peserta didik.
*TPACK* adalah kerangka kerja yang menjelaskan pengetahuan tentang integrasi teknologi, pedagogi, dan konten materi dalam pengajaran.

background.en: Indonesian language learning on intrinsic story elements in elementary schools frequently suffers from limited interactive digital learning media, leading to student passivity, low motivation, and difficulties in comprehension. This traditional, teacher-centered approach creates a gap with the demands of twenty-first-century digital learning, necessitating innovative, contextual, and student-centered learning tools for fourth-grade students.
background.id: Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia pada materi unsur intrinsik cerita di sekolah dasar sering kali menghadapi keterbatasan media pembelajaran digital interaktif, yang berujung pada kepasifan siswa, rendahnya motivasi, dan kesulitan pemahaman. Pendekatan tradisional yang berpusat pada guru ini menciptakan kesenjangan dengan tuntutan pembelajaran digital abad ke-21, sehingga diperlukan sarana pembelajaran yang inovatif, kontekstual, dan berpusat pada siswa kelas IV.

contributions.en: The main contribution of this study is the creation and empirical validation of an interactive Genially Game tailored specifically for teaching story intrinsic elements to fourth-grade elementary students. The work delivers a validated instructional product integrating game elements, multimedia, and pedagogical principles to improve student engagement and comprehension.
contributions.id: Kontribusi utama dari penelitian ini adalah pembuatan dan validasi empiris dari *Genially Game* interaktif yang dirancang khusus untuk pembelajaran unsur intrinsik cerita kepada siswa kelas IV sekolah dasar. Karya ini menghasilkan produk pembelajaran tervalidasi yang mengintegrasikan elemen *game*, multimedia, dan prinsip pedagogis untuk meningkatkan keterlibatan serta pemahaman siswa.

future_work.en: Future work should test the effectiveness of the media on learning outcomes using experimental designs, apply it to different subjects or educational levels, and develop more varied interactive features to meet digital era learning needs.
future_work.id: Penelitian mendatang sebaiknya menguji efektivitas media terhadap hasil belajar menggunakan desain eksperimen, menerapkannya pada materi atau jenjang pendidikan yang berbeda, serta mengembangkan fitur interaktif yang lebih bervariatif guna memenuhi kebutuhan pembelajaran di era digital.

method.en: The study employs a Research and Development (R&D) methodology using the ADDIE model, comprising analysis, design, development, implementation, and evaluation phases. Data were collected via observation, interviews, expert validation, student response questionnaires, and teacher activity questionnaires administered during limited and field trials at SDN 4 Made Lamongan.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan metodologi *Research and Development* (*R&D*) dengan model *ADDIE*, yang mencakup fase *analysis*, *design*, *development*, *implementation*, dan *evaluation*. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, validasi ahli, angket respons siswa, dan angket aktivitas guru yang dilaksanakan selama uji coba terbatas dan uji coba lapangan di SDN 4 Made Lamongan.

related_work.en: Prior studies highlight the significance of digital learning media and game-based learning in enhancing student motivation and learning outcomes. However, research specifically focusing on interactive Genially-based game media designed for teaching intrinsic story elements in fourth-grade elementary schools remains scarce, motivating the development of the proposed media.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu menyoroti pentingnya media pembelajaran digital dan *game-based learning* dalam meningkatkan motivasi dan hasil belajar siswa. Kendati demikian, penelitian yang secara khusus berfokus pada media *game* berbasis *Genially* untuk pembelajaran unsur intrinsik cerita di kelas IV sekolah dasar masih langka, sehingga memotivasi pengembangan media yang diusulkan.

results.en: The developed media achieved very high expert validation scores: 93.7 percent from subject matter experts, 93 percent from media experts, and 92.2 percent from design experts. Practicality was demonstrated by student response rates of 92 percent in limited trials and 93.3 percent in field trials, alongside teacher activity scores increasing from 80 percent to 90 percent.
results.id: Media yang dikembangkan memperoleh skor validasi ahli yang sangat tinggi: 93,7 persen dari ahli materi, 93 persen dari ahli media, dan 92,2 persen dari ahli desain. Kepraktisan ditunjukkan melalui tingkat respons siswa sebesar 92 persen pada uji coba terbatas dan 93,3 persen pada uji coba lapangan, beserta peningkatan skor aktivitas guru dari 80 persen menjadi 90 persen.

tldr.en: This study develops an interactive Genially Game for teaching intrinsic story elements to fourth-grade elementary students using the ADDIE model. The results show that the developed media achieves very high validity and practicality, making it suitable for classroom instruction.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengembangkan *Genially Game* interaktif untuk pembelajaran unsur intrinsik cerita bagi siswa kelas IV sekolah dasar menggunakan model *ADDIE*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa media yang dikembangkan mencapai validitas dan kepraktisan yang sangat tinggi sehingga layak digunakan dalam pembelajaran.

doi:10.51878/elementary.v6i3.10231.abstract: Communication skills are essential competencies that need to be developed in Indonesian language learning at the elementary school level. However, the communication skills of fifth-grade students at SDN 05 Beloyang remain uneven, particularly in speaking, listening, and nonverbal communication. This study aims to describe the communication skills of fifth-grade students at SDN 05 Beloyang in Indonesian language learning. This research employed a descriptive qualitative approach involving 15 fifth-grade students and one classroom teacher as research subjects. Data were collected through observation, interviews, and documentation. Data validity was examined through technique triangulation, while data analysis was conducted through data collection, data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing. The results show that students’ communication skills were generally in the fairly good category. In the speaking aspect, some students were able to perform and express ideas orally, while others still lacked confidence and were easily distracted by a noisy classroom atmosphere. In the listening aspect, most students showed attentive listening behavior, but their understanding was not evenly developed due to problems with focus and concentration. In the nonverbal communication aspect, students appeared more active through eye contact, facial expressions, and body movements during interaction. These findings imply that teachers need to create more conducive, interactive, and supportive Indonesian language learning activities to gradually improve students’ speaking confidence and listening skills. ABSTRAK Kemampuan komunikasi merupakan kompetensi penting yang perlu dikembangkan dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di sekolah dasar. Namun, kemampuan komunikasi siswa kelas V SDN 05 Beloyang masih belum merata, terutama pada aspek berbicara, mendengarkan, dan komunikasi nonverbal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mendeskripsikan kemampuan komunikasi siswa kelas V SDN 05 Beloyang dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif dengan subjek 15 siswa kelas V dan satu guru kelas. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Keabsahan data diperiksa melalui triangulasi teknik, sedangkan analisis data dilakukan melalui tahap pengumpulan data, reduksi data, penyajian data, dan penarikan kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kemampuan komunikasi siswa secara umum berada pada kategori cukup baik. Pada aspek berbicara, sebagian siswa mampu tampil dan menyampaikan gagasan secara lisan, tetapi sebagian lainnya masih kurang percaya diri dan mudah terganggu oleh suasana kelas yang bising. Pada aspek mendengarkan, sebagian besar siswa menunjukkan sikap menyimak, tetapi pemahaman mereka belum merata karena kendala fokus dan konsentrasi. Pada aspek komunikasi nonverbal, siswa tampak lebih aktif melalui kontak mata, ekspresi wajah, dan gerak tubuh saat berinteraksi. Temuan ini mengimplikasikan bahwa guru perlu menciptakan pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia yang lebih kondusif, interaktif, dan suportif untuk meningkatkan keberanian berbicara serta kemampuan menyimak siswa secara bertahap.

doi:10.51878/learning.v6i3.14341.abstract: The ability to analyze stories is an important skill in Indonesian language learning because it requires students to identify and interpret intrinsic elements of a narrative. However, students at the elementary school level may experience difficulties in analyzing story content when learning activities are less engaging and provide limited opportunities for active participation. This study aimed to examine the effect of the Picture and Picture learning model on third-grade students’ story analysis skills in Indonesian language learning. The study employed a quantitative approach with a pre-experimental design using a one-group pretest-posttest design. Data were collected through tests, observations, and documentation and analyzed using the Shapiro-Wilk normality test and paired-sample t-test. The findings indicate that the implementation of the Picture and Picture learning model was associated with an improvement in students’ ability to analyze stories. The statistical analysis also demonstrated a significant difference between students’ performance before and after the implementation of the learning model. These findings suggest that the Picture and Picture model can support students in understanding and analyzing intrinsic elements of stories through visual, structured, and interactive learning activities. The model may therefore serve as an alternative instructional approach for strengthening elementary students’ story analysis skills in Indonesian language learning. ABSTRAK Kemampuan menganalisis cerita merupakan salah satu keterampilan penting dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia karena berkaitan dengan kemampuan siswa memahami dan menghubungkan berbagai unsur dalam teks. Namun, kemampuan siswa dalam menganalisis unsur intrinsik cerita masih menjadi tantangan dalam pembelajaran di sekolah dasar. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh model pembelajaran picture and picture terhadap kemampuan menganalisis cerita pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia siswa kelas 3 SDN Pucang IV Sidoarjo. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain one group pretest-posttest. Sampel penelitian terdiri atas 25 siswa kelas 3-A yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes, observasi, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan uji normalitas Shapiro-Wilk dan paired sample t-test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kemampuan menganalisis cerita siswa mengalami peningkatan setelah penerapan model picture and picture. Pengujian statistik juga menunjukkan adanya perbedaan yang signifikan antara kemampuan siswa sebelum dan setelah penerapan model. Pencapaian indikator menunjukkan bahwa siswa mampu mengidentifikasi berbagai unsur intrinsik cerita, meskipun tingkat penguasaan pada setiap indikator masih beragam. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa model picture and picture dapat menjadi alternatif pembelajaran yang membantu siswa memahami dan menganalisis cerita melalui aktivitas visual yang terstruktur.

doi:10.51878/learning.v6i3.14842.abstract: Reading and comprehending fiction texts are important components of Indonesian language learning in elementary schools because they support students' ability to identify information, understand text content, and recognize story elements. However, learning practices dominated by conventional methods may limit student engagement and result in suboptimal learning achievement. This study aimed to determine the effect of the Whole Language approach on the Indonesian language learning outcomes of fifth-grade students at SDN Kludan, Tanggulangin District, Sidoarjo Regency, particularly in learning fiction texts. The study employed a quantitative approach using a quasi-experimental method with a Nonequivalent Control Group Design. The sample consisted of 54 students, including 27 students in the experimental class and 27 students in the control class. The research instruments included a learning achievement test and a student activity observation sheet. Data were analyzed through validity, reliability, normality, homogeneity, and hypothesis testing using an Independent Samples t-test. The results showed that the mean posttest score of the experimental class was 85.04, which was higher than that of the control class (71.37). The Independent Samples t-test indicated a statistically significant difference between the two groups (t(52) = −15.300, p < .001). Furthermore, student activity reached 87%, which was categorized as very active. Therefore, the implementation of the Whole Language approach significantly affected the Indonesian language learning outcomes of fifth-grade elementary school students. ABSTRAK Keterampilan membaca dan memahami teks fiksi merupakan bagian penting dalam pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di sekolah dasar karena mendukung kemampuan siswa dalam menemukan informasi, memahami isi bacaan, dan mengidentifikasi unsur-unsur cerita. Namun, pembelajaran yang masih didominasi metode konvensional dapat menyebabkan keterlibatan siswa rendah sehingga capaian hasil belajar belum optimal. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh penerapan pendekatan Whole Language terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia siswa kelas V SDN Kludan Kecamatan Tanggulangin Kabupaten Sidoarjo pada materi teks cerita fiksi. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan jenis quasi experiment dan desain Non equivalent Control Group Design. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 54 siswa yang terdiri atas 27 siswa kelas eksperimen dan 27 siswa kelas kontrol. Instrumen penelitian berupa tes hasil belajar dan lembar observasi keaktifan siswa. Analisis data meliputi uji validitas, reliabilitas, normalitas, homogenitas, dan uji hipotesis menggunakan Independent Sample t-Test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata nilai posttest kelas eksperimen sebesar 85,04, lebih tinggi dibandingkan kelas kontrol sebesar 71,37. Hasil uji Independent Sample t-Test menunjukkan nilai t(52) = -15,300 dengan Sig. (2-tailed) < 0,001, yang menunjukkan adanya perbedaan yang signifikan antara kelas eksperimen dan kelas kontrol. Selain itu, hasil observasi menunjukkan tingkat keaktifan siswa mencapai 87% dengan kategori sangat aktif. Dengan demikian, penerapan pendekatan Whole Language berpengaruh signifikan terhadap hasil belajar Bahasa Indonesia siswa kelas V SDN Kludan.

doi:10.51878/learning.v6i3.14843.abstract: Listening skills are an important language skill for elementary school students because they are related to the ability to understand and process information delivered orally. However, initial observations in the fourth-grade class at Pahlawan Nasional Private Elementary School Medan showed that students' listening skills were still not optimal, as indicated by difficulties in understanding information, answering questions, and maintaining attention during learning activities. This study aimed to determine the effect of the storytelling method on students' listening skills in Indonesian language learning in the fourth grade at Pahlawan Nasional Private Elementary School Medan. This study employed a quantitative approach with a quasi-experimental design using a nonequivalent control group design. The population consisted of 38 fourth-grade students from classes IV A and IV B, all of whom were selected as the sample using total sampling. Data were collected through observation and tests, while data were analyzed using normality, homogeneity, and independent samples t-test. The results showed that the mean posttest score of the experimental class was 85.21, while that of the control class was 70.71. The independent samples t-test resulted in a Sig. (2-tailed) value of 0.002 < 0.05. These results indicate a difference in students' listening skills between the experimental and control classes after the learning process, indicating that the storytelling method had an effect on fourth-grade students' listening skills in Indonesian language learning. ABSTRAK Keterampilan menyimak merupakan salah satu keterampilan berbahasa yang penting dikuasai peserta didik sekolah dasar karena berkaitan dengan kemampuan memahami dan mengolah informasi yang disampaikan secara lisan. Namun, hasil pengamatan awal di kelas IV SD Swasta Pahlawan Nasional Medan menunjukkan bahwa keterampilan menyimak peserta didik masih belum optimal, yang ditandai dengan kesulitan memahami informasi, menjawab pertanyaan, serta mempertahankan perhatian selama pembelajaran. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh metode storytelling terhadap keterampilan menyimak peserta didik pada pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas IV SD Swasta Pahlawan Nasional Medan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain quasi experimental tipe nonequivalent control group design. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 38 peserta didik yang terdiri atas kelas IV A dan IV B, dengan seluruh populasi dijadikan sampel melalui teknik total sampling. Pengumpulan data dilakukan melalui observasi dan tes, sedangkan analisis data menggunakan uji normalitas, homogenitas, dan independent samples t-test. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa rata-rata posttest kelas eksperimen sebesar 85,21, sedangkan kelas kontrol sebesar 70,71. Hasil uji independent samples t-test menunjukkan nilai Sig. (2-tailed) sebesar 0,002 < 0,05. Hasil tersebut menunjukkan adanya perbedaan keterampilan menyimak antara kelas eksperimen dan kelas kontrol setelah pembelajaran, sehingga metode storytelling berpengaruh terhadap keterampilan menyimak peserta didik kelas IV pada pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia.

doi:10.51878/strategi.v6i3.13696.abstract: ABSTRACT One important aspect of language proficiency is writing skill. Writing enables students to express their ideas, opinions, and thoughts clearly through written texts. This study aims to analyze errors in the use of the Indonesian language found in students' narrative essays. A descriptive research method was employed in this study. The data were collected from 55 narrative essays produced through a writing test. The analysis was based on the theory of language errors classified according to linguistic factors, with a focus on morphological and lexical errors. The findings reveal the presence of both morphological and lexical errors in students' essays. Morphological errors include incorrect use of affixes (prefixes, suffixes, and confixes), reduplication errors (both base-word and affixed-word reduplication), preposition errors (e.g., di and ke), and spelling or writing errors. Lexical errors involve inappropriate selection and use of Indonesian vocabulary as well as interference from regional languages, particularly Besemah, Palembang, and Javanese. The study further indicates that these errors are primarily caused by students’ lack of carefulness in writing and the influence of their regional language backgrounds. ABSTRAK Salah satu aspek penting dari kemahiran berbahasa adalah keterampilan menulis. Menulis memungkinkan siswa untuk mengekspresikan ide, pendapat, dan pemikiran mereka dengan jelas melalui teks tertulis. Studi ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis kesalahan dalam penggunaan bahasa Indonesia yang ditemukan dalam esai naratif siswa. Metode penelitian deskriptif digunakan dalam penelitian ini. Data dikumpulkan dari 55 esai naratif yang dihasilkan melalui tes menulis. Analisis didasarkan pada teori kesalahan bahasa yang diklasifikasikan menurut faktor linguistik, dengan fokus pada kesalahan morfologis dan leksikal. Temuan menunjukkan adanya kesalahan morfologis dan leksikal dalam esai siswa. Kesalahan morfologis meliputi penggunaan imbuhan yang salah (awalan, akhiran, dan konfiks), kesalahan reduplikasi (baik reduplikasi kata dasar maupun kata berimbuhan), kesalahan preposisi (misalnya, di dan ke), dan kesalahan ejaan atau penulisan. Kesalahan leksikal melibatkan pemilihan dan penggunaan kosakata bahasa Indonesia yang tidak tepat serta interferensi dari bahasa daerah, khususnya Besemah, Palembang, dan Jawa. Studi ini lebih lanjut menunjukkan bahwa kesalahan-kesalahan ini terutama disebabkan oleh kurangnya ketelitian siswa dalam menulis dan pengaruh latar belakang bahasa daerah mereka.

doi:10.51878/teaching.v6i3.12231.abstract: This research and development project aims to create a digital Snakes and Ladders game media for Indonesian language learning on the theme "Love for Indonesia" for fifth-grade students at SDN 17 Air Kumbang that is valid and practical. The method used is Research and Development (R&D) with the ADDIE model (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). The research subjects comprised 3 fifth-grade students in the one-to-one test and 15 fifth-grade students in the small group test. Data analysis results indicate that media validity reached an average of 95.23% (highly valid criteria) based on evaluations by three experts (media, language, content). The media practicality level obtained from student response questionnaires showed a percentage of 93.33% in the one-to-one test and 91.60% in the small group test, both meeting the "highly practical" criteria. Thus, the digital Snakes and Ladders game media for the "Love for Indonesia" material is declared valid and practical for use in elementary school Indonesian language learning. ABSTRAK Penelitian dan pengembangan ini bertujuan menciptakan media permainan ular tangga digital untuk pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia materi "Cinta Indonesia" kelas V SDN 17 Air Kumbang yang valid dan praktis. Metode yang digunakan adalah Research and Development (R&D) dengan model ADDIE (Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, Evaluation). Subjek penelitian terdiri dari 3 siswa kelas V pada uji one-to-one dan 15 siswa kelas V pada uji small group. Hasil analisis data menunjukkan kevalidan media mencapai rerata 95,23% (kriteria sangat valid) berdasarkan uji tiga ahli (media, bahasa, materi). Tingkat kepraktisan media yang diperoleh dari kuesioner respon siswa menunjukkan persentase sebesar 93,33% pada uji one-to-one dan 91,60% pada uji small group, yang keduanya memenuhi kriteria sangat praktis. Dengan demikian, media permainan ular tangga digital materi "Cinta Indonesia" dinyatakan valid dan praktis dipergunakan dalam proses pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia di sekolah dasar.

doi:10.52208/klasikal.v8i2.1890.abstract: The use of learners' first language (L1) in English as a Foreign Language (EFL) classrooms has become an important issue in multilingual education. While English-only instruction has traditionally been promoted, contemporary research suggests that strategic use of local languages can facilitate second language acquisition through cognitive and pedagogical support. This study investigated the role of Malay as a local language in the teaching of English writing at SMPN 4 Lubuklinggau, Indonesia. A qualitative case study design was employed involving one English teacher and Grade VII students. Data were collected through classroom observations, semi-structured interviews, and document analysis of students' writing. The data were analyzed using thematic analysis consisting of open coding, axial coding, and thematic categorization. The findings indicate that Malay functions as an effective pedagogical scaffold during English writing instruction. Teachers strategically used Malay to explain grammatical concepts, clarify writing tasks, facilitate brainstorming, and support vocabulary development. Students reported that Malay enabled them to generate ideas, organize paragraphs, reduce writing anxiety, and improve confidence in expressing ideas in English. However, the study also identified challenges, including grammatical interference, direct translation, and limited English vocabulary. These findings support Sociocultural Theory and Translanguaging Theory, demonstrating that learners' complete linguistic repertoire serves as a valuable cognitive resource rather than an obstacle to English learning. The study recommends strategic integration of local language during pre-writing and drafting stages while maintaining sufficient English exposure during revision and final composition
