doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5215.abstract: Data processing in waste bank management systems faces substantial challenges when extracting structured information from unstructured textual data containing transaction records, customer information, and waste categorization details. This study develops and validates an automated Named Entity Recognition (NER) system based on the IndoBERT transformer architecture to process textual records from Makassar waste bank operations. The approach fine-tunes the indolem/indobert-base-uncased model through domain-specific adaptation targeting waste management vocabulary and operational terminology. The dataset comprises 975 textual records collected from 8 Waste Bank Units in Makassar City. These records were systematically annotated using the BIO tagging scheme for eight entity types: B-LOCATION, B-PERSON, B-WASTE_CATEGORY, B-WASTE_TYPE, I-PERSON, I-WASTE_CATEGORY, I-WASTE_TYPE, and O. The dataset was partitioned into training (682 samples, 69.9%), validation (146 samples, 15.0%), and test sets (147 samples, 15.1%) using stratified sampling methodology with high inter-annotator agreement (κ=0.91). Experimental results show outstanding performance with 94.37% test accuracy, 90.65% precision, 94.37% recall, and 92.21% F1-score, outperforming general-purpose Indonesian NER approaches. Perfect performance was achieved for waste type recognition (B-WASTE_TYPE: 100% F1-score) and location identification (B-LOCATION: 100% F1-score), while waste category classification reached 96% F1-score. This implementation successfully automates entity extraction from Makassar waste bank textual data, reducing manual processing time by 95% while maintaining high accuracy levels. This research makes important contributions to Indonesian environmental natural language processing. These contributions include transformer adaptation methodologies for resource-constrained domains, validated IndoBERT performance on Indonesian waste bank data, the first Indonesian waste management NER dataset, and demonstrated feasibility of NLP-based environmental policy systems.

glossary.explanation_id: Named Entity Recognition adalah tugas *natural language processing* untuk mengidentifikasi dan mengklasifikasikan entitas bernama di dalam teks ke dalam kategori yang telah ditentukan.
IndoBERT adalah model bahasa berbasis *transformer* pra-latih yang dilatih khusus pada korpus teks bahasa Indonesia.
BIO tagging adalah skema anotasi yang menandai awal, bagian dalam, dan luar dari suatu entitas dalam token teks.
fine-tuning adalah proses penyesuaian lanjutan pada model pra-latih menggunakan data spesifik domain untuk tugas tertentu.
tokenizer adalah komponen perangkat lunak yang memecah teks masukan menjadi unit-unit token yang lebih kecil seperti kata atau subkata.
stratified sampling adalah metode pengambilan sampel yang memastikan proporsi kelas atau kategori tetap seimbang di setiap bagian dataset.
transformer adalah arsitektur *deep learning* yang mengandalkan mekanisme *attention* untuk memproses data sekuensial secara paralel.
low-resource merujuk pada kondisi di mana data beranotasi atau sumber daya komputasi untuk suatu bahasa atau domain sangat terbatas.

background.en: Processing waste bank data in Indonesia faces substantial challenges due to regional linguistic diversity, inconsistent data entry protocols, and specialized terminology associated with waste management. Conventional manual approaches are excessively time-intensive, error-prone, and lack scalability as textual data volumes expand across nationwide waste banks. These limitations create major barriers to leveraging waste bank data for environmental monitoring, policy formulation, and operational optimization. To address these gaps, the study develops an automated Named Entity Recognition system specifically tailored for waste bank textual data.
background.id: Pemrosesan data bank sampah di Indonesia menghadapi tantangan besar akibat keragaman linguistik regional, protokol masukan data yang tidak konsisten, dan terminologi khusus yang terkait dengan pengelolaan sampah. Pendekatan manual konvensional terbukti sangat menyita waktu, rentan kesalahan, dan kurang skalabel seiring meningkatnya volume data teks di seluruh bank sampah nasional. Keterbatasan ini menciptakan hambatan utama dalam memanfaatkan data bank sampah untuk pemantauan lingkungan, perumusan kebijakan, dan optimalisasi operasional. Untuk mengatasi kesenjangan ini, studi ini mengembangkan sistem *Named Entity Recognition* otomatis yang dirancang khusus untuk data teks bank sampah.

contributions.en: This research makes three primary contributions to Indonesian natural language processing and environmental informatics. First, it develops the first domain-specific Named Entity Recognition model for Indonesian waste bank data processing using IndoBERT with systematic fine-tuning. Second, it creates and contributes a complete annotated dataset of 975 textual records collected from eight operational waste bank units in Makassar City, annotated using the BIO tagging scheme. Third, it provides rigorous empirical validation achieving 94.37% test accuracy and 92.21% F1-score, demonstrating a 95% reduction in manual processing time.
contributions.id: Penelitian ini memberikan tiga kontribusi utama bagi *natural language processing* bahasa Indonesia dan informatika lingkungan. Pertama, penelitian ini mengembangkan model *Named Entity Recognition* spesifik domain pertama untuk pemrosesan data bank sampah Indonesia menggunakan IndoBERT dengan *fine-tuning* sistematis. Kedua, penelitian ini menciptakan dan berkontribusi pada dataset beranotasi lengkap sebanyak 975 catatan teks yang dikumpulkan dari delapan unit bank sampah operasional di Kota Makassar, yang dianotasi menggunakan skema penandaan BIO. Ketiga, penelitian ini memberikan validasi empiris yang ketat dengan mencapai akurasi pengujian sebesar 94,37% dan skor F1 92,21%, serta mendemonstrasikan pengurangan waktu pemrosesan manual sebesar 95%.

future_work.en: The authors acknowledge limitations including the dataset drawing exclusively from Makassar City, limiting generalizability to other Indonesian regions with different linguistic patterns. Future work directions include enhancing the model with multilingual NER capabilities for regional code-switching, exploring active learning strategies to reduce annotation overhead, investigating model compression techniques for mobile environments, and adapting the framework for additional environmental management applications such as water quality and air pollution.
future_work.id: Para penulis mengakui adanya keterbatasan, termasuk dataset yang bersumber secara eksklusif dari Kota Makassar, sehingga membatasi generalisasi ke wilayah Indonesia lain dengan pola linguistik yang berbeda. Arah penelitian masa depan meliputi peningkatan model dengan kapabilitas NER multibahasa untuk *code-switching* regional, eksplorasi strategi *active learning* untuk mengurangi beban anotasi, investigasi teknik kompresi model untuk lingkungan seluler, serta adaptasi kerangka kerja untuk aplikasi pengelolaan lingkungan tambahan seperti kualitas air dan polusi udara.

method.en: The research methodology consists of data collection and preprocessing, entity annotation, model configuration and fine-tuning, training optimization, and model evaluation. Textual records were collected from eight Waste Bank Units in Makassar City and preprocessed using UTF-8 normalization, abbreviation standardization, mixed-language handling, and WordPiece tokenization. Entity annotation employed the BIO tagging scheme across eight entity types. The classification model fine-tunes the indolem/indobert-base-uncased transformer with a learning rate of 2e-5, batch size of 16, and AdamW optimizer over 3 epochs. Evaluation relies on precision, recall, F1-score, and accuracy metrics using stratified cross-validation.
method.id: Metodologi penelitian ini terdiri dari pengumpulan dan *preprocessing* data, anotasi entitas, konfigurasi dan *fine-tuning* model, optimasi pelatihan, serta evaluasi model. Catatan teks dikumpulkan dari delapan unit bank sampah di Kota Makassar dan diproses melalui normalisasi UTF-8, standardisasi singkatan, penanganan bahasa campuran, dan *tokenization* WordPiece. Anotasi entitas menggunakan skema penandaan BIO pada delapan jenis entitas. Model klasifikasi melakukan *fine-tuning* pada *transformer* *indolem/indobert-base-uncased* dengan *learning rate* 2e-5, *batch size* 16, dan *optimizer* *AdamW* selama 3 *epoch*. Evaluasi mengandalkan metrik *precision*, *recall*, *F1-score*, dan *akurasi* menggunakan *cross-validation* stratifikasi.

related_work.en: Prior research in Indonesian Named Entity Recognition largely focuses on general domains such as news articles, legal documents, and financial records, leaving specialized environmental applications underexplored. Previous studies explored disaster named entity recognition using BiLSTM architecture and personal financial entity extraction using IndoBERT-BiGRU-CRF models. However, existing Indonesian NER research has not adequately addressed informal community terminology mixed with regional dialects and domain-specific waste management vocabulary. This research builds upon transformer-based models and adapts them to low-resource environmental information systems.
related_work.id: Penelitian sebelumnya dalam *Named Entity Recognition* bahasa Indonesia sebagian besar berfokus pada domain umum seperti artikel berita, dokumen hukum, dan catatan keuangan, sehingga aplikasi lingkungan khusus masih kurang dieksplorasi. Studi terdahulu mengeksplorasi *named entity recognition* bencana menggunakan arsitektur BiLSTM dan ekstraksi entitas keuangan pribadi menggunakan model *IndoBERT-BiGRU-CRF*. Namun, riset NER bahasa Indonesia yang ada belum secara memadai menangani terminologi komunitas informal yang bercampur dengan dialek regional dan kosakata pengelolaan sampah yang spesifik domain. Penelitian ini membangun karya di atas model berbasis *transformer* dan mengadaptasikannya ke sistem informasi lingkungan *low-resource*.

results.en: The IndoBERT-based NER model achieved outstanding performance on the test set of 147 records, obtaining an accuracy of 94.37%, precision of 90.65%, recall of 94.37%, and an F1-score of 92.21%. Entity-type analysis showed perfect performance for B-LOCATION, B-WASTE_TYPE, I-WASTE_CATEGORY, and I-WASTE_TYPE with 100% F1-scores, while B-WASTE_CATEGORY reached 96% and B-PERSON achieved 90%. The authors interpret these strong results as evidence that domain-specific fine-tuning effectively handles specialized waste management terminology despite the complexity of Indonesian naming conventions and informal dialects.
results.id: Model NER berbasis IndoBERT mencapai performa luar biasa pada set pengujian yang terdiri dari 147 catatan, dengan memperoleh akurasi 94,37%, *precision* 90,65%, *recall* 94,37%, dan skor F1 sebesar 92,21%. Analisis tingkat entitas menunjukkan performa sempurna untuk B-LOCATION, B-WASTE_TYPE, I-WASTE_CATEGORY, dan I-WASTE_TYPE dengan skor F1 100%, sementara B-WASTE_CATEGORY mencapai 96% dan B-PERSON mencapai 90%. Para penulis menginterpretasikan hasil yang kuat ini sebagai bukti bahwa *fine-tuning* spesifik domain secara efektif menangani terminologi pengelolaan sampah khusus meskipun terdapat kompleksitas konvensi penamaan Indonesia dan dialek informal.

tldr.en: This paper develops an automated Named Entity Recognition system using IndoBERT for Indonesian waste bank data processing. The proposed approach achieves an F1-score of 92.21% and reduces manual processing time by 95 percent.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengembangkan sistem *Named Entity Recognition* otomatis menggunakan IndoBERT untuk pemrosesan data bank sampah di Indonesia. Pendekatan yang diusulkan mencapai skor F1 sebesar 92,21% dan mereduksi waktu pemrosesan manual hingga 95 persen.

doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5215.title: IndoBERT-based Named Entity Recognition Using Transformer Model for Indonesian Waste Bank Data Processing

doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5444.abstract: Over the past few years, researches on Big Five personality prediction model focusing on Indonesian tweets has mostly faced data scarcity and imbalance problem. This study aims to build Big Five personality prediction models for the low-resource language setting using Indonesian social media texts in platform X, and conduct a comparative performance analysis using deep learning model (hybrid BiLSTM-BiGRU) and transferred learning models (IndoBERT and IndoXLNet) with the optimization using various data augmentation and feature expansion techniques to overcome data scarcity and imbalance. We carried out data collection of 11746 tweets from hybrid sources (BFI questionnaire and keyword-based crawling), preprocessing using tokenization and stemming, extraction using Word2Vec and FastText, data augmentation (using SYN-REP, BACK-TRANS, RAND-INS, and SMOTE variants), Top-N feature expansion (with N = 1, 5, and 10), hyperparameter tuning using Optuna (for learning rate, batch size, dropout rate, and weight decay), and evaluating the model's accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. The result shows that IndoBERTweet+BACK-TRANS+Top-10 achieved 84% accuracy and an F1-score of 81.5%, surpassing IndoXLNet+BACKTRANS+Top-5 (82%) and LSTM+GRU+FastText+KMeansSMOTE+Top-5 (78%), with the BACK-TRANS technique improves overall F1 result by 13%. These findings bolster computational psychology informatics for low-resource NLP focusing on Indonesian language, as well as aiding mental health screening with 18% better generalization in imbalanced data, and enabling scalable trait inference in human resource and mental health applications.

glossary.explanation_id: Kondisi minimnya ketersediaan data latih yang memadai untuk melatih *model bahasa* secara efektif.
Ketimpangan jumlah sampel data antar-kelas kategori dalam suatu *dataset*.
Teknik memperkaya dimensi fitur dengan menambahkan token yang memiliki kemiripan makna.
Metode augmentasi teks dengan menerjemahkan teks ke bahasa lain lalu menerjemahkannya kembali ke bahasa asal.
Proses pencarian pengaturan parameter terbaik untuk mengoptimalkan kinerja *model*.
Metode *evaluasi* *model* dengan membagi *dataset* menjadi beberapa bagian untuk pelatihan dan pengujian secara bergantian.
Pendekatan yang menggabungkan berbagai jenis data masukan seperti teks, gambar, dan angka.

background.en: Research on Big Five personality prediction using Indonesian social media texts frequently encounters data scarcity and significant class imbalance. These limitations hinder the development of robust computational models for low-resource languages, impacting applications in mental health screening and human resource analytics where reliable personality trait inference is critical.
background.id: Penelitian mengenai prediksi kepribadian *Big Five* menggunakan teks media sosial berbahasa Indonesia sering kali menghadapi kelangkaan data dan ketidakseimbangan kelas yang signifikan. Keterbatasan ini menghambat pengembangan model komputasi yang tangguh untuk *low-resource language*, yang berdampak pada aplikasi penyaringan kesehatan mental dan analitik sumber daya manusia di mana inferensi sifat kepribadian yang andal sangat penting.

contributions.en: The study introduces a hybrid dataset of 11,746 Indonesian tweets collected via BFI questionnaires and keyword crawling with ethical labeling. It systematically evaluates data augmentation methods, oversampling techniques, and FastText feature expansion across a hybrid BiLSTM-BiGRU model and transformer models including IndoBERT, IndoBERTweet, and IndoXLNet.
contributions.id: Studi ini memperkenalkan *dataset* hibrida yang terdiri dari 11.746 twit berbahasa Indonesia yang dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner BFI dan *crawling* berbasis kata kunci dengan pelabelan etis. Penelitian ini secara sistematis mengevaluasi metode augmentasi data, teknik *oversampling*, dan ekspansi fitur FastText pada model hibrida BiLSTM-BiGRU serta *transformer* termasuk IndoBERT, IndoBERTweet, dan IndoXLNet.

future_work.en: Future work includes exploring multi-label and multi-modal personality prediction incorporating emojis, tabular attributes, and image data. Additionally, researchers plan to utilize large language models and generative AI like GPT-4o for more adaptive data augmentation to further improve model accuracy and scalability.
future_work.id: Penelitian mendatang mencakup eksplorasi prediksi kepribadian *multi-label* dan *multi-modal* dengan menggabungkan emoji, atribut tabular, dan data citra. Selain itu, peneliti berencana memanfaatkan *large language model* dan *generative AI* seperti GPT-4o untuk augmentasi data yang lebih adaptif guna meningkatkan akurasi dan skalabilitas model lebih lanjut.

method.en: Data preprocessing involves lowercasing, cleaning, normalization, stopword removal, tokenization, and stemming via Sastrawi. Features are extracted using Word2Vec and FastText, followed by augmentation techniques like synonym replacement, back-translation, random insertion, and SMOTE variants, alongside Top-N feature expansion. Models are trained using 10-fold cross-validation with Optuna hyperparameter tuning.
method.id: Praproses data mencakup pengubahan huruf kecil, pembersihan, normalisasi, penghapusan *stopword*, *tokenization*, dan *stemming* melalui Sastrawi. Fitur diekstraksi menggunakan Word2Vec dan FastText, diikuti oleh teknik augmentasi seperti *synonym replacement*, *back-translation*, *random insertion*, dan varian SMOTE, beserta ekspansi fitur *Top-N*. Model dilatih menggunakan *10-fold cross-validation* dengan *hyperparameter tuning* menggunakan Optuna.

related_work.en: Previous studies on Indonesian social media text classification, such as sentiment analysis and depression detection, have explored feature expansion using Word2Vec and FastText to address vocabulary mismatches. However, prior personality prediction works on Indonesian Twitter data often suffered from low F1-scores due to the lack of text data augmentation and ethical multi-annotator labeling.
related_work.id: Studi sebelumnya tentang klasifikasi teks media sosial berbahasa Indonesia, seperti analisis sentimen dan deteksi depresi, telah mengeksplorasi ekspansi fitur menggunakan Word2Vec dan FastText untuk mengatasi ketidakcocokan kosakata. Namun, penelitian prediksi kepribadian terdahulu pada data Twitter Indonesia sering kali mengalami skor F1 yang rendah karena kurangnya augmentasi data teks dan pelabelan *multi-annotator* yang etis.

results.en: IndoBERTweet with back-translation and top-10 feature expansion achieved the best performance with an 84 percent accuracy and an 81.5 percent F1-score, outperforming IndoXLNet and the hybrid LSTM-GRU model. Back-translation improved overall F1 results by 13 percent, while FastText feature expansion reduced class imbalance variance by 15 percent compared to the baseline.
results.id: IndoBERTweet dengan *back-translation* dan ekspansi fitur *top-10* mencapai performa terbaik dengan akurasi 84 persen dan skor F1 81,5 persen, mengungguli IndoXLNet dan model hibrida LSTM-GRU. *Back-translation* meningkatkan hasil F1 secara keseluruhan sebesar 13 persen, sementara ekspansi fitur FastText mengurangi varians ketidakseimbangan kelas sebesar 15 persen dibandingkan *baseline*.

tldr.en: This study builds Big Five personality prediction models for Indonesian tweets using deep learning and transfer learning with data augmentation and feature expansion techniques. The results show that IndoBERTweet combined with back-translation and top-10 feature expansion achieves the highest accuracy of 84 percent.
tldr.id: Studi ini membangun model prediksi kepribadian *Big Five* untuk twit bahasa Indonesia menggunakan *deep learning* dan *transfer learning* dengan teknik augmentasi data dan ekspansi fitur. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa IndoBERTweet yang dikombinasikan dengan *back-translation* dan ekspansi fitur *top-10* mencapai akurasi tertinggi sebesar 84 persen.

doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5444.title: Enhancing Big Five Personality Prediction on Indonesian Tweets: A Comparative Study of LSTM-GRU Hybrid and IndoBERT/IndoXLNet with Augmentation Techniques

doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5652.abstract: The effectiveness of suicide prevention in Indonesia is severely hindered by significant underreporting and social stigma, leading at-risk individuals to express their distress on social media platforms such as Twitter. However, detecting these signals is computationally challenging due to the informal nature of Indonesian slang and the risk of losing emotional context through aggressive pre-processing. This study aims to evaluate the performance of various deep learning and traditional models in detecting suicidal ideation while specifically analyzing the impact of syntactic preservation. We performed a comparative analysis using IndoBERT, Multilingual BERT (mBERT), and three baseline models including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest which were evaluated through two distinct pre-processing strategies, namely Dataset A (fully preprocessed) and Dataset B (partially preprocessed). Experimental results demonstrate that IndoBERT achieved the highest performance on Dataset B with an accuracy of 90.6%, outperforming traditional baselines. The results indicate that omitting stopword removal and stemming is more effective for transformer-based architectures, as retaining original word forms helps preserve semantic integrity and emotional nuances required for contextual understanding. These findings highlight the importance of context-aware solutions to bridge the data gap in public health. By providing a robust computational framework that maintains linguistic integrity, this research has the potential to facilitate scalable, real-time interventions for supporting the identification of high-risk individuals within the Indonesian digital landscape. This study contributes to the development of automated mental health screening tools by demonstrating the potential of NLP-based methods for detecting psychological distress in low-resource, informal languages.

glossary.explanation_id: IndoBERT adalah model *transformer* pratelatih yang dioptimalkan khusus untuk pemrosesan teks *bahasa Indonesia*.
Multilingual BERT adalah model bahasa berbasis *BERT* yang dilatih menggunakan korpus dari berbagai bahasa secara bersamaan.
*Tokenization* adalah proses memecah teks kalimat menjadi unit-unit kata atau token yang lebih kecil untuk analisis komputasi.
*Stemming* adalah proses menghilangkan imbuhan pada kata untuk mengembalikannya ke bentuk dasar.
*Stopword Removal* adalah tahapan penyisihan kata umum yang memiliki frekuensi kemunculan tinggi namun bernilai informasi rendah.
TF-IDF adalah metode *vektorisasi* teks yang mengukur pentingnya suatu kata dalam dokumen relatif terhadap sekumpulan korpus.
*Fine-tuning* adalah proses melatih ulang model pratelatih menggunakan dataset spesifik untuk tugas hilir tertentu.
*Confusion matrix* adalah tabel evaluasi yang memetakan performa klasifikasi berdasarkan prediksi benar dan salah.

background.en: Suicide prevention in Indonesia is severely hindered by significant underreporting and social stigma, leading at-risk individuals to express their distress on social media platforms like Twitter. However, detecting these signals is computationally challenging due to the informal nature of Indonesian slang, abbreviations, and code-mixing. Furthermore, aggressive text pre-processing risks stripping away vital emotional context and linguistic nuances required for accurate psychological assessment.
background.id: Pencegahan bunuh diri di Indonesia sangat terhambat oleh pelaporan yang rendah dan stigma sosial, sehingga individu berisiko sering mengekspresikan tekanan psikologis mereka pada platform *media sosial* seperti Twitter. Akan tetapi, mendeteksi sinyal-sinyal ini secara komputasi menjadi tantangan tersendiri akibat sifat informal dari bahasa gaul, singkatan, dan *code-mixing* dalam bahasa Indonesia. Selain itu, *pre-processing* teks yang agresif berisiko menghilangkan konteks emosional penting serta nuansa linguistik yang diperlukan untuk penilaian psikologis yang akurat.

contributions.en: This study contributes to automated mental health screening by evaluating pre-trained BERT-based architectures, specifically IndoBERT and Multilingual BERT, against traditional machine learning baselines on Indonesian Twitter data. Its primary novelty lies in the systematic evaluation of two pre-processing scenarios: Dataset A with full cleaning including stemming and stopword removal, and Dataset B with partial pre-processing that retains original word forms and pronouns to preserve syntactic integrity.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi pada penyaringan kesehatan mental otomatis dengan mengevaluasi arsitektur berbasis *BERT* yang telah dilatih sebelumnya, khususnya IndoBERT dan *Multilingual BERT*, terhadap *baseline machine learning* tradisional pada data Twitter Indonesia. Kebaruan utamanya terletak pada evaluasi sistematis dari dua skenario *pre-processing*: Dataset A dengan pembersihan penuh termasuk *stemming* dan *stopword removal*, serta Dataset B dengan *pre-processing* sebagian yang mempertahankan bentuk kata asli dan kata ganti untuk menjaga integritas sintaksis.

future_work.en: The authors state that the study is limited by its focus on unimodal text analysis, restricted hyperparameter tuning, and lack of historical user context. Future research aims to address these constraints by developing multimodal frameworks that integrate images and video, employing automated hyperparameter optimization, and incorporating user-level behavioral patterns.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyatakan bahwa penelitian ini dibatasi oleh fokusnya pada analisis teks unimodal, pengaturan *hyperparameter* yang terbatas, dan kurangnya konteks pengguna historis. Penelitian mendatang bertujuan untuk mengatasi kendala tersebut dengan mengembangkan kerangka kerja multimodal yang mengintegrasikan gambar dan video, menerapkan optimasi *hyperparameter* otomatis, dan memasukkan pola perilaku tingkat pengguna.

method.en: The dataset comprises 4,001 tweets collected via the Twitter Academic Search API, evenly split between suicidal ideation and non-suicidal classes and validated by a professional psychologist. The text pipeline includes case folding, data cleaning, tokenization, and normalization, branched into Dataset A (fully preprocessed with stopword removal and stemming) and Dataset B (partially preprocessed, omitting stopword removal and stemming). Models including IndoBERT, mBERT, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, and Random Forest were trained and evaluated using a 70:15:15 stratified split across accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score.
method.id: Dataset ini terdiri dari 4.001 twit yang dikumpulkan melalui *Twitter Academic Search API*, dibagi secara merata antara kelas ide bunuh diri dan non-bunuh diri serta divalidasi oleh psikolog profesional. Alur teks mencakup *case folding*, *pembersihan data*, *tokenisasi*, dan *normalisasi*, yang bercabang menjadi Dataset A (diproses penuh dengan *stopword removal* dan *stemming*) serta Dataset B (diproses sebagian tanpa *stopword removal* dan *stemming*). Model termasuk IndoBERT, *mBERT*, *Logistic Regression*, *Support Vector Machine*, dan *Random Forest* dilatih dan dievaluasi menggunakan pembagian stratifikasi 70:15:15 berdasarkan akurasi, *precision*, *recall*, dan *F1-score*.

related_work.en: Previous studies on suicidal ideation detection have predominantly focused on high-resource languages such as English, leaving a gap in developing robust models for Indonesian. Prior Indonesian-centric research often relies on traditional machine learning or basic deep learning architectures that struggle with informal slang and emotional syntax. While a recent hybrid IndoBERT-Large and LSTM approach achieved high accuracy, it relied on extensive pre-processing and formal normalization, and a general consensus was lacking regarding the impact of text cleaning in mental health contexts.
related_work.id: Studi-studi sebelumnya mengenai deteksi ide bunuh diri sebagian besar berfokus pada bahasa dengan sumber daya tinggi seperti bahasa Inggris, sehingga menyisakan celah dalam mengembangkan model yang tangguh untuk bahasa Indonesia. Penelitian terdahulu yang berfokus pada bahasa Indonesia sering kali mengandalkan *machine learning* tradisional atau arsitektur *deep learning* dasar yang mengalami kesulitan dalam mengatasi bahasa gaul informal dan sintaksis emosional. Meskipun pendekatan hibrida *IndoBERT-Large* dan *LSTM* baru-baru ini mencapai akurasi tinggi, pendekatan tersebut bergantung pada *pre-processing* ekstensif dan normalisasi formal, serta masih kurangnya konsensus mengenai dampak pembersihan teks dalam konteks kesehatan mental.

results.en: Experimental results demonstrate that IndoBERT on Dataset B at 16 epochs achieved the highest performance with a precision of 90.4%, recall of 90.8%, F1-score of 90.6%, and overall accuracy of 90.6%, outperforming traditional baselines like Logistic Regression at 86.2%. Both IndoBERT and mBERT showed performance gains on Dataset B, indicating that omitting stopword removal and stemming helps preserve semantic integrity and emotional nuances required by transformer architectures. Confusion matrix analysis further confirmed superior sensitivity with fewer false negatives.
results.id: Hasil eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa IndoBERT pada Dataset B dengan 16 *epoch* mencapai performa tertinggi dengan *precision* 90,4%, *recall* 90,8%, *F1-score* 90,6%, dan akurasi keseluruhan 90,6%, mengungguli *baseline* tradisional seperti *Logistic Regression* sebesar 86,2%. Baik IndoBERT maupun *mBERT* menunjukkan peningkatan performa pada Dataset B, yang mengindikasikan bahwa menghilangkan *stopword removal* dan *stemming* membantu menjaga integritas semantik dan nuansa emosional yang dibutuhkan oleh arsitektur *transformer*. Analisis *confusion matrix* lebih lanjut mengonfirmasi sensitivitas yang superior dengan jumlah *false negative* yang lebih sedikit.

tldr.en: This paper evaluates deep learning and traditional models for detecting suicidal ideation on Indonesian Twitter, comparing full and partial pre-processing strategies. The results demonstrate that IndoBERT with partial pre-processing achieves the highest accuracy of 90.6% by preserving syntactic structure and emotional nuances.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengevaluasi *deep learning* dan model tradisional untuk mendeteksi ide bunuh diri pada Twitter di Indonesia dengan membandingkan strategi *pre-processing* penuh dan sebagian. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa IndoBERT dengan *pre-processing* sebagian mencapai akurasi tertinggi sebesar 90,6% dengan mempertahankan struktur sintaksis dan nuansa emosional.

doi:10.52436/1.jutif.2026.7.4.5652.title: Suicidal Ideation Detection on Twitter in Indonesia: A Comparative Transfer Learning Study using IndoBERT and Multilingual BERT

doi:10.52465/joiser.v4i3.85.abstract: Clickbait is an increasingly prevalent phenomenon in Indonesian online news media, where headlines are crafted to attract clicks without accurately reflecting article content. This study proposes and compares eight classification models: three shallow learning algorithms — Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Logistic Regression — and five transformer-based deep learning models: IndoBERT-p1, IndoBERT-p2, XLM-RoBERTa, mBERT, and DistilBERT. The dataset used is CLICK-ID, consisting of 15,000 labeled headlines from 12 Indonesian news portals, expanded to 25,138 samples via semi-supervised pseudo labeling with a confidence threshold of 0.85. All deep learning models were trained with Focal Loss (α=0.25, γ=2.0) to address class imbalance and Automatic Mixed Precision (AMP) for GPU efficiency. Results show that IndoBERT-p1, IndoBERT-p2, XLM-RoBERTa, mBERT, and DistilBERT achieve comparable performance, with macro F1-scores ranging from 86.57% to 88.54%. Among shallow learning models, SVM performs best with 83.51% F1-score. An average ensemble of all five transformer models achieves the best overall performance at 90.14% accuracy and 89.00% F1-score, outperforming every individual model. This study contributes to Indonesian clickbait detection research by demonstrating that ensemble aggregation of diverse transformer architectures yields more reliable performance than reliance on any single model.

Arsitektur *deep learning* berbasis mekanisme *self-attention* yang merevolusi bidang *natural language processing*.
Teknik *semi-supervised learning* di mana model yang terlatih menghasilkan label untuk data yang belum beranotasi.
Fungsi kerugian yang memberikan bobot lebih besar pada sampel yang sulit diklasifikasikan guna mengatasi ketidakseimbangan kelas.

Metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rata-rata *F1-score* dari setiap kelas untuk memberikan bobot yang sama pada setiap kategori.

background.en: Clickbait headlines in Indonesian online news media mislead readers to maximize click numbers, contributing to disinformation and eroding public trust. While natural language processing research on clickbait detection is extensive for English, studies targeting Bahasa Indonesia remain limited, and a systematic comparison between traditional shallow learning and transformer-based deep learning combined with pseudo-labeling has not been thoroughly explored.
background.id: *Headline clickbait* dalam media berita *online* Indonesia menyesatkan pembaca demi memaksimalkan jumlah klik, yang berkontribusi pada disinformasi dan merusak kepercayaan publik. Meskipun penelitian *natural language processing* tentang deteksi *clickbait* sangat luas untuk bahasa Inggris, studi yang menargetkan bahasa Indonesia masih terbatas, dan perbandingan sistematis antara *shallow learning* tradisional serta *deep learning* berbasis *transformer* yang dikombinasikan dengan *pseudo-labeling* belum dieksplorasi secara menyeluruh.

contributions.en: This study contributes to Indonesian clickbait detection research by comprehensively comparing three shallow learning algorithms and five transformer-based deep learning models under a unified experimental setup. It evaluates the impact of semi-supervised pseudo-labeling for dataset expansion, analyzes Focal Loss for handling class imbalance, and demonstrates that ensemble aggregation of diverse transformer architectures yields more reliable performance than any single model.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi pada penelitian deteksi *clickbait* bahasa Indonesia dengan membandingkan secara komprehensif tiga algoritma *shallow learning* dan lima model *deep learning* berbasis *transformer* di bawah pengaturan eksperimental yang seragam. Studi ini mengevaluasi dampak *pseudo-labeling* semi-supervisi untuk perluasan data, menganalisis *Focal Loss* dalam menangani ketidakseimbangan kelas, serta mendemonstrasikan bahwa *ensemble* agregasi dari berbagai arsitektur *transformer* menghasilkan performa yang lebih andal daripada model tunggal apa pun.

future_work.en: A limitation noted by the authors concerns the data splitting procedure, where pseudo-labeled samples were incorporated into the combined dataset prior to stratified splitting, resulting in approximately 40 percent of the validation and test sets consisting of pseudo-labeled rather than human-annotated instances.
future_work.id: Keterbatasan yang dicatat oleh penulis berkaitan dengan prosedur pembagian data, di mana sampel *pseudo-labeled* dimasukkan ke dalam korpus gabungan sebelum pembagian berstrata, yang mengakibatkan sekitar 40 persen dari set validasi dan uji terdiri dari instans berlabel semu daripada instans beranotasi manusia.

method.en: The study uses the CLICK-ID dataset comprising 15,000 labeled headlines, expanded to 25,138 samples using IndoBERT-p1 pseudo-labeling with a confidence threshold of 0.85. The shallow learning models use TF-IDF features with unigram and bigram combinations, while the deep learning models utilize five transformer architectures trained with Focal Loss and Automatic Mixed Precision. Evaluation metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, and macro F1-score across a stratified train, validation, and test split.
method.id: Studi ini menggunakan korpus *CLICK-ID* yang terdiri dari 15.000 *headline* beranotasi, yang diperluas menjadi 25.138 sampel menggunakan *pseudo-labeling* *IndoBERT-p1* dengan ambang batas keyakinan 0,85. Model *shallow learning* menggunakan fitur *TF-IDF* dengan kombinasi *unigram* dan *bigram*, sementara model *deep learning* memanfaatkan lima arsitektur *transformer* yang dilatih menggunakan *Focal Loss* dan *Automatic Mixed Precision*. Metrik evaluasi mencakup akurasi, presisi, *recall*, dan *macro F1-score* di seluruh pembagian data latih, validasi, dan uji yang berstrata.

related_work.en: Prior research on clickbait detection relied on simple text-based features with traditional classification algorithms, recurrent neural networks with character-level CNN embeddings, and ensemble machine learning. For Indonesian news, William and Sari introduced the CLICK-ID dataset, followed by studies applying M-BERT and comparing BERT with DistilBERT. However, these prior works evaluated single architectures or narrow pairs in isolation without a comprehensive comparison spanning shallow learning and multiple transformer models within a unified pipeline.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu tentang deteksi *clickbait* mengandalkan fitur berbasis teks sederhana dengan algoritma klasifikasi tradisional, *recurrent neural network* dengan *embedding* CNN tingkat karakter, serta *ensemble machine learning*. Untuk berita bahasa Indonesia, William dan Sari memperkenalkan korpus *CLICK-ID*, diikuti oleh studi yang menerapkan *M-BERT* dan membandingkan *BERT* dengan *DistilBERT*. Namun, karya-karya terdahulu ini mengevaluasi arsitektur tunggal atau pasangan sempit secara terisolasi tanpa perbandingan komprehensif yang mencakup *shallow learning* dan beberapa model *transformer* dalam satu *pipeline* yang seragam.

results.en: Deep learning models consistently outperform shallow learning models by 3 to 5 percent in F1-score, with IndoBERT-p1 achieving the highest individual deep learning score and SVM leading the shallow learning models at 83.51 percent F1-score. All five transformer models achieve comparable performance with macro F1-scores between 86.57 percent and 88.54 percent. An average ensemble of all five transformer models achieves the best overall performance with 90.14 percent accuracy and 89.00 percent F1-score, outperforming individual models.
results.id: Model *deep learning* secara konsisten mengungguli model *shallow learning* sebesar 3 hingga 5 persen pada *F1-score*, dengan *IndoBERT-p1* mencapai skor *deep learning* individu tertinggi dan *SVM* memimpin model *shallow learning* pada *F1-score* 83,51 persen. Kelima model *transformer* mencapai performa yang sebanding dengan *macro F1-score* antara 86.57 persen dan 88.54 persen. Sebuah *ensemble* rata-rata dari kelima model *transformer* mencapai performa keseluruhan terbaik dengan akurasi 90,14 persen dan *F1-score* 89.00 persen, mengungguli model-model individual.

tldr.en: This study compares shallow learning and transformer models for Indonesian clickbait headline classification. The results show that an average ensemble of five transformer models achieves the best performance, outperforming any individual model.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini membandingkan *shallow learning* dan model *transformer* untuk klasifikasi *headline clickbait* bahasa Indonesia. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *ensemble* rata-rata dari lima model *transformer* mencapai performa terbaik, mengungguli setiap model individu.

doi:10.5281/zenodo.21671493.abstract: This action research study examined the impact of Project SMART on learners' reading proficiency at San Guillermo Elementary School during the 2024–2025 school year. This research utilizes a descriptive-quantitative approach. Moreover, the study focused on the 107 learners from Grades 1–6 who were assessed through pre- and post-test reading tests in English and Filipino. The SMART project intervention focuses more on data-driven assessment, meaning teachers use data to guide their instruction and help students become proficient readers. Additionally, they employ strategic interventions to help learners fully develop their decoding and reading proficiency. This phase enabled teachers and learners to tailor reading to individual learners' needs. Pre-test results revealed that a large proportion of pupils are slow, struggling, and non-readers, while 23.26% are fast readers in English and 28.04% in Filipino. Following the implementation of the guided oral reading approach, reading drills were conducted. Post-test data revealed a notable increase in fast readers, 36.64% in English and 37.38% in Filipino. There is also a significant decrease in non-reader learners in both subjects; however, there is still one. In line with the Department of Education’s thrust toward foundational literacy, the study concluded that Project SMART serves as an impactful, sustainable framework for developing progressive and independent readers. It is recommended to monitor progress further, modify instruction, and strengthen community partnerships to sustain reading growth and institutionalize the gains of the SMART achievement project.

doi:10.5281/zenodo.21786413.abstract: This community service program aims to equip Indonesian Migrant Workers (PMI) in Hong Kong with digital literacy as a preventive measure against the rising prevalence of online scams. The primary issue faced by PMI is a high vulnerability to social engineering techniques, phishing, fraudulent investments, and the threat of Human Trafficking (TPPO) due to low awareness of digital security. The program was conducted online via the Zoom platform on February 15, 2026, involving 44 PMI participants from the Bintang Nusantara Hong Kong community. Training materials included the definition of digital literacy, identification of various scam modes (such as phishing, illegal online loans, and fake job advertisements), recognition of linguistic markers used in scams, and practical verification steps through official government channels. Evaluation was carried out using pre-tests and post-tests to measure the improvement in participants' understanding. The results indicated a significant increase in the participants' ability to recognize cyber threats and their awareness of personal data protection. This initiative proved effective in building PMI's digital resilience and is recommended to be implemented periodically to protect their income and personal safety from evolving cybercrimes.

doi:10.5281/zenodo.22266723.abstract: Delonix decaryi (R.Vig.) Capuron, locally designated as "Fengoky," is an iconic pachycaul tree endemic to the sub-arid spiny thickets of southwestern Madagascar. Threatened by severe habitat fragmentation, localized charcoal exploitation, and accelerating climate shifts, understanding its environmental boundaries is critical for regional conservation. This study employs Maximum Entropy (MaxEnt) predictive modelling to delineate the ecological niche of Delonix decaryi and identify the primary macroclimatic drivers governing its distribution. Using 94 spatially filtered occurrence records, 19 bioclimatic variables, and a persistent vegetation fraction layer, we generated a highly robust predictive model (Training AUC = 0.9839). Our analysis reveals that seasonal precipitation patterns exert overriding control over the species’ spatial limits. The precipitation of the wettest month (bio13) emerged as the single most critical predictor, accounting for 68.9% of total model contribution and displaying a dominant permutation importance of 96.7%. Annual precipitation (bio12) contributed an additional 17.1%. Marginal response curves show that Delonix decaryi occupies a highly specialized, narrow hydrologic window, with habitat suitability peaking sharply where wettest-month rainfall remains below 150 mm and annual precipitation ranges strictly between 330 mm and 600 mm. Temperature seasonality (bio4) represented the most significant source of unique, non-redundant environmental information. These findings establish a clear quantitative baseline to guide habitat restoration, define spatial boundaries for protected area expansion, and inform ex-situ germplasm collection in the face of shifting arid dynamics in southern Madagascar.

doi:10.53299/jppi.v6i3.4645.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengimplementasian media poster edukatif berbasis Canva dalam meningkatkan literasi visual pada pembelajaran bahasa Indonesia materi teks informatif visual di sekolah dasar. Studi ini menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif yang dilaksanakan di MI Muhammadiyah Baruamba dengan subjek penelitian sejumlah 14 siswa. Data penelitian diperoleh melalui observasi dan dokumentasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pengimplementasian media Canva berjalan dengan baik dan mampu menciptakan pembelajaran yang interaktif. Literasi visual siswa mengalami kenaikan yang ditunjukkan melalui kemampuan mengidentifikasi unsur poster, menghubungkan gambar dengan pesan, dan menyusun informasi secara sistematis. Respon siswa pada penggunaan media ini tergolong positif, dengan mayoritas siswa merasa tertarik dan lebih mudah memahami materi. Faktor pendukung selama proses pembelajaran meliputi ketersediaan perangkat dan peran guru, sedangkan hambatan yang muncul meliputi keterbatasan akses internet dan kemampuan teknologi siswa yang belum merata. Dengan demikian, media poster edukatif berbasis Canva efektif dalam mendukung pembelajaran teks informatif visual di sekolah dasar.
doi:10.53299/jppi.v6i3.4645.title: Implementasi Poster Edukatif Berbasis Canva untuk Meningkatkan Literasi Visual dalam Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia Teks Informatif Visual di Sekolah Dasar

doi:10.54373/ijset.v6i4.7270.abstract: Indonesian language learning in lower elementary school grades faces various changes in the era of globalization, particularly due to technological developments, changes in student characteristics, and demands for literacy strengthening. This study aims to describe the dynamics of Indonesian language learning in lower elementary school grades in the era of globalization, including planning, implementation, technology utilization, obstacles, and teacher strategies. This study uses a descriptive qualitative approach with purposive selection of informants consisting of lower elementary school teachers as primary informants and principals and students as supporting informants. Data were collected through observation, in-depth interviews, and documentation, then analyzed using an interactive model through data condensation, data presentation, and drawing conclusions. The results show that Indonesian language learning has integrated active methods and digital media to create more interactive and student-centered learning. However, its implementation still faces obstacles such as limited technological facilities, teachers' digital competencies, differences in students' literacy abilities, and lack of parental guidance. Strategies implemented by teachers include literacy strengthening, the use of innovative media, individual guidance, and collaboration with parents. This study concludes that innovation in Indonesian language learning in the era of globalization needs to be supported by improved teacher competency, adequate facilities, and synergy between schools and families.

doi:10.54373/ijset.v6i4.7283.abstract: Indonesian language instruction regarding pantun (traditional Malay poetic forms) for fifth-grade students at SDN 2 Tiudan, Tulungagung Regency, currently lacks engaging and innovative learning media. This situation results in low student motivation and difficulties in comprehending the material. Therefore, there is a need for digital learning media that are both engaging and easy to understand. This study aims to develop a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic learning medium for the pantun topic for fifth-grade elementary students and to determine its validity and practicality. The study employs the Research and Development (R&D) method using the ADDIE model, which encompasses the stages of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation. Data were collected through observation, interviews, documentation, and validation questionnaires completed by media, subject matter, and language experts, as well as response questionnaires from teachers and students. The results indicate that the E-Infographic achieved validity scores of 94% from media experts, 93% from subject matter experts, and 96% from language experts, placing it in the "highly valid" category. Practicality tests yielded scores of 92% from students and 90% from teachers, placing it in the "highly practical" category. Thus, the Canva-assisted E-Infographic is deemed highly valid and highly practical for use as a learning medium for Indonesian language instruction on the subject of pantun

glossary.explanation_id: Model *ADDIE* adalah kerangka kerja perancangan instruksional yang terdiri dari lima tahap utama: *Analysis*, *Design*, *Development*, *Implementation*, dan *Evaluation*.
*Canva* adalah platform desain grafis berbasis web yang digunakan untuk merancang berbagai materi visual dan media pembelajaran digital.
*E-Infografis* adalah representasi informasi visual digital yang menyajikan data dan materi secara ringkas, terstruktur, dan menarik.
*Research and Development* adalah metode penelitian yang digunakan untuk menghasilkan produk tertentu dan menguji keefektifannya.
Sampiran adalah dua baris pertama pada pantun yang biasanya berupa sampiran alam atau suasana dan tidak memiliki hubungan makna langsung dengan isi.
Pantun adalah bentuk karya sastra puisi tradisional Melayu yang terdiri dari empat baris per bait dengan rima a-b-a-b serta memiliki sampiran dan isi.

background.en: Indonesian language instruction regarding pantun, which are traditional Malay poetic forms, for fifth-grade students at SDN 2 Tiudan in Tulungagung Regency currently lacks engaging and innovative learning media. This limitation leads to low student motivation and comprehension difficulties regarding the subject matter, necessitating the creation of digital learning tools that are both interesting and easy to understand.
background.id: Pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia mengenai pantun untuk peserta didik kelas V di SDN 2 Tiudan, Kabupaten Tulungagung, saat ini masih kekurangan media pembelajaran yang menarik dan inovatif. Keterbatasan ini memicu rendahnya motivasi belajar peserta didik serta kesulitan dalam memahami materi, sehingga diperlukan pembuatan sarana pembelajaran digital yang menarik dan mudah dipahami.

contributions.en: The paper contributes a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic product for fifth-grade Indonesian language instruction that seamlessly combines visual material presentation with educational games and interactive quizzes focused on pantun. It targets the specific gap of lacking integrated visual and interactive digital tools for traditional poetry learning in elementary education.
contributions.id: Makalah ini menyumbangkan produk E-Infografis digital berbantuan Canva untuk pembelajaran Bahasa Indonesia kelas V yang memadukan penyajian materi visual dengan permainan edukatif serta kuis interaktif yang berfokus pada pantun. Penelitian ini menargetkan celah spesifik berupa kurangnya perangkat digital visual dan interaktif yang terintegrasi untuk pembelajaran puisi tradisional di pendidikan dasar.

future_work.en: The authors state that the study does not test the effectiveness of the media on student learning outcomes, limiting the scope to development, validity, and practicality. Future researchers are recommended to develop similar digital learning media for other subjects with broader testing scopes and conduct deeper evaluations regarding their effectiveness on student learning outcomes.
future_work.id: Penulis menyatakan bahwa penelitian ini tidak menguji efektivitas media terhadap hasil belajar peserta didik, sehingga cakupannya terbatas pada pengembangan, kevalidan, dan kepraktisan. Peneliti selanjutnya disarankan untuk mengembangkan media pembelajaran digital serupa pada mata pelajaran lain dengan cakupan uji coba yang lebih luas serta melakukan evaluasi yang lebih mendalam mengenai efektivitasnya terhadap hasil belajar peserta didik.

method.en: The study employs the Research and Development method using the ADDIE model, which consists of Analysis, Design, Development, Implementation, and Evaluation stages. Data were gathered through observation, interviews, documentation, expert validation questionnaires involving media, subject matter, and language specialists, as well as response questionnaires administered to teachers and students.
method.id: Penelitian ini menerapkan metode *Research and Development* menggunakan model *ADDIE* yang terdiri dari tahapan *Analysis*, *Design*, *Development*, *Implementation*, dan *Evaluation*. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi, wawancara, dokumentasi, angket validasi ahli yang melibatkan spesialis media, materi, dan bahasa, serta angket respons yang diberikan kepada guru dan peserta didik.

related_work.en: Prior studies have developed digital media and infographics to support education, but they often exhibit limitations in integrating pantun content with concise visual presentations and educational games within a single platform. Earlier research tended to develop visual media and learning games separately, failing to combine both specifically for pantun instruction in elementary schools.
related_work.id: Penelitian terdahulu telah mengembangkan media digital dan infografis untuk mendukung pendidikan, namun seringkali menunjukkan keterbatasan dalam mengintegrasikan materi pantun dengan penyajian visual yang ringkas serta permainan edukatif dalam satu platform. Riset sebelumnya cenderung mengembangkan media visual dan permainan pembelajaran secara terpisah, sehingga gagal menggabungkan keduanya secara khusus untuk pembelajaran pantun di sekolah dasar.

results.en: Expert validation tests showed that the E-Infographic achieved validity scores of 94% from media experts, 93% from subject matter experts, and 96% from language experts, categorizing it as highly valid. Furthermore, practicality tests yielded scores of 92% from students and 90% from teachers, placing the medium in the highly practical category.
results.id: Uji validasi ahli menunjukkan bahwa E-Infografis memperoleh skor validitas sebesar 94% dari ahli media, 93% dari ahli materi, dan 96% dari ahli bahasa, sehingga dikategorikan sangat valid. Selanjutnya, uji kepraktisan menghasilkan skor 92% dari peserta didik dan 90% dari guru, menempatkan media tersebut ke dalam kategori sangat praktis.

tldr.en: This study develops a Canva-assisted digital E-Infographic learning medium for teaching pantun to fifth-grade elementary students using the ADDIE model. The results show that the developed medium achieves high validity and practicality ratings from experts, teachers, and students.
tldr.id: Penelitian ini mengembangkan media pembelajaran digital E-Infografis berbantuan Canva untuk materi pantun bagi peserta didik kelas V sekolah dasar menggunakan model *ADDIE*. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa media yang dikembangkan mencapai tingkat validitas dan kepraktisan yang sangat tinggi dari para ahli, guru, dan peserta didik.

doi:10.54392/ijll2633.abstract: Artificial intelligence has grown quickly in language teaching, particularly since the introduction of generative AI and large language models. Even so, the existing evidence is dispersed across various technologies, teaching applications, learner groups, and research approaches. This systematic integrative review examined 40 primary empirical or technical studies. It also used 15 systematic reviews, meta-analyses, and bibliometric syntheses to provide contextual evidence. The selected publications were published between 2017 and July 2026, while the majority of the primary evidence appeared after 2022. The review employed descriptive mapping, thematic synthesis, design-sensitive methodological assessment, and framework development. The primary papers were evaluated based on AI technology, educational application, language skill, learner group, research design, outcome type, multilingual representation, methodological quality, and ethical or governance concerns. Writing assistance, automated feedback, speaking practice, learner perceptions, teacher support, and AI-assisted pedagogy were the most extensively researched topics. In contrast, reading, listening, younger learners, low-resource languages, delayed learning outcomes, and validation across contexts received less attention. The evidence points to potential short-term improvements for writing revision, speaking practice, motivation, engagement, and teacher support. However, confidence in these findings is limited because many studies used small sample sizes, brief interventions, single-institution settings, self-reported measures, incomplete model and prompt reporting, and minimal external validation. Generative systems increased interactivity, adaptability, and task coverage but also introduced output variability, hallucination, authorship ambiguity, privacy risk, and reproducibility problems. Based on the integrated findings, the review proposes a responsible-adoption framework connecting AI-system characteristics, pedagogical design, human–AI interaction, contextual conditions, educational outcomes, and institutional governance. The findings indicate that educational value depends less on technological novelty than on task alignment, teacher mediation, learner agency, methodological rigour, multilingual inclusion, and accountable human oversight.
