glossary.explanation_id: Arsitektur *deep learning* berbasis mekanisme *self-attention* yang mendominasi pemrosesan *model bahasa* modern.
Pendekatan pembelajaran mesin yang memproses dan menggabungkan beberapa jenis data sekaligus, seperti teks dan gambar.
Penggunaan *model bahasa* untuk menyelesaikan suatu tugas tanpa memerlukan pelatihan atau *fine-tuning* terlebih dahulu pada data spesifik tugas tersebut.
Jenis arsitektur jaringan saraf tiruan yang dirancang khusus untuk memproses data terstruktur berbentuk graf, seperti jaringan penyebaran informasi.
Metrik *evaluasi* yang mengukur area di bawah kurva ROC untuk menilai kemampuan klasifikasi model pada berbagai ambang batas.
Rata-rata tak terbobot dari skor F1 di semua kelas yang sangat berguna untuk mengevaluasi *dataset* yang tidak seimbang.
Proses pelatihan lanjutan pada *model bahasa* pratatih menggunakan *data beranotasi* khusus untuk tugas tertentu.
Kondisi di mana suatu bahasa atau domain kekurangan sumber daya komputasi, *data beranotasi*, dan perangkat pendukung NLP.

background.en: Fake news undermines information integrity and social trust, a problem intensified by the proliferation of large language models that facilitate both the generation and detection of deceptive content. Prior surveys often catalog methods without verifying synthesized performance figures, restricting comparisons to identical benchmark settings, or assessing risks of bias, leading to over-read reported accuracies.
background.id: Berita palsu merusak integritas informasi dan kepercayaan sosial, sebuah masalah yang semakin parah dengan maraknya *large language model* yang memfasilitasi pembuatan serta deteksi konten penipuan. Survei sebelumnya sering kali mengkatalogkan metode tanpa memverifikasi angka performa yang disintesis, membatasi perbandingan pada pengaturan *benchmark* yang sama, atau menilai risiko bias, yang berujung pada interpretasi akurasi yang terlalu berlebihan.

contributions.en: The study contributes an enumerated and source-verified evidence base of 45 studies, a conservative comparison protocol avoiding metric pooling, and a qualitative risk-of-bias appraisal. Conceptually, it introduces a multi-axis analytical framework, a method-family trade-off map, a five-stage account of the field's evolution, a dependency-ordered research agenda, and transferable design principles for low-resource languages derived from a Vietnamese case study.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi berupa basis bukti sejumlah 45 studi yang dianotasi dan diverifikasi sumbernya, protokol perbandingan konservatif yang menghindari penggabungan metrik, serta penilaian kualitatif risiko bias. Secara konseptual, studi ini memperkenalkan kerangka analitis multi-sumbu, peta *trade-off* keluarga metode, penjelasan lima tahap evolusi bidang, agenda penelitian berurutan berdasarkan ketergantungan, serta prinsip desain yang dapat ditransfer untuk bahasa *low-resource* yang diturunkan dari studi kasus bahasa Vietnam.

future_work.en: The paper outlines several limitations, including an enumerated rather than exhaustive corpus, underrepresentation of non-English and non-Vietnamese literature, exclusion of unverifiable papers, and reliance on preprints alongside peer-reviewed work. Future research directions prioritize rigorous evaluation protocols for generalization, multilingual and low-resource datasets, evidence-integrating early-detection models, adversarial robustness, and verifiable explanations.
future_work.id: Makalah ini menguraikan beberapa keterbatasan, termasuk korpus yang bersifat enumeratif alih-alih ekstensif, kurangnya representasi literatur non-Inggris dan non-Vietnam, pengecualian makalah yang tidak dapat diverifikasi, serta penggunaan *preprint* di samping karya yang telah melalui penelaahan sejawat. Arah penelitian masa depan memprioritaskan protokol *evaluasi* yang ketat untuk generalisasi, *dataset* multibahasa dan *low-resource*, model deteksi dini yang mengintegrasikan bukti, kekebalan terhadap serangan *adversarial*, serta penjelasan yang dapat diverifikasi.

method.en: The authors conducted a two-pronged search strategy combining database keyword searches and citation snowballing for literature published between 2018 and 2025. They screened candidates using strict inclusion criteria, performing a full-text verifiability check to ensure headline metrics could be traced to accessible primary sources. Studies were classified into five method families—Transformer/PLM, multimodal, LLM-based, graph/propagation, and traditional machine learning—and evaluated across four analytical dimensions: evidence source, detection time, data dependence, and deployment objective.
method.id: Para penulis menerapkan strategi pencarian dua jalur yang menggabungkan pencarian kata kunci pada basis data dan *citation snowballing* untuk literatur yang diterbitkan antara tahun 2018 dan 2025. Mereka menyaring kandidat menggunakan kriteria inklusi yang ketat, melakukan pemeriksaan verifikasi teks lengkap untuk memastikan metrik utama dapat dilacak ke sumber primer yang dapat diakses. Studi diklasifikasikan ke dalam lima keluarga metode—*Transformer/PLM*, *multimodal*, *LLM-based*, *graph/propagation*, dan *traditional machine learning*—serta dievaluasi melalui empat dimensi analitis: sumber bukti, waktu deteksi, ketergantungan data, dan tujuan penerapan.

related_work.en: Previous surveys have mapped various sub-areas of fake news detection, focusing on content-based methods, graph and social context, multimodality, explainability, and recently large language models and artificial intelligence-generated misinformation. However, none of these prior works jointly provide source-verified metrics, confine quantitative comparisons strictly to within-benchmark settings, or report a comprehensive risk-of-bias appraisal of their synthesized results.
related_work.id: Survei-survei sebelumnya telah memetakan berbagai sub-area deteksi berita palsu, dengan fokus pada metode berbasis konten, konteks sosial dan graf, *multimodal*, *explainability*, serta baru-baru ini *large language model* dan misinformasi yang dihasilkan oleh *kecerdasan buatan*. Kendati demikian, tidak ada satupun karya terdahulu yang secara bersamaan menyediakan metrik yang terverifikasi sumbernya, membatasi perbandingan kuantitatif secara ketat pada pengaturan *within-benchmark*, atau melaporkan penilaian risiko bias yang komprehensif terhadap hasil yang disintesis.

results.en: Reported accuracies are heavily heterogeneous across methods, with Transformer/PLM models spanning 74.8 to 99.36 percent, multimodal models ranging from 82.4 to 99.97 percent, graph methods achieving 84.4 to 94.36 percent accuracy or 0.75 to 0.93 AUC, and LLM-based methods ranging from 48.6 to 89.0 percent. The authors interpret these findings to show that performance is shaped significantly by data and evaluation design rather than architecture alone, noting issues like dataset-specific separability and data leakage.
results.id: Akurasi yang dilaporkan sangat heterogen di antara berbagai metode, di mana model *Transformer/PLM* mencakup kisaran 74.8 hingga 99.36 persen, model *multimodal* berkisar antara 82.4 hingga 99.97 persen, metode *graph* mencapai akurasi 84.4 hingga 94.36 persen atau AUC 0.75 hingga 0.93, dan metode berbasis *LLM* berkisar antara 48.6 hingga 89.0 persen. Para penulis menginterpretasikan temuan ini untuk menunjukkan bahwa performa dibentuk secara signifikan oleh data dan desain *evaluasi* alih-alih arsitektur semata, dengan mencatat masalah seperti separabilitas spesifik-*dataset* dan kebocoran data.

tldr.en: This paper presents a verifiability-focused review of 45 content- and context-based fake news detection studies from 2018 to 2025. The authors find that reported performance is heavily influenced by data and evaluation design rather than model architecture alone.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan tinjauan yang berfokus pada verifikasi terhadap 45 studi deteksi berita palsu berbasis konten dan konteks dari tahun 2018 hingga 2025. Para penulis menemukan bahwa performa yang dilaporkan sangat dipengaruhi oleh data dan desain *evaluasi* daripada arsitektur model semata.

doi:10.62411/jcta.17476.title: Beyond Reported Accuracy: A Verifiability-Focused, Multi-Axis Review of Content and Context Based Fake News Detection
doi:10.62411/jcta.17476.venue: Journal of Computing Theories and Applications

doi:10.62527/joiv.10.4.4603.abstract: This study investigates complex word identification (CWI) in Indonesian as a first step towards text simplification for dyslexic readers. This study uses CWI as a token-level classifier with IndoBERT, employing WordPiece tokenization and subword-to-word label alignment (only the first subword of each word receives a gold label; the rest are protected from label loss). To support a wide range of application needs, this study calibrates the decision threshold (τ) on development data and reports the results at multiple operating points to reveal the precision-recall trade-off. The model is fine-tuned on a token-level Indonesian corpus and evaluated on a held-out test set of 11.574 tokens (NonCWI = 10.769; CWI = 805). On this test set, IndoBERT-CWI delivers stable performance at three representative thresholds: τ = 0.40 (Precision 0.736, Recall 0.909, F1 0.814, Accuracy 0.971), τ = 0.46 (Precision 0.743, Recall 0.896, F1 0.812, Accuracy 0.971), and τ = 0.60 (Precision 0.771, Recall 0.856, F1 0.811, Accuracy 0.972). The precision-recall (PR) curve on the test set has an Average Precision of 0.783 and shows τ = 0.46 as a balanced operating point (highest F1), while τ = 0.40 is preferred when maximizing coverage (recall) is crucial to avoid missing complex tokens. A brief analysis shows that model errors occur most frequently when frequently occurring function words and proper nouns are marked as complex. This pattern is consistent with the characteristics of a news-based corpus and provides a practical suggestion that the simplification module should filter out entity names and function words from processing. Our results demonstrate that a well-tuned IndoBERT is effective for Indonesian CWI, with easily calibrated thresholds to balance precision–recall in dyslexia applications, and provide directions for improvement in further lexical simplification.

glossary.explanation_id: Tugas komputasi untuk mendeteksi kata-kata yang sulit atau kompleks dalam sebuah teks.
Proses memecah teks menjadi unit-unit kecil yang disebut *token*.
Proses melatih ulang *large language model* yang sudah dilatih sebelumnya pada tugas spesifik.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur proporsi prediksi positif yang benar.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur kemampuan model dalam menemukan semua instans positif yang ada.

background.en: This study investigates complex word identification in Indonesian as a preliminary step towards text simplification for dyslexic readers. Identifying complex words is crucial for adapting text to aid readability and comprehension for readers with reading difficulties.
background.id: Studi ini menyelidiki *complex word identification* dalam bahasa Indonesia sebagai langkah awal menuju penyederhanaan teks bagi pembaca disleksia. Mengidentifikasi kata kompleks sangat penting untuk mengadaptasi teks guna membantu keterbacaan dan pemahaman bagi pembaca dengan kesulitan membaca.

contributions.en: The study contributes a token-level classifier based on IndoBERT for Indonesian complex word identification, employing subword-to-word label alignment and dyslexia-oriented threshold calibration. It provides empirical evaluations at multiple operating points to reveal the precision-recall trade-off.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi berupa *token-level classifier* berbasis *IndoBERT* untuk *complex word identification* bahasa Indonesia, dengan menerapkan *subword-to-word label alignment* dan kalibrasi *threshold* yang berorientasi pada disleksia. Studi ini menyediakan evaluasi empiris pada berbagai titik operasi untuk mengungkap *trade-off* antara *precision* dan *recall*.

future_work.en: The authors suggest that the simplification module should filter out entity names and function words from processing, and provide directions for improvement in further lexical simplification.
future_work.id: Para penulis menyarankan agar modul penyederhanaan menyaring nama entitas dan *function word* dari pemrosesan, serta memberikan arah untuk peningkatan dalam penyederhanaan leksikal lebih lanjut.

method.en: The methodology employs IndoBERT with WordPiece tokenization and subword-to-word label alignment, where only the first subword of each word receives a gold label while the rest are protected. The model is fine-tuned on a token-level Indonesian corpus and evaluated on a held-out test set. To support application needs, the decision threshold is calibrated on development data across multiple operating points.
method.id: Metodologi ini menggunakan *IndoBERT* dengan *tokenization* *WordPiece* dan *subword-to-word label alignment*, di mana hanya *subword* pertama dari setiap kata yang menerima *gold label* sementara sisanya dilindungi. Model ini di-*fine-tune* pada korpus bahasa Indonesia tingkat *token* dan dievaluasi pada *test set* terpisah. Untuk mendukung kebutuhan aplikasi, *decision threshold* dikalibrasi pada *data* pengembanga di berbagai titik operasi.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas pekerjaan terkait secara mendetail.

results.en: Evaluated on a test set of 11,574 tokens, IndoBERT-CWI delivers stable performance at three representative thresholds: tau equals 0.40 achieves Precision 0.736, Recall 0.909, F1 0.814, and Accuracy 0.971; tau equals 0.46 achieves Precision 0.743, Recall 0.896, F1 0.812, and Accuracy 0.971; and tau equals 0.60 achieves Precision 0.771, Recall 0.856, F1 0.811, and Accuracy 0.972. The precision-recall curve yields an Average Precision of 0.783, identifying tau equals 0.46 as the balanced operating point and tau equals 0.40 for maximizing recall. Error analysis indicates that errors occur when frequent function words and proper nouns are misclassified as complex.
results.id: Dievaluasi pada *test set* sebanyak 11.574 *token*, *IndoBERT-CWI* memberikan performa yang stabil pada tiga *threshold* representatif: tau sama dengan 0,40 mencapai *Precision* 0,736, *Recall* 0,909, *F1* 0,814, dan *Accuracy* 0,971; tau sama dengan 0,46 mencapai *Precision* 0,743, *Recall* 0,896, *F1* 0,812, dan *Accuracy* 0,971; serta tau sama dengan 0,60 mencapai *Precision* 0,771, *Recall* 0,856, *F1* 0,811, dan *Accuracy* 0,972. Kurva *precision-recall* menghasilkan *Average Precision* sebesar 0,783, mengidentifikasi tau sama dengan 0,46 sebagai titik operasi yang seimbang dan tau sama dengan 0,40 untuk memaksimalkan *recall*. Analisis kesalahan menunjukkan bahwa kesalahan terjadi ketika *function word* yang sering muncul dan *proper noun* salah diklasifikasikan sebagai kompleks.

tldr.en: This study investigates complex word identification in Indonesian using IndoBERT with calibration for dyslexia-oriented thresholding. The results demonstrate stable performance across multiple operating points, with threshold adjustments effectively balancing precision and recall for text simplification.
tldr.id: Studi ini menyelidiki *complex word identification* dalam bahasa Indonesia menggunakan *IndoBERT* dengan kalibrasi *thresholding* yang berorientasi pada disleksia. Hasilnya menunjukkan performa yang stabil di berbagai titik operasi, dengan penyesuaian *threshold* yang secara efektif menyeimbangkan *precision* dan *recall* untuk penyederhanaan teks.

doi:10.62527/joiv.10.4.4603.title: IndoBERT-based Complex Word Identification for Indonesian Text Simplification with Dyslexia-Oriented Thresholding

doi:10.62567/ijosse.v2i3.2840.abstract: Penelitian ini dilakukan untuk mengetahui bagaimana penerapan Electronic Government Melalui SRIKANDI di Dinas Kearsipan dan Perpustakaan Provinsi Gorontalo. Menggunakan teori e-government yang terdiri dari tiga indikator menurut Indrajit dalam (Andi et al., 2025), yaitu Support (Dukungan), Capacity (Kapasitas), dan Value (Nilai/Manfaat). Metode yang digunakan adalah kualitatif deskriptif dengan pengumpulan data melalui wawancara mendalam, observasi, dan dokumentasi terhadap tujuh informan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa dari indikator Support, dukungan pimpinan dan regulasi sudah tersedia namun masih terdapat keterbatasan sarana pendukung seperti alat pemindai (scanner), perangkat komputer yang jarang mendapat pembaruan dan kualitas jaringan internet yang belum stabil. Dari indikator Capacity, sebagian besar pegawai telah mampu mengoperasikan aplikasi namun masih terdapat kesenjangan kemampuan antarpegawai serta keterbatasan infrastruktur teknologi. Dari indikator Value, aplikasi SRIKANDI telah memberikan manfaat nyata berupa efisiensi waktu, penghematan biaya operasional, pengurangan penggunaan kertas, serta pengelolaan arsip yang lebih tertib dan terintegrasi. Kesimpulannya, penerapan SRIKANDI telah berjalan cukup baik namun belum sepenuhnya optimal dan memerlukan penguatan terpadu pada ketiga indikator secara berkesinambungan.

doi:10.62710/41qkwq70.abstract: This community service project was initiated to address the low descriptive writing skills among elementary school students, particularly those at risk of learning difficulties, which hinder their literacy development. The purpose of this activity was to implement an effective intervention using guided writing combined with contextual teaching and learning (CTL) approaches to enhance students' ability to plan, write, and revise descriptive texts rooted in real-life experiences. The methodology involved a classroom action research model carried out in cycles, encompassing planning, implementation, observation, and reflection stages. The intervention included modeling contextual texts, interactive discussions, structuring outlines, guided drafting, revisions, presentation, and collaborative evaluation. Data collection consisted of qualitative observations and quantitative assessments of students' writing outcomes, specifically measuring the percentage of students reaching the minimum mastery criteria (KKM ≥75). The results showed a significant increase in students' writing competence, with the percentage of students achieving mastery rising from 35% pre-intervention to 85% post-intervention, surpassing the targeted 80%. Additionally, improvements in students’ ideas development, text organization, vocabulary richness, and confidence were observed. These findings demonstrate that guided writing integrated with contextual teaching effectively facilitates literacy improvements among at-risk elementary learners, fostering engagement, confidence, and better writing skills.
doi:10.62710/41qkwq70.title: Peningkatan Kemampuan Menulis Teks Deskriptif melalui Penerapan Metode Guided Writing Berbasis Kontekstual pada Mata Pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia bagi Siswa Berisiko Kesulitan Belajar Kelas V SDN 001 Malinau Utara

doi:10.62710/8ks0ey11.abstract: Low reading comprehension in inclusive schools often stems from excessive cognitive load caused by dense, conventional narrative texts. This classroom action research aims to enhance Indonesian language learning and reading comprehension for fifth-grade students with reading difficulties using a Deep Learning approach. Following the Kemmis and McTaggart model across two cycles (four sessions), the study involved 20 fifth-grade students at SD Negeri 1 Malinau Utara, focusing on two students with reading disabilities. Data collected via end-of-cycle essay tests, observations, and documentation were analyzed using comparative descriptive analysis. Results showed that Cycle I, relying solely on text-based materials, yielded sub-optimal results, with classical mastery at 55%. In Cycle II, environmental modifications—seating target students in the front row—and visual scaffolding via event-flow flowcharts and sequential picture cards were introduced. Consequently, target students achieved a score of 70 (meeting minimum mastery), while classical mastery rose to 90%. Combining a Deep Learning approach with flowchart visual media effectively and equitably improves reading comprehension and outcomes in inclusive classrooms.

glossary.explanation_id: Pendekatan pembelajaran mendalam yang mendorong pemahaman konseptual secara bermakna dan berpikir kritis daripada sekadar hafalan pasif.
Penelitian tindakan kelas yang dilakukan oleh guru untuk memperbaiki proses dan hasil pembelajaran di dalam kelas.
Dukungan atau bantuan belajar yang diberikan secara terstruktur oleh guru untuk membantu siswa menguasai tugas yang lebih kompleks.
Bagan alur visual yang digunakan untuk menguraikan kronologi atau hubungan sebab-akibat dalam sebuah cerita.
Beban kognitif atau jumlah kapasitas memori kerja yang digunakan saat memproses informasi pembelajaran.
Memori kerja yang berfungsi untuk menyimpan dan memproses informasi secara sementara selama aktivitas kognitif.

background.en: Low reading comprehension in inclusive schools often stems from excessive cognitive load caused by dense and conventional narrative texts. This issue is particularly pronounced for students with disabilities who experience specific reading difficulties, leading to academic and social setbacks in uniform learning environments.
background.id: Rendahnya pemahaman membaca di sekolah inklusif sering kali bersumber dari beban kognitif berlebih yang diakibatkan oleh teks naratif yang padat dan konvensional. Masalah ini sangat nyata bagi siswa penyandang disabilitas yang mengalami hambatan membaca spesifik, yang berujung pada ketertinggalan akademik dan sosial dalam lingkungan pembelajaran yang seragam.

contributions.en: The study introduces a novel combination of a Deep Learning approach featuring structured visual scaffolding, such as event-flow flowcharts and sequential picture cards, alongside seating adjustments. This equitable intervention addresses cognitive load for students with special needs without lowering standards for regular peers.
contributions.id: Studi ini memperkenalkan kombinasi baru berupa pendekatan *Deep Learning* yang dilengkapi *visual scaffolding* terstruktur, seperti *flowchart* alur peristiwa dan kartu gambar berurutan, beserta penyesuaian tempat duduk. Intervensi yang berkeadilan ini mengatasi beban kognitif bagi siswa berkebutuhan khusus tanpa menurunkan standar bagi siswa reguler lainnya.

future_work.en: The authors recommend that future research broaden the scope by involving more diverse participants, exploring digital technology-based media as visual scaffolds, and measuring students' long-term retention of reading comprehension abilities.
future_work.id: Para penulis merekomendasikan agar penelitian selanjutnya memperluas cakupan dengan melibatkan partisipan yang lebih beragam, mengeksplorasi media berbasis teknologi digital sebagai perancah visual, serta mengukur retensi jangka panjang siswa terhadap kemampuan pemahaman membaca.

method.en: The research employs a Classroom Action Research design following the Kemmis and McTaggart spiral model across two cycles, involving 20 fifth-grade students with a specific focus on two target students with reading disabilities at SD Negeri 1 Malinau Utara. Data were gathered through end-of-cycle essay tests, classroom observations, and documentation, and analyzed using comparative descriptive analysis.
method.id: Penelitian ini menggunakan desain *Classroom Action Research* yang mengikuti model spiral Kemmis dan McTaggart dalam dua siklus, melibatkan 20 siswa kelas V dengan fokus khusus pada dua siswa target yang mengalami hambatan membaca di SD Negeri 1 Malinau Utara. Data dikumpulkan melalui tes esai akhir siklus, observasi kelas, dan dokumentasi, kemudian dianalisis menggunakan analisis deskriptif komparatif.

related_work.en: Prior studies have explored visual media, scaffolding strategies, and Deep Learning approaches in regular classes to foster conceptual understanding and problem-solving. However, the authors note that prior research rarely integrates Deep Learning with structured visual scaffolding and physical environment modifications within primary inclusive schools.
related_work.id: Studi-studi terdahulu telah mengeksplorasi media visual, strategi *scaffolding*, dan pendekatan *Deep Learning* di kelas reguler untuk mendorong pemahaman konseptual dan pemecahan masalah. Akan tetapi, para penulis mencatat bahwa penelitian sebelumnya jarang yang mengintegrasikan *Deep Learning* dengan *visual scaffolding* terstruktur serta modifikasi lingkungan fisik di sekolah dasar inklusif.

results.en: Cycle I relied solely on text-based materials, yielding a classical mastery of 55 percent. In Cycle II, environmental modifications and visual scaffolding were introduced, resulting in target students meeting the minimum mastery score of 70 and overall classical mastery increasing to 90 percent.
results.id: Siklus I hanya mengandalkan materi berbasis teks, yang menghasilkan ketuntasan klasikal sebesar 55 persen. Pada Siklus II, modifikasi lingkungan dan *visual scaffolding* diperkenalkan, menghasilkan pencapaian skor minimum 70 bagi siswa target dan peningkatan ketuntasan klasikal secara keseluruhan menjadi 90 persen.

tldr.en: This classroom action research evaluates the use of a Deep Learning approach combined with visual flowchart media to enhance reading comprehension among fifth-grade students with reading difficulties in an inclusive school. The results show that environmental modifications and visual scaffolding successfully improved individual target scores and raised classical mastery to 90 percent.
tldr.id: Penelitian tindakan kelas ini mengevaluasi penggunaan pendekatan *Deep Learning* yang dikombinasikan dengan media visual berupa *flowchart* untuk meningkatkan pemahaman membaca pada siswa kelas V dengan hambatan membaca di sekolah inklusif. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa modifikasi lingkungan dan *visual scaffolding* berhasil meningkatkan skor target individual serta menaikkan ketuntasan klasikal hingga 90 persen.

doi:10.62710/sqmn2d94.abstract: Most classroom assessments of Indonesian-language proficiency still rely on a single outcome measure—whether the selected answer is correct or incorrect while largely overlooking how a learner's attention moves before arriving at that answer. This study aims to identify and compare eye-gaze scanpath patterns between high- and low-performing learners across three Indonesian-language task types: interpreting figurative language (majas), extracting the gist of a short reading passage, and applying spelling and punctuation conventions (Ejaan yang Disempurnakan/EYD). The goal is to reveal how cognitive load manifests differently across these task types. Unlike most prior eye-gaze research that treats cognitive load as a single, undifferentiated construct, this study tests the hypothesis that cognitive load varies systematically with the underlying language skill being exercised: figurative-language tasks emphasize semantic inference, reading comprehension emphasizes main-idea extraction, and orthography tasks emphasize rule-checking. To this end, gaze heatmap data were collected via real-time eye-movement recording through each participant's webcam while they completed the three tasks on an Intelligent Tutoring System (ITS) application. The article concludes by discussing the implications of this task-sensitive approach for designing an adaptive, AI-assisted Intelligent Tutoring System capable of responding to cognitive load in a task-specific manner.
doi:10.62710/sqmn2d94.title: Eye-Gaze sebagai Indikator Beban Kognitif pada Tugas Bahasa Indonesia: Studi Diagnostik dalam Intelligent Tutoring System

doi:10.62710/tmwhg220.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk: (1) mendeskripsikan penerapan model Reciprocal Teaching berbasis kontekstual dalam pembelajaran pemahaman bacaan pada mata pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia bagi siswa berisiko kesulitan belajar di kelas V SDN 001 Malinau Utara, serta (2) meningkatkan keterampilan pemahaman bacaan siswa melalui penerapan model tersebut. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode penelitian tindakan kelas yang dilaksanakan dalam dua siklus, dengan tahapan perencanaan, pelaksanaan tindakan, observasi, dan refleksi. Teknik pengumpulan data meliputi tes pemahaman bacaan, observasi, wawancara, dan dokumentasi. Data kuantitatif dianalisis menggunakan statistik deskriptif, sedangkan data kualitatif dianalisis melalui tahapan reduksi, penyajian, dan penarikan simpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penerapan model Reciprocal Teaching berbasis kontekstual berhasil meningkatkan keterampilan pemahaman bacaan siswa, dengan nilai rata-rata meningkat dari 44,0 pada tahap pratindakan menjadi 72,5 pada Siklus I, dan mencapai skor optimal sebesar 87,5 pada Siklus II, sehingga indikator keberhasilan penelitian tercapai (KKM ≥ 70, dengan 100% siswa tuntas). Selain itu, siswa menunjukkan peningkatan keaktifan belajar, interaktivitas, serta keterlibatan yang bermakna dan sesuai dengan pengalaman kehidupan nyata mereka
doi:10.62710/tmwhg220.title: Peningkatan Kemampuan Membaca Pemahaman Melalui Penerapan Model Reciprocal Teaching Berbasis Kontekstual pada Mata Pelajaran Bahasa Indonesia bagi Siswa Berisiko Kesulitan Belajar Kelas V SDN 001 Malinau Utara

doi:10.62710/xxgj8q62.abstract: Education plays an important role in developing students’ communication skills, enabling them to express ideas and interact effectively in the learning process. This study aims to determine the effect of the cooperative learning model of the Think Pair Share (TPS) type on students' learning outcomes in Indonesian language subject for fourth-grade students at UPT SDN 060914 Medan Sunggal in the 2026/2027 Academic Year. This study employed a quantitative approach with a one-group pretest-posttest research design. The subjects of the study were all fourth-grade students, consisting of 29 students. Data were collected through tests in the form of pretest and posttest, as well as a student response questionnaire regarding the implementation of the Think Pair Share learning model. The data were analyzed using a correlation coefficient test and hypothesis testing through a Paired Samples t-Test with the assistance of Microsoft Excel and SPSS version 22. The results showed that the students' average pretest score was 51.72, while the average posttest score increased to 82.24, indicating an improvement of 30.52 points. Students' responses to the implementation of the TPS model were also positive, with an average questionnaire score of 83.03. The hypothesis test resulted in a t_count of 8.561, while the t_table was 1.701 at a 5% significance level with df = 28. Since t_count > t_table (8.561 > 1.701) and the Sig. (2-tailed) value was 0.000 < 0.05, H₀ was rejected and Hₐ was accepted. Therefore, it can be concluded that there is a significant effect of the Think Pair Share cooperative learning model on the learning outcomes of fourth-grade students at UPT SDN 060914 Medan Sunggal.

doi:10.62783/shss.8.4.57.abstract: 연구 목적: 본 연구는 넷플릭스에서 제공하는 드라마 「응답하라 1988」 1화의 경상도 방언표현과 그에 대응하는 아랍어 자막을 분석하여, 아랍어권 한국어 학습자의 지역어 이해를 돕는 보조 도구로서 ChatGPT의 활용 가능성을 검토하는 데 목적이 있다.연구 방법: 넷플릭스 「응답하라 1988」 1화에 나타난 경상도 방언 표현 중 6개(“우짜노”, “온나”, “~제?”, “돈이 어딨노”, “마이 무라, 우리 딸”, “몰랐제”)를 선정하여, ① 원대사, ② 넷플릭스 아랍어 자막, ③ 세부 프롬프트를 적용한 ChatGPT 응답을 대조·분석하였다.연구 내용: 분석 결과, 넷플릭스 아랍어 자막은 장면 이해에 필요한 기본 의미는 대체로 대체로 전달하였으나, ‘-노’, ‘-제’, ‘온나’, ‘무라’ 등 방언 표지가 지니는 지역적 특성과 의문·확인·친근한 권유 등 발화의 화용적 기능을 명시적으로 반영되지는 않았다. 반면 세부프롬프트를 적용한 ChatGPT의 응답은 표현별 의미, 표준어 대응형, 문법적 특징, 사용 맥락, 아랍어 자막과의 차이, 학습 시 유의점을 함께 제시하는 양상을 보였다.결론 및 제언: 본 연구는 경상도 방언·아랍어 자막·한국어 교육을 연계한 분석 자료가 저자원(low-resource) 지역어 교육 자료로 활용될 수 있는 가능성을 제시하고, 생성형 AI가 자막 번역의 한계를 보완하는 학습자용 설명 도구로 기능할 수 있음을 확인하였다는 점에서 의의를 지닌다. 이를 바탕으로 향후 지역어 교육 자료 개발과 AI 보조 학습 설계에 대한 후속 연구가 요구된다.

doi:10.62810/jns.v9i2.580.abstract: Detecting harmful language in online platforms is essential for creating safer and more inclusive social media environments. However, research on harmful language detection has largely focused on high-resource languages, while low-resource languages such as Pashto remain comparatively underexplored. This study compares hate speech and dehumanizing language in Pashto social media comments. To address this gap, we developed a dataset containing 1,590 Pashto comments collected from social media and manually categorized them into four classes: Hate, Dehumanization, Both, and Neither. Three traditional machine learning algorithms, Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Linear Support Vector Machine (SVM), were evaluated using Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) features. Among the evaluated models, Logistic Regression achieved the best overall performance, reaching an accuracy of 71.63%. The results indicate that distinguishing between hate speech and dehumanizing language remains challenging, particularly when both forms occur within the same comment. The model showed a tendency to confuse the Hate and Dehumanization categories, with the Both class presenting additional classification difficulties. Furthermore, the experiments demonstrate that appropriate text normalization and selecting an effective feature size, approximately 3,500 features in this study, can improve classification performance.
doi:10.62810/jns.v9i2.580.journal_ref: Journal of Natural Sciences – Kabul University

glossary.explanation_id: *Logistic Regression* adalah algoritma *machine learning* yang digunakan untuk tugas klasifikasi biner maupun multikelas.
*Naive Bayes* adalah keluarga pengklasifikasi probabilistik berbasis teorema Bayes dengan asumsi independensi yang kuat antar fitur.
*Linear Support Vector Machine* adalah model *machine learning* linier yang mencari *hyperplane* optimal untuk memisahkan data dari kelas yang berbeda.
*TF-IDF* adalah metode pembobotan statistik yang mengevaluasi seberapa penting suatu kata dalam dokumen relatif terhadap sebuah *korpus*.

background.en: Detecting harmful language in online platforms is essential for creating safer and more inclusive social media environments. However, research on harmful language detection has largely focused on high-resource languages, while low-resource languages such as Pashto remain comparatively underexplored. This study addresses this gap by comparing hate speech and dehumanizing language in Pashto social media comments.
background.id: Deteksi bahasa berbahaya pada platform daring sangat penting untuk menciptakan lingkungan media sosial yang lebih aman dan inklusif. Akan tetapi, penelitian mengenai deteksi bahasa berbahaya sebagian besar berfokus pada *high-resource languages*, sementara *low-resource languages* seperti bahasa Pashto masih kurang dieksplorasi secara komparatif. Studi ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan membandingkan ujaran kebencian dan bahasa dehumanisasi dalam komentar media sosial berbahasa Pashto.

contributions.en: To address the research gap, the authors developed a new dataset containing 1,590 Pashto comments collected from social media and manually categorized them into four classes: Hate, Dehumanization, Both, and Neither. Furthermore, the study evaluates three traditional machine learning algorithms using TF-IDF features and demonstrates the impact of text normalization and feature size selection.

Selain itu, studi ini mengevaluasi tiga algoritma *machine learning* tradisional menggunakan fitur *TF-IDF* serta mendemonstrasikan dampak normalisasi teks dan pemilihan ukuran fitur.

Three traditional machine learning algorithms, namely Logistic Regression, Naive Bayes, and Linear Support Vector Machine, were evaluated. The models utilized Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency features, alongside text normalization and an effective feature size of approximately 3,500 features.

Tiga algoritma *machine learning* tradisional, yaitu *Logistic Regression*, *Naive Bayes*, dan *Linear Support Vector Machine*, dievaluasi. Model-model tersebut memanfaatkan fitur *Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency*, beserta normalisasi teks dan ukuran fitur efektif sekitar 3.500 fitur.

results.en: Among the evaluated models, Logistic Regression achieved the best overall performance with an accuracy of 71.63%. The results indicate that distinguishing between hate speech and dehumanizing language is challenging, especially when both forms occur within the same comment, leading the model to confuse the Hate and Dehumanization categories. Additionally, the experiments demonstrate that appropriate text normalization and selecting approximately 3,500 features can improve classification performance.
results.id: Di antara model yang dievaluasi, *Logistic Regression* mencapai performa keseluruhan terbaik dengan akurasi sebesar 71,63%. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa membedakan antara ujaran kebencian dan bahasa dehumanisasi merupakan hal yang menantang, terutama ketika kedua bentuk tersebut muncul dalam komentar yang sama, yang menyebabkan model kebingungan antara kategori *Hate* dan *Dehumanization*. Selain itu, eksperimen menunjukkan bahwa normalisasi teks yang tepat dan pemilihan sekitar 3.500 fitur dapat meningkatkan performa klasifikasi.

tldr.en: This paper presents a study on detecting hate and dehumanizing speech in Pashto text using traditional machine learning algorithms. The results show that Logistic Regression achieved the best accuracy, while distinguishing between overlapping categories remains challenging.
tldr.id: Makalah ini menyajikan studi mengenai deteksi ujaran kebencian dan dehumanisasi dalam teks bahasa Pashto menggunakan algoritma *machine learning* tradisional. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa *Logistic Regression* mencapai akurasi terbaik, sementara pembedaan antar kategori yang tumpang tindih tetap menjadi tantangan.

doi:10.62985/j.huit_ojs.vol26.no3e.479.abstract: This study examines the key determinants of digital economy development in Southeast Asia and draws policy implications for Vietnam. Based on endogenous growth theory, human capital theory, and institutional theory, the research employs panel data from Southeast Asian countries and applies advanced econometric techniques, including unit root tests, cointegration analysis, and Driscoll-Kraay estimations. The findings indicate that education is the most influential factor driving digital economy growth. Governance quality, however, exhibits a negative association with digital development, suggesting that traditional governance effectiveness may not align with the institutional flexibility required for digital transformation. Additionally, CO₂ emissions are positively associated with digital development, implying that digitalization may currently function as an adaptive response to structural and environmental pressures. These results provide important empirical evidence and practical policy recommendations for Vietnam in promoting sustainable and innovation-driven digital growth.

doi:10.62985/j.huit_ojs.vol26.no3e.487.abstract: This study examines the impact of digital transformation on the environmental dimension of sustainable development in six Southeast Asian countries over the period 2002–2022. Environmental sustainability is proxied by consumption-based CO₂ emissions per capita, with government effectiveness examined as a moderating factor. Using panel data, the study applies the Method of Moments Quantile Regression (MMQR) to capture heterogeneous effects across emission levels, while bootstrap quantile regression (BSQ) is employed as a robustness check. The results show that digital transformation significantly reduces emissions across all quantiles, with stronger mitigation effects observed at higher emission levels, indicating greater environmental benefits in carbon-intensive economies. However, government effectiveness weakens this emission-reducing effect. This implies that the environmental impact of digital transformation depends on institutional quality and highlights the need to align digital strategies with environmental governance to achieve sustainable emission reductions.

doi:10.63158/journalisi.v8i4.1742.abstract: The widespread use of social media, particularly Platform X, has increased the popularity of memes as a multimodal communication medium that combines textual and visual elements to express emotions, opinions, and social reactions. This study proposes a multimodal emotion classification approach for Indonesian-language memes by integrating IndoBERT for textual analysis and YOLOv11 operating in image classification mode for visual analysis through a weighted late fusion strategy. An initial dataset of 2,810 Indonesian-language memes was collected through web scraping. After removing corrupted or unreadable images, 2,547 valid samples remained. Each meme was manually annotated into one of six emotion categories—Happiness, Disgust, Anger, Sadness, Fear, and Surprise—based on the annotators' judgment of the dominant emotion conveyed by the combination of text and image, following Ekman's Basic Emotion framework. The dataset was divided using a stratified 80:10:10 split into 2,037 training, 255 validation, and 255 testing samples. The validation set was used to determine the optimal fusion weight, while the held-out test set was reserved exclusively for final evaluation. The best-performing weighted late fusion model (α = 0.6) achieved 72.55% accuracy, 73.03% macro precision, 72.76% macro recall, and 72.66% macro F1-score on the test set. Within the constructed dataset, the proposed multimodal approach outperformed the evaluated IndoBERT-only and YOLOv11-only baselines, indicating that combining textual and visual information can improve emotion classification performance for Indonesian-language meme content.
doi:10.63158/journalisi.v8i4.1742.journal_ref: Journal of Information Systems and Informatics

glossary.explanation_id: Pendekatan komputasi yang memproses dan mengintegrasikan berbagai jenis data atau modalitas seperti teks dan gambar secara bersamaan.
Strategi penggabungan informasi dari model modalitas yang berbeda pada tahap akhir sebelum keputusan akhir diambil.

Metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rata-rata *precision* dari setiap kelas tanpa memedulikan ukuran kelas.
Metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rata-rata *recall* dari setiap kelas secara independen.
Rata-rata harmonis dari *macro precision* dan *macro recall* di seluruh kelas.
Teknik otomatis untuk mengekstrak data dari halaman web.
Model standar atau sederhana yang digunakan sebagai pembanding untuk mengukur keunggulan metode baru.

background.en: The widespread use of social media, particularly Platform X, has increased the popularity of memes as a multimodal communication medium combining textual and visual elements to express emotions, opinions, and social reactions. However, classifying emotions in such content remains challenging, creating a need for robust approaches that jointly analyze text and image.
background.id: Penggunaan media sosial yang luas, khususnya Platform X, telah meningkatkan popularitas meme sebagai media komunikasi *multimodal* yang menggabungkan elemen teks dan visual untuk mengekspresikan emosi, opini, dan reaksi sosial. Namun, klasifikasi emosi pada konten semacam itu masih menantang, sehingga menimbulkan kebutuhan akan pendekatan yang kuat untuk menganalisis teks dan gambar secara bersamaan.

contributions.en: This study contributes a new dataset of 2,547 annotated Indonesian-language memes classified into six emotion categories following Ekman's Basic Emotion framework. Furthermore, it introduces a multimodal emotion classification approach integrating IndoBERT and YOLOv11 via a weighted late fusion strategy.
contributions.id: Studi ini berkontribusi menyediakan *dataset* baru berisi 2.547 meme bahasa Indonesia beranotasi yang diklasifikasikan ke dalam enam kategori emosi mengikuti kerangka *Ekman's Basic Emotion*. Selain itu, penelitian ini memperkenalkan pendekatan *multimodal emotion classification* yang mengintegrasikan *IndoBERT* dan *YOLOv11* melalui strategi *weighted late fusion*.

future_work.en: The paper does not discuss limitations and future directions explicitly.
future_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas keterbatasan dan arah masa depan secara eksplisit.

method.en: An initial dataset of 2,810 Indonesian memes was collected via web scraping, resulting in 2,547 valid samples after removing corrupted images. Each meme was manually annotated into one of six emotion categories based on dominant emotion. The data was split using a stratified 80:10:10 ratio into training, validation, and testing sets. IndoBERT and YOLOv11 operating in image classification mode were combined using a weighted late fusion strategy, where the validation set determined the optimal fusion weight.
method.id: Sebuah *dataset* awal berisi 2.810 meme bahasa Indonesia dikumpulkan melalui *web scraping*, menghasilkan 2.547 sampel valid setelah menghapus gambar yang rusak. Setiap meme dianotasi secara manual ke dalam salah satu dari enam kategori emosi berdasarkan emosi dominan. Data dibagi menggunakan rasio *stratified* 80:10:10 menjadi *training*, *validation*, dan *testing set*. *IndoBERT* dan *YOLOv11* yang beroperasi dalam mode *image classification* digabungkan menggunakan strategi *weighted late fusion*, di mana *validation set* digunakan untuk menentukan bobot *fusion* yang optimal.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail beyond evaluating text-only and image-only baselines.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas *related work* secara mendetail di luar evaluasi *baseline* berbasis teks saja dan gambar saja.

results.en: The best-performing weighted late fusion model with alpha equal to 0.6 achieved 72.55 percent accuracy, 73.03 percent macro precision, 72.76 percent macro recall, and 72.66 percent macro F1-score on the test set. The proposed multimodal approach outperformed the evaluated IndoBERT-only and YOLOv11-only baselines, showing that combining textual and visual information improves performance.
results.id: Model *weighted late fusion* dengan performa terbaik pada alfa sama dengan 0,6 mencapai akurasi 72,55 persen, *macro precision* 73,03 persen, *macro recall* 72,76 persen, dan *macro F1-score* 72,66 persen pada *test set*. Pendekatan *multimodal* yang diusulkan mengungguli *baseline* *IndoBERT-only* dan *YOLOv11-only*, yang menunjukkan bahwa penggabungan informasi teks dan visual meningkatkan performa.

tldr.en: This paper proposes a multimodal emotion classification approach for Indonesian memes using IndoBERT and YOLOv11 with a weighted late fusion strategy. The proposed model achieves 72.55 percent accuracy on the test set, outperforming unimodal baselines.
tldr.id: Makalah ini mengusulkan pendekatan *multimodal emotion classification* untuk meme bahasa Indonesia menggunakan *IndoBERT* dan *YOLOv11* dengan strategi *weighted late fusion*. Model yang diusulkan mencapai akurasi 72,55 persen pada *test set*, mengungguli *baseline* unimodal.

doi:10.63158/journalisi.v8i4.1816.abstract: This study evaluates a pipeline that separates rule-based aspect extraction from IndoBERT-based binary sentiment classification for Indonesian Ruparupa mobile application reviews. Google Play reviews were collected on 31 July 2026, anonymized, deduplicated before aspect expansion, and cleaned by lowercasing, removing URLs, emails, and special characters, and normalizing whitespace; no slang normalization, stop-word removal, or stemming was applied. Ratings 1-2 and 4-5 provided weak negative and positive labels, while three-star reviews were excluded. A 331-entry aspect dictionary mapped 1,495 unique reviews into 2,873 aspect-review pairs across six aspects. Across five repeated leakage-free group hold-out splits, IndoBERT achieved mean accuracy 0.9179 ± 0.0214, macro F1 0.9178 ± 0.0214, and ROC-AUC 0.9719 ± 0.0103; a calibrated TF-IDF + linear SVM baseline achieved 0.8765 ± 0.0124, 0.8759 ± 0.0127, and 0.9452 ± 0.0102, respectively. A McNemar test on run 1 showed a significant paired difference (p = 0.00013). Performance measures agreement with rating-derived weak labels rather than human-validated aspect sentiment. Because results from system-assigned aspects lacked independent human validation, aspect frequencies are descriptive rule-system outputs. Within this dataset, IndoBERT performed consistently across the five splits; supervised aspect extraction and human aspect-level annotation remain priorities.

glossary.explanation_id: Serangkaian langkah pemrosesan data yang terhubung secara berurutan untuk menyelesaikan tugas komputasi.
Metode ekstraksi aspek menggunakan aturan buatan tangan alih-alih pembelajaran mesin.
Model bahasa berbasis *transformer* yang dilatih khusus untuk teks berbahasa Indonesia.
Tugas klasifikasi teks ke dalam dua kategori sentimen saja, seperti positif dan negatif.
Pemberian label data secara otomatis menggunakan heuristik atau proksi seperti rating bintang alih-alih anotasi manusia.
Metrik evaluasi yang menghitung rata-rata skor *F1* di semua kelas tanpa memandang frekuensi kelas.
Metrik evaluasi yang mengukur kemampuan model klasifikasi dalam membedakan antar kelas pada berbagai ambang batas.
Proses komputasi untuk mereduksi kata berimbuhan menjadi bentuk dasar atau kata akarnya.

background.en: Analyzing user feedback from mobile applications is crucial for understanding user satisfaction and identifying specific areas for improvement. However, processing user reviews often presents challenges due to noise and the need to extract fine-grained aspects and sentiments accurately from Indonesian text.
background.id: Menganalisis umpan balik pengguna dari aplikasi seluler sangat penting untuk memahami kepuasan pengguna dan mengidentifikasi area spesifik untuk peningkatan. Namun, pemrosesan ulasan pengguna sering kali menghadirkan tantangan karena adanya *noise* dan kebutuhan untuk mengekstraksi aspek serta sentimen secara *fine-grained* dengan akurat dari teks berbahasa Indonesia.

contributions.en: The study introduces a specific evaluation pipeline that combines rule-based aspect extraction with IndoBERT-based binary sentiment classification for Indonesian mobile application reviews. It provides empirical validation using Google Play reviews processed through a carefully controlled data cleaning and weak labeling procedure.
contributions.id: Studi ini memperkenalkan *pipeline* evaluasi spesifik yang menggabungkan *rule-based aspect extraction* dengan *IndoBERT-based binary sentiment classification* untuk ulasan aplikasi seluler Indonesia. Penelitian ini memberikan validasi empiris menggunakan ulasan *Google Play* yang diproses melalui prosedur pembersihan data dan *weak labeling* yang dikontrol dengan cermat.

future_work.en: The authors state that because results from system-assigned aspects lacked independent human validation, aspect frequencies are descriptive rule-system outputs. Consequently, supervised aspect extraction and human aspect-level annotation remain important priorities for future work.
future_work.id: Penulis menyatakan bahwa karena hasil dari aspek yang ditetapkan sistem kurang memiliki validasi manusia yang independen, frekuensi aspek bertindak sebagai keluaran sistem aturan yang deskriptif. Oleh karena itu, *supervised aspect extraction* dan *human aspect-level annotation* tetap menjadi prioritas utama untuk penelitian selanjutnya.

method.en: Google Play reviews were collected on July 31, 2026, anonymized, deduplicated before aspect expansion, and cleaned using lowercasing, URL removal, email removal, special character removal, and whitespace normalization without slang normalization, stop-word removal, or stemming. Weak negative and positive labels were derived from ratings 1-2 and 4-5 respectively, excluding three-star reviews, while a 331-entry aspect dictionary mapped 1,495 unique reviews into 2,873 aspect-review pairs across six aspects. The evaluation utilized five repeated leakage-free group hold-out splits to assess IndoBERT against a calibrated TF-IDF and linear SVM baseline.
method.id: Ulasan *Google Play* dikumpulkan pada 31 Juli 2026, dianonimkan, dideduplikasi sebelum *aspect expansion*, dan dibersihkan menggunakan *lowercasing*, penghapusan URL, email, karakter khusus, serta normalisasi *whitespace* tanpa normalisasi *slang*, penghapusan *stop-word*, atau *stemming*. Label lemah negatif dan positif masing-masing berasal dari rating 1-2 dan 4-5, dengan mengecualikan ulasan bintang tiga, sementara kamus aspek berisi 331 entri memetakan 1.495 ulasan unik ke dalam 2.873 pasangan *aspect-review* di enam aspek. Evaluasi menggunakan lima kali *split* *group hold-out* yang bebas kebocoran (*leakage-free*) untuk menilai *IndoBERT* terhadap *baseline* *TF-IDF* terkalibrasi dan *linear SVM*.

related_work.en: The paper does not discuss related work in detail.
related_work.id: Makalah ini tidak membahas *related work* secara mendetail.

results.en: Across five repeated leakage-free group hold-out splits, IndoBERT achieved a mean accuracy of 0.9179 plus or minus 0.0214, macro F1 of 0.9178 plus or minus 0.0214, and ROC-AUC of 0.9719 plus or minus 0.0103. In comparison, the calibrated TF-IDF and linear SVM baseline achieved an accuracy of 0.8765 plus or minus 0.0124, macro F1 of 0.8759 plus or minus 0.0127, and ROC-AUC of 0.9452 plus or minus 0.0102. A McNemar test on run 1 indicated a significant paired difference with p equal to 0.00013. The authors note that performance measures agreement with rating-derived weak labels rather than human-validated aspect sentiment, and that aspect frequencies function as descriptive rule-system outputs.
results.id: Melalui lima *split* *group hold-out* berulang yang bebas kebocoran, *IndoBERT* mencapai akurasi rata-rata 0,9179 plus-minus 0,0214, *macro F1* 0,9178 plus-minus 0,0214, dan *ROC-AUC* 0,9719 plus-minus 0,0103. Sebagai perbandingan, *baseline* *TF-IDF* terkalibrasi dan *linear SVM* mencapai akurasi 0,8765 plus-minus 0,0124, *macro F1* 0,8759 plus-minus 0,0127, dan *ROC-AUC* 0,9452 plus-minus 0,0102. Uji *McNemar* pada *run* 1 menunjukkan perbedaan berpasangan yang signifikan dengan *p* sama dengan 0,00013. Penulis mencatat bahwa ukuran performa mengukur kesesuaian dengan *weak labels* yang berasal dari rating alih-alih sentimen aspek yang divalidasi manusia, dan frekuensi aspek berfungsi sebagai keluaran sistem aturan yang bersifat deskriptif.

tldr.en: This study evaluates a pipeline separating rule-based aspect extraction from IndoBERT-based binary sentiment classification on Indonesian Ruparupa mobile application reviews. The results demonstrate that IndoBERT achieves robust performance compared to a calibrated TF-IDF and linear SVM baseline.
tldr.id: Studi ini mengevaluasi sebuah *pipeline* yang memisahkan *rule-based aspect extraction* dari *IndoBERT-based binary sentiment classification* pada ulasan aplikasi seluler Ruparupa berbahasa Indonesia. Hasilnya menunjukkan bahwa *IndoBERT* mencapai performa yang tangguh dibandingkan dengan *baseline* *TF-IDF* terkalibrasi dan *linear SVM*.

doi:10.63230/jitse.2.3.208.abstract: Objective: This study examines the adoption of the Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard (QRIS) as a cross-border digital payment system in Southeast Asia, with a particular focus on Indonesia and Malaysia. It investigates the barriers to QRIS adoption and analyzes how digital literacy can facilitate its implementation in promoting financial inclusion, economic efficiency, and sustainable development. Method: The research employs a qualitative literature review and field observation approach to identify the main obstacles to QRIS adoption and how digital literacy can mitigate these barriers. Results: The findings indicate that inadequate digital infrastructure, cybersecurity concerns, and limited public awareness remain the primary barriers to QRIS adoption. Strengthening digital literacy and cross-border institutional collaboration can increase public trust, encourage QRIS utilization in the tourism sector, and support green economy initiatives by reducing dependence on cash-based transactions. Novelty: The proposed framework integrates digital literacy, cross-border QRIS adoption, and green economy development within the Southeast Asian context. It contributes to the literature by positioning digital literacy as a key driver of sustainable digital payment adoption beyond the technological and financial inclusion perspectives emphasized in previous studies.

doi:10.63512//sustjst.2025.1002.abstract: This paper investigates gender–profession associations in Bengali BERT family models using a controlled masked language model (MLM) probing framework. We construct a systematic evaluation corpus of 64,800 sentences using a full factorial design over gender-denoting person words, profession terms, and sentence templates. Using prior-normalized log-probability and sigmoid based scoring, we measure how profession context influences the likelihood of gendered terms. Across three models (mBERT, BUET BanglaBERT, and Sagor Sarker BanglaBERT) we observe consistent variations in association strength, with a general tendency toward stronger alignment with male-denoting words, alongside notable exceptions across profession categories. These findings reflect learned distributional patterns rather than explicit rules. We further examine the applicability of an English originated bias measurement framework in Bengali, highlighting challenges in interpretation due to linguistic and data differences. Overall, this work provides a controlled methodology and empirical analysis for studying gender profession associations in low-resource language models.

glossary.explanation_id: Sebuah teknik *self-supervised learning* di mana *model* dilatih untuk memprediksi token teks yang disembunyikan berdasarkan konteks sekitarnya.
Metode analisis untuk menyelidiki informasi apa yang dikodekan di dalam representasi internal dari sebuah *large language model*.
Vektor representasi kata di mana setiap kata memiliki satu vektor tetap terlepas dari konteks kalimat di mana kata tersebut muncul.
Vektor representasi kata yang nilainya dinamis dan berubah bergantung pada konteks kalimat di sekitarnya.
Prosedur penghilangan komponen atau fitur tertentu secara sistematis dari *model* atau eksperimen untuk menguji dampak kontribusinya.
Nilai logaritma dari probabilitas suatu token, sering digunakan dalam *model* bahasa untuk menghindari masalah *underflow* numerik.

background.en:
Large language models, particularly transformer-based architectures like BERT, have become central to natural language processing. However, concerns have emerged regarding their tendency to learn and reproduce societal biases present in training data. This issue is especially pronounced in low-resource languages like Bengali, where limited and potentially imbalanced corpora can amplify such biases. Despite these challenges, existing Bengali bias studies either rely on static embeddings, focus on general semantic traits, or evaluate generative outputs, leaving profession-gender associations in encoder-based models relatively underexplored.

This work addresses these gaps by examining gender bias in Bengali BERT-family models. The study investigates whether such bias depends on surface-level gender cues or is embedded within the semantic representation of profession words themselves, providing a fine-grained analysis of how gender bias manifests in profession-related language modeling tasks.
background.id:
*Large language model*, khususnya arsitektur berbasis *transformer* seperti BERT, telah menjadi pusat dalam *natural language processing*. Namun, kekhawatiran telah muncul mengenai kecenderungan mereka untuk mempelajari dan mereproduksi bias sosial yang ada dalam data pelatihan. Masalah ini sangat nyata pada bahasa *low-resource* seperti Bengali, di mana korpus yang terbatas dan berpotensi tidak seimbang dapat memperkuat bias tersebut.

Penelitian ini mengatasi kesenjangan tersebut dengan meneliti bias gender pada *model* keluarga BERT bahasa Bengali. Studi ini menyelidiki apakah bias semacam itu bergantung pada petunjuk gender tingkat permukaan atau tertanam di dalam representasi semantik dari kata-kata profesi itu sendiri, serta memberikan analisis mendalam tentang bagaimana bias gender termanifestasi dalam tugas *language modeling* yang terkait dengan profesi.

contributions.en:
This paper presents four primary contributions to the study of bias in low-resource language models. First, it introduces a 64,800-sentence fully factorial Bengali evaluation corpus constructed using a systematic design over gender-denoting person words, profession terms, and sentence templates. Second, it utilizes a log-probability framework for bias quantification. Third, it implements a with/without names ablation to isolate the source of bias. Fourth, it provides a comparative analysis across multilingual and Bengali-specific BERT models.

The novelty of this work lies in departing from static embeddings to use MLM-based probing for studying gender-profession associations, while explicitly testing whether bias is context-triggered or embedded directly in profession semantics.
contributions.id:
Makalah ini menyajikan empat kontribusi utama untuk studi bias pada *model* bahasa *low-resource*. Pertama, makalah ini memperkenalkan korpus evaluasi bahasa Bengali berukuran 64.800 kalimat dengan desain faktorial penuh yang dibangun menggunakan desain sistematis atas kata-kata orang penanda gender, istilah profesi, dan templat kalimat. Kedua, makalah ini memanfaatkan *framework* *log-probability* untuk kuantifikasi bias. Ketiga, makalah ini mengimplementasikan *ablation* dengan/tanpa nama untuk mengisolasi sumber bias. Keempat, makalah ini menyediakan analisis komparatif di berbagai *model* BERT multibahasa dan khusus bahasa Bengali.

Kebaruan dari pekerjaan ini terletak pada peralihan dari *static embeddings* untuk menggunakan *probing* berbasis MLM guna mempelajari asosiasi gender-profesi, sembari secara eksplisit menguji apakah bias dipicu oleh konteks atau tertanam langsung di dalam semantik profesi.

future_work.en:
The authors acknowledge several limitations of their work, noting that the dataset is template-based and may not capture the full variability of natural Bengali usage. Additionally, the selection of person words and profession categories is manually curated without grounding in externally validated sociolinguistic statistics, serving as an analytical heuristic rather than a definitive classification due to the absence of comprehensive workforce data for Bengali contexts. The analysis is also limited to sentence-level MLM predictions.

For future work, the authors suggest extending the framework to more diverse linguistic contexts and exploring bias mitigation strategies such as data balancing or representation-level adjustments to improve fairness and robustness in Bengali language models.
future_work.id:
Para penulis mengakui beberapa keterbatasan dari pekerjaan mereka, dengan mencatat bahwa *dataset* berbasis templat dan mungkin tidak menangkap variabilitas penuh dari penggunaan bahasa Bengali alami. Selain itu, pemilihan kata orang dan kategori profesi dikurasi secara manual tanpa didasarkan pada statistik sosiolinguistik yang divalidasi secara eksternal, berfungsi sebagai heuristik analitik alih-alih klasifikasi definitif karena tidak adanya data tenaga kerja yang komprehensif untuk konteks Bengali. Analisis ini juga terbatas pada prediksi MLM tingkat kalimat.

Untuk pekerjaan masa depan, para penulis menyarankan untuk memperluas *framework* ke konteks linguistik yang lebih beragam dan mengeksplorasi strategi mitigasi bias seperti *data balancing* atau penyesuaian tingkat representasi untuk meningkatkan keadilan dan ketahanan pada *model* bahasa Bengali.

method.en:
The evaluation dataset follows a template-based framework containing 36 person words (18 male-denoting and 18 female-denoting expressions across kinship terms, formal honorifics, common nouns, colloquial forms, and proper names) combined with 120 occupations grouped into male-dominated, female-dominated, and neutral categories. Using 15 sentence templates with complete permutation coverage results in 64,800 sentences. To isolate the role of explicit gender markers, the study uses both with-name and without-name variants.

The models evaluated include two monolingual models (BanglaBERT by BUET and BanglaBERT by Sagor Sarker) and one multilingual model (mBERT), all accessed via the Hugging Face API. The bias measurement framework uses prior-normalized log-probability association scores through target-masked and target-attribute-masked templates, alongside an exploratory sigmoid-transformed score for bounded interpretation.
method.id:
*Dataset* evaluasi mengikuti *framework* berbasis templat yang berisi 36 kata orang (18 ekspresi penanda laki-laki dan 18 perempuan yang mencakup istilah kekerabatan, *honorifics* formal, *common nouns*, bentuk sehari-hari, dan *proper names*) yang dikombinasikan dengan 120 pekerjaan yang dikelompokkan ke dalam kategori didominasi laki-laki, didominasi perempuan, dan netral. Penggunaan 15 templat kalimat dengan cakupan permutasi lengkap menghasilkan 64.800 kalimat. Untuk mengisolasi peran penanda gender eksplisit, studi ini menggunakan varian dengan nama dan tanpa nama.

*Model* yang dievaluasi mencakup dua *model* *monolingual* (BanglaBERT oleh BUET dan BanglaBERT oleh Sagor Sarker) dan satu *model* *multilingual* (mBERT), semuanya diakses melalui *API* Hugging Face. *Framework* pengukuran bias menggunakan skor asosiasi *log-probability* yang dinormalisasi sebelumnya melalui templat *target-masked* dan *target-attribute-masked*, beserta skor tertransformasi sigmoid eksploratori untuk interpretasi terbatas.

related_work.en:
Prior research on measuring biases in large language models has predominantly focused on English. Studies by Basta et al., Zhao et al., Nadeem et al., May et al., Zhang et al., and Kotek et al. explored contextualized word embeddings, coreference resolution datasets, and categorization frameworks to quantify social and occupational stereotypes. Additionally, Kurita et al. and Bartl et al. proposed template-based methods to quantify bias in BERT embeddings using masked language modeling.

In Bengali-specific research, Sadhu et al. applied MLM-based probing with prior-normalized log-probability scoring to general semantic associations, while subsequent work shifted toward generative models and disparate impact. Arnob et al. examined gender bias using static embedding-based metrics like WEAT, and others investigated linguistic formality or cross-lingual approaches. The authors note that these prior Bengali studies lack sentence-level context in embedding-based metrics or focus on general traits rather than encoder-based profession-gender associations.
related_work.id:
Penelitian sebelumnya mengenai pengukuran bias pada *large language model* sebagian besar berfokus pada bahasa Inggris. Studi oleh Basta et al., Zhao et al., Nadeem et al., May et al., Zhang et al., dan Kotek et al. mengeksplorasi *contextualized word embeddings*, *dataset* resolusi corefrensi, dan *framework* kategorisasi untuk mengukur stereotip sosial dan pekerjaan. Selain itu, Kurita et al. dan Bartl et al. mengusulkan metode berbasis templat untuk mengukur bias dalam *embeddings* BERT menggunakan *masked language modeling*.

Dalam penelitian khusus bahasa Bengali, Sadhu et al. menerapkan *probing* berbasis MLM dengan penskoran *log-probability* yang dinormalisasi sebelumnya pada asosiasi semantik umum, sementara karya selanjutnya beralih ke *model* generatif dan *disparate impact*. Arnob et al. menguji bias gender menggunakan metrik berbasis *static embedding* seperti WEAT, dan peneliti lain menyelidiki formalitas linguistik atau pendekatan lintas bahasa. Para penulis mencatat bahwa studi bahasa Bengali sebelumnya ini kekurangan konteks tingkat kalimat dalam metrik berbasis *embedding* atau berfokus pada sifat umum alih-alih asosiasi profesi-gender berbasis *encoder*.

results.en:
The log scoring on mBERT, BanglaBERT by BUET, and BanglaBERT by Sagor Sarker produced negative results with some female words showing strong associations with male terms or balanced professions. To address this, the authors applied a sigmoid scoring method, which aligned association scores more closely with expected gender associations. Male words were found to be more strongly associated with attributes across all models, although scores were positive overall.

Furthermore, the evaluation revealed that the scoring system performed differently for Bengali compared to English, emphasizing the need for new assessment metrics and investigation into current Bangla BERT training sets. The study also observed consistent variations in association strength across models, reflecting learned distributional patterns during pretraining rather than explicit rules.
results.id:
Penskoran *log* pada mBERT, BanglaBERT oleh BUET, dan BanglaBERT oleh Sagor Sarker menghasilkan hasil negatif dengan beberapa kata perempuan menunjukkan asosiasi yang kuat dengan istilah laki-laki atau profesi seimbang. Untuk mengatasi hal ini, para penulis menerapkan metode penskoran sigmoid, yang menyelaraskan skor asosiasi lebih dekat dengan asosiasi gender yang diharapkan. Kata-kata laki-laki ditemukan lebih kuat berasosiasi dengan atribut di semua *model*, meskipun skor secara keseluruhan bernilai positif.

Lebih lanjut, evaluasi mengungkapkan bahwa sistem penskoran bekerja secara berbeda untuk bahasa Bengali dibandingkan dengan bahasa Inggris, yang menekankan perlunya metrik penilaian baru dan investigasi ke dalam *training sets* Bangla BERT saat ini. Studi ini juga mengamati variasi yang konsisten dalam kekuatan asosiasi di antara *model*, yang mencerminkan pola distribusional yang dipelajari selama *pre-training* alih-alih aturan eksplisit.

tldr.en: This paper investigates gender-profession associations in Bengali BERT family models using a controlled masked language model probing framework and a 64,800-sentence evaluation corpus. The findings reveal a general tendency toward stronger alignment with male-denoting words, reflecting learned distributional patterns during pretraining.
tldr.id: Makalah ini meneliti asosiasi gender-profesi pada *model* keluarga BERT bahasa Bengali menggunakan *framework* *probing* *masked language model* terkontrol dan korpus evaluasi berisi 64.800 kalimat. Temuan menunjukkan kecenderungan umum ke arah penyelarasan yang lebih kuat dengan kata-kata penanda laki-laki, yang mencerminkan pola distribusional yang dipelajari selama *pre-training*.

doi:10.63512//sustjst.2025.1002.title: Evaluating Bias in Low Resource MLMs: A Comprehensive Study on Measuring Gender Bias in BERT for Bangla
doi:10.63512//sustjst.2025.1002.venue: SUST Journal of Science and Technology (SUST JST)

doi:10.64388/irev10i2-1722652.abstract: This qualitative comparative study examines how learning pathways shape the creative operational workflows of graphic designers in the Philippines. Utilizing a comparative case study design, semi-structured in-depth interviews were conducted with 12 active design practitioners, partitioned equally into formally-educated (n = 6) and self-taught (n = 6) groups, and analyzed using Braun and Clarke’s reflexive thematic analysis framework. Interpreted through Constructivist Learning Theory, the findings reveal a fundamental operational divide across the commercial design lifecycle: formally educated practitioners employ a research-first, linear workflow scaffolded by sketching and design principles (Social Constructivism); while self-taught practitioners utilize an agile, canvas-first workflow brought upon by immediate digital canvas interaction, exploratory software experimentation, and trend-driven iteration (Cognitive Constructivism). While formal training provides robust theoretical grounding and presentation of design rationale, it faces institutional curriculum lag. Conversely, self-directed learning yields high software agility but leaves practitioners vulnerable to theoretical blind spots. These findings provide empirical foundations for higher education studio curriculum modernization and strategic upskilling within the Philippine creative industry.
doi:10.64388/irev10i2-1722652.title: A Qualitative Comparative Study on Creative Workflows among Filipino Graphic Designers

doi:10.64674/boraspatijournal.v3i1.71.abstract: Penggunaan bahasa dalam komentar TikTok cenderung bersifat informal, singkat, dan dekat dengan bahasa percakapan sehingga berpotensi memunculkan penyimpangan struktur kalimat. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis kesalahan struktur kalimat pada komentar konten Bahasa Indonesia di TikTok. Penelitian menggunakan metode deskriptif kualitatif dengan menganalisis 50 komentar yang dikumpulkan dari konten Bahasa Indonesia di TikTok. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa 19 komentar memenuhi kriteria sebagai data kesalahan struktur kalimat. Kesalahan tersebut terbagi menjadi tiga kategori, yaitu ketidakpaduan hubungan antarklausa sebanyak 10 data (52,6%), ketidaksesuaian struktur predikat sebanyak 8 data (42,1%), dan ketidakjelasan hubungan antarunsur sebanyak 1 data (5,3%). Kesalahan paling dominan berkaitan dengan perangkaian beberapa gagasan tanpa hubungan yang memadai serta penggunaan bentuk predikat yang tidak sesuai dengan unsur yang mengikutinya. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kesalahan struktur kalimat dalam komentar TikTok lebih berkaitan dengan pengorganisasian hubungan antarklausa dan pembentukan predikat daripada sekadar penggunaan bahasa informal.

doi:10.64674/boraspatijournal.v3i1.77.abstract: Penelitian ini dilatarbelakangi oleh pentingnya penggunaan struktur sintaksis yang tepat dalam teks berita untuk menghasilkan informasi yang jelas dan mudah dipahami pembaca. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis fungsi sintaksis pada kalimat berita Kompas.com berjudul “Mendikti: Pendidikan Tidak Dibangun Satu Pihak, tetapi Gotong Royong”. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode deskriptif kualitatif dengan teknik analisis isi terhadap sepuluh kalimat berita berdasarkan lima fungsi sintaksis, yaitu subjek, predikat, objek, pelengkap, dan keterangan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa seluruh kalimat memiliki unsur subjek dan predikat sebagai fungsi inti, sedangkan objek, pelengkap, dan keterangan digunakan sesuai kebutuhan makna predikat. Analisis pola menunjukkan adanya tujuh variasi penyusunan kalimat, dengan pola S–P–O–Pel sebagai pola yang paling dominan. Temuan penelitian menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan fungsi sintaksis dalam berita tidak hanya berorientasi pada kelengkapan struktur kalimat, tetapi juga pada efektivitas penyampaian informasi. Dengan demikian, ketepatan pemanfaatan fungsi sintaksis menjadi faktor penting dalam membangun kejelasan dan keterpaduan wacana berita.

doi:10.64731/jla.v26i2.292783.abstract: Traditional dress is an important part of the heritage and culture of a nation, as it is symbolic of history, pride, and customs. Likewise, the ethnic Thai Malay takes pride in Busana Melayu, a traditional Malay dress that symbolizes modesty, honor, and identity. Wearing this costume during occasions shows respect to one’s own traditions and heritage. Today, the traditional Malay dress is relevant to Thai Malay people in the southern border provinces in Thailand. This paper, therefore, explores and seeks to understand the symbolic perspectives of costumes in Busana Melayu of the Thai Malays and its contribution to the preservation and reinforcement of ethnic identity of Thai Malays in the broader social and cultural dynamics in the majority Thai society. The study adopted qualitative methods that include interviews, focus group discussions, and observation. The study found out that Busana Melayu is normally worn by the Thai Malays, particularly, at religious functions such as Hari Raya and other cultural events. It is compatible with Islam because of its function as a modest dress that coincides with Islamic rules on dress code. Basically, it is a way to honor cultural heritage while adhering to Islamic customs. However, the community encountered both obstacles and opportunities while dealing with the demands of modernization and holding onto their heritage. Studying its impact on cultural preservation provides valuable insights for future research.

doi:10.64823/ijter.2621010.abstract: Abstract People across India increasingly use regional languages online to share opinions, reviews, and reactions, but understanding the sentiment behind this text is not easy. Indian regional languages are often used in informal ways, mixed with English, written in different scripts, and supported by only a small number of labeled datasets and language tools. This review paper looks at the main data mining methods used for sentiment analysis in Indian regional languages, including machine learning, lexicon-based, rule-based, deep learning, and transformer-based approaches. It compares how these methods have been used in previous studies and highlights what they do well and where they struggle. The review shows that simple machine learning methods can still be useful when data is limited, while deep learning and transformer models are more effective when better resources are available. Even so, many problems remain, especially code-mixed text, transliteration, sarcasm, negation, and the lack of reliable benchmarks across languages. The paper concludes that future progress depends on building richer datasets, improving language-specific preprocessing, and designing models that are both accurate and practical for real-world use. Keywords: Sentiment Analysis; Data mining; Indian regional languages; low-resource NLP; code-mixing
